rows.name: [Don't] Let Go
rows.short_description: [Don't] Let Go is a quiet, emotional and atmospheric 3D Action-Adventure Puzzle game. Bound to a mysterious entity by a powerful connection you must work together to solve puzzles, defeat enemies and escape the ancient city. Do you have the strength to sever your only connection?
rows.description_html: [Don't] Let Go is a quiet, emotional and atmospheric 3D Action-Adventure Puzzle game. Bound to a mysterious entity by a powerful connection you must work together to solve puzzles, defeat enemies and escape the ancient city. Narrative: You will venture to an ancient and mostly abandoned city located deep within a crater on a journey to see whether the forgotten city is inhabitable for your wandering tribe. Here you will find a mysterious cube with a destructive past that latches onto you, forming a symbiotic rope-like connection. You must use this new found friend to escape the city by solving its many puzzles, avoiding its many threats and allowing the cube to grow. However… all is not as it seems… As the cube grows, it will start to slowly act like an anchor weighing you down and making your escape almost impossible. Do you have what it takes to flee the cursed land… Progression: On your journey you and the mysterious cube will venture to regain its long lost power. By revisiting churches from a past era you can upgrade the cubes power, allowing it to grow in size and strength enabling you to reach new areas and solve more complex puzzles. However... as the cube grows so does its ability to prevent your escape, can you really leave it behind? Goals and Challenges: After successfully locating and abandoned city with potential to be your tribes new home you find yourself unable to leave, the exit blocked by two ancient tentacles. Together with your cube venture to different points in the city to destroy the tentacles, allowing you to flee the cursed land.  Along the way, subordinates of the tentacle will attempt to sever your connection with the cube, imprisoning you both and preventing your escape. Fight multiple different enemy types, forcing you to use the cube in unique ways to defeat them all.  Solve ancient puzzles to unlock new areas and progress through the city on your journey to leave with your new friend.  Primary Game Mechanic: After discovering the cube it forms a unique bond to you, forming a symbiotic rope like connection between the two. Acting like an anchor, the cube and this ancient connection will prevent you from moving far without it, holding you back and limiting your journey. As you go further from the cube your energy will decrease and reliance on it will increase forcing you to stay near it and maintain your energy. The cube is your primary weapon throughout the journey, by throwing it at enemies knock them back and eventually vanish them to push forward and find a way out of the city.  The cube can also be thrown at objects allowing you to alter the environment and solve puzzles to progress further.  Knowing its true power the mystical enemies will try to take the cube from you and return it to the prison from which you found it. Your goal is to protect it and keep it safe, stunning, hitting and defeating all the enemies that block your path and threaten its safety  Playtime: On average it takes new players 1 hour and 30 minutes to beat the game for the first time. At the end of each playthrough you are rewarded with a picture to showcase your achievement. There are 5 of these to collect based on challenges within the game, have fun and good luck! Disclaimers: This is a student game made by 6 people for our final major project at Birmingham City University (2 Designers, 2 Programmers, 1 Artist, 1 Sound Designer). The game is finished and takes a new player around an hour and a half to beat.  [Don't] Let Go has been primarily built for gamepads (Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo controllers) please use one of those for the best experience, we do not advise using a keyboard.

rows.name: Toxic Harvest
rows.short_description: Trapped on Halloween night in a chemical plant after a deadly spill, you’re hunted by a mutated creature. Your only escape is blocked, and every push toward freedom alerts your position. Time your movements, manage your stamina, and survive the night.
rows.description_html: Trapped on Halloween night in a chemical plant after a catastrophic spill, you’re being hunted by something born of mutation and madness. In this single player short horror, your only way out is blocked, but every time you push towards your escape, the screeching grind echoes, drawing the creature closer. Timing is everything, so listen for its movements, and if it sees you... Run. Key Features: The Creature Hunts You – Something inhuman stalks your every move. Stamina Survival – Each push drains your strength and alerts the creature; wait for a cooldown and hide. Claustrophobic Factory Setting – Navigate dim corridors to evade the creature's pursuit. One Goal: Escape – Push the pallet far enough to clear your path… before it takes you. Do you have what it takes to escape? Or will you become the next victim of the Toxic Harvest ?

rows.name: Dark Watching Chapter 1
rows.short_description: your goal is to find your sister that went missing. Solve simple puzzles and avoid being found by the Watcher.
rows.description_html: Dark Watching: Chapter 1 – The Bunker is a gripping first-person horror adventure. You play as Jacob, searching for your missing sister. Your path leads through an abandoned bunker full of secrets, puzzles, and deadly dangers. Explore rooms, collect clues and items Solve puzzles, activate mechanisms and doors A virus-infected Human hunts you – one mistake can be fatal Your decisions affect one of three possible endings Dark atmosphere and eerie sounds Story Hook: After a mysterious murder in the mall, you must take an alternate route through the bunker. Only vigilance, clever action, and your flashlight will ensure your survival.

rows.name: Sandrotten: Ekera
rows.short_description: An endless horde hack & slash with souls-like combat mechanics. Fight your way through endless waves of undead, and see just how far you can make it before the Sandrotten horde takes you down.
rows.description_html: You’ve been here before. You’ll be here again. Survive the nightmare that doesn't end. ​ An endless nightmare; You awaken in Ekera, the nightmarish hellscape realm of rot & torment. Where the souls of the dead fight & die without rest. The only way to escape is to wake up, but even death does not free you from Ekera's grasp. With only your weapon, your stamina, and your will to fight, fight your way through endless hordes of damned souls as long as you can; for when you fall, and you will fall - Ekera remembers. Sandrotten: Ekera is a never ending horde hack & slash where you fight your way through endless hordes of tormented undead beings, with the difficulty increasing after each kill. How many can you take down before your inevitable fall?

rows.name: Word Quest

rows.description_html: Type fast to survive! Embark on the world of Word Quest, play as a Sorcerer that went into debt after gambling everything he had, lead that sorcerer into glory again by completing quests, battling against monsters and acquiring new skills in this typing game! Do quests to pay your debt, and buy skills to get stronger! Battle monsters to save people and win money! Expected playtime of 30m-1h to complete depending on your skill level

rows.name: Eclipse Breaker: Boss Rush
rows.short_description: Face a gauntlet of relentless bosses in this free minigame from action roguelite, Eclipse Breaker. Test your skill in 15–20 minute sessions built for fast-paced but strategic runs, before jumping into the complete adventure later this year.
rows.description_html: This free minigame gives you an early taste of the upcoming action-roguelite Eclipse Breaker. Step into a Boss Rush mode designed for quick, high-intensity runs that showcase the game’s parry-driven combat and active-time battle flow. Perfect for anyone who wants to see how far they can push their skills in a single sitting. Every run throws you against a lineup of bosses with escalating patterns and punishing attacks. Learn their tells, master your dodges and parries, and unleash devastating counters. Runs take 15–20 minutes , making it easy to jump in for “just one more try.” This Boss Rush mode will also be included in the main Eclipse Breaker game at launch. Play it now for free, then come back during Steam Next Fest for the full demo with roguelite progression, companion allies, loads of equipment and upgrades, and more bosses to conquer. Developer's Note Hi everyone, I’m Jorge Rodriguez, the developer of Eclipse Breaker. This project is my tribute to the roguelites and PlayStation-era RPGs that defined my love of games, blending fast-paced, timing-driven battles with the sense of mystery and danger I grew up chasing. I've had a lot of fun developing this game, and it’s been a joy to bring that idea to life. The minigame you’re about to play is just one game mode available in the full release, and your feedback is incredibly valuable as we keep building toward the launch later this year. Whether you’re here for the strategic combat, the nostalgia, or to test your skills against impossible odds, thank you for giving Eclipse Breaker a try. Now go face the challenge, and see how long you can last!

rows.name: Finding Momo
rows.short_description: A fast-paced yet heartwarming 3D runner where you dash through vibrant cities starting in Busan, collect recyclables to restore nature, and rescue animals while searching for your missing friend Momo.
rows.description_html: Bug Test If you encounter any issues or bugs while playing the game, reporting them through 'Discord' allows for faster resolution. You can join 'Discord' via the link on the Steam store page. About the Game Finding Momo Finding Momo is a fast-paced yet heartwarming ESG 3D runner that begins in the lively streets of Busan .  Play as Jon , an adventurer on a mission to find his missing friend, Momo . Dash through busy urban alleys and scenic coastal roads, dodge obstacles, collect recyclable items to restore the city, and rescue sea animals in need. The perspective shifts dynamically between side view and back view , giving each run a fresh and cinematic feel. The more you run, the more life and nature return to the world around you. 🐾 Key Features Start in Busan and journey through diverse cities across the globe Explore vibrant 3D environments inspired by real urban and coastal scenery      Dynamic camera angles : switch seamlessly between side-scrolling and back-view running Collect recyclable items and bring nature back as you run Encounter and rescue endangered sea animals along the way A cozy and colorful art style with charming characters Unlock fun character customization options Accessible single-player gameplay for casual and indie fans More than just chasing high scores, Finding Momo is a wholesome adventure about caring for the world around us—and never giving up on the friends (and pets!) we love.

rows.name: Senior Sunset
rows.short_description: 35 dead students, dozens of silenced parents, and one police coverup later you decide it's time to take matters into your own hands. You descend into the depths of your high school to figure out what really happened to your classmates.
rows.description_html: WELCOME BACK TO SCHOOL 35 of your classmates were murdered. Law enforcement's response was to cover everything up. Not a single living soul could tell you the whole story, so you decide to find out for yourself. Take on the role of Amanda, an aspiring podcaster who yearns for a good story- something to really get some people tuning in. You break into your own high school to investigate, finding the truth behind the murders and uncovering that the truth is far more sinister than you could've ever imagined. Be aware at all times. With limited movement options, you'll have to decide when's best to make your move. It will hear you. Plan ahead . Unlock various shortcuts and hidden pathways in the school to assist you in navigating throughout. Be sure of your route in order to avoid any unwanted encounters. WHAT TO EXPECT Dive into a full, fleshed out psychological horror experience. Senior Sunset offers a linear story with gameplay that can vary between cautious, slow, and calculated & intense and fast-paced. Beware of him . A constant, looming threat is ever-present throughout your descent into the school. It will do everything in its power to hunt you down. With its advanced detection & reactive capabilities, nowhere is safe for long. The school is a dark, detailed location packed full of places to explore. Slowly unlock different rooms and halls as you journey through with little to no navigational assistance.

rows.name: a.sector
rows.short_description: a.sector is a multiplayer, top-down space shooter. Collect loot, earn coins, play with friends! See if you can summon the boss or conquer some dark elite enemies!
rows.description_html: a.sector is a multiplayer, top-down space shooter. Collect loot, upgrade your ships, earn coins, play with friends! See if you can summon the boss or conquer some dark elite enemies! Can you maximize your ship's power by collecting enough floppy disks? Choose from 5 playable ship types: the fighter, the tank, the scout, the healer & the juggernaut. Play with friends to gain a buff from their ship's aura! Aura buff effects: Fighter -> boost your ship's attack power Tank -> boost your ship's damage reduction Scout -> boost your ship's movement speed Healer -> boost your ship's healing power Juggernaut -> boost your ship's max health

rows.name: Birbox
rows.short_description: Birbox is a 2D puzzle-platformer where you fly, throw, and deliver bizarre packages as a hard-working bird. Use physics, timing, and creativity to solve quirky challenges, face enemies, and please eccentric clients in a chaotic delivery company.
rows.description_html: NUCLEAR BOMBS! GHOSTS! FUTURISTIC MACHINES! And of course... PIZZA! Deliver all kinds of crazy packages in Birbox , a 2D puzzle-platformer where you play as a regular bird with a very irregular job. Every package is a new delivery experience! At Birbox Inc. , deliveries are... let’s say extravagant . That’s why each level introduces a new mechanic to master — from umbrellas to teksaballs! Wait… you don’t know what a teksaball is? Think outside the box... and with the box itself! These deliveries won’t be easy. You’ll need to use physics and the unique properties of each package to solve puzzles that require timing, skill, and the cleverness of a crow. Compete with the competition — literally! Oh, did we mention the deadly robots? Between puzzles, you’ll face enemies that spice up your delivery routes. You’ll also encounter bosses who want to stop those boxes from reaching their destination. They’re not just tough — they’re puzzles too! Too easy for you? Go for five stars! Our clients demand speed . So if you’re up for a challenge, try to complete each delivery as quickly as possible to earn a five-star rating. (Who knows — it might come in handy later…) Or maybe you'd prefer a more careful approach? Try finishing levels without damaging the package . Go for perfection or take it easy — the choice is yours. Chat with unforgettable clients! In this bird-filled world, every customer is unique. Before each delivery, you'll have a chance to talk with your clients — no matter how big, old… or clueless they might be. Join Birbox — for free! It’s the only delivery job where you’ll handle rockets, radioactive materials, and... a ton of fun.

rows.name: Surrelia Adventures
rows.short_description: A free to play 3D platformer which features single player gameplay and platforming mechanics. Surrelia Adventures is a game in which there's no one way to play. You navigate the world with two characters that have different powers and it's up to the player to utilise them to progress.
rows.description_html: Surrelia Adventures is a 3D platformer where two characters from different worlds are transported to the world of Surrelia. They must work together and find their way back home, by solving puzzles, speaking to the inhabitants and fighting off dangerous foes. Characters Abilities The two characters that you control means double possibility, with Geo(Red) being able to shrink down to enter secret areas, and Pokko(Purple) being able to jump on top of the highest hills. The combat differs with Geo being a melee only character, great for close combat, which differs from Pokko who shoots from a blaster, great for keeping your distance! Level themes Complete levels around visually striking environments in different regions, each region is home to a different species based on the ecosystem, so be sure to speak to them and hear what they have to say! World Experience Surrelia is a vibrant and joyful place, so be sure to see as much as you can through this adventure all while collecting special power ups and gems to get a high score Credits Devonte Griffiths- Lead Developer, Main Programmer Max Oxman- Game Designer, 3D Modeller, Environment Design Devin Brown- 3D Modeller Carlo Olivas- UI, Settings Keiran Sayer- Level Design, Secondary Assets And a special thank you to Salim Hasshu- Mentor, Publisher ‘DeMon Games’, at De Montfort University Luis Cesar Rodriguez- Achievement Art Additional Information Rocks and Combined Asset- fab- raffyraffy- Under public license- Textures altered- CC License 4.0-

rows.name: FLOSS
rows.short_description: A fast-paced top-down shooter without any excess. Built on aggressive movement, precise controls, and real challenge. Designed for players who love to learn, adapt, and master mechanics.
rows.description_html: This game won’t tell you an epic story or amaze you with mind-blowing graphics. It’s built to give you a series of carefully crafted battles. A free indie project where every mechanic works together as one whole. Aggressive dashing. Forget about passive play and rolling around to avoid damage. Six unique weapons. Each serves its own purpose — and you don’t have to bother with weapon switching. Every weapon is always available, instantly. Fast-paced and demanding. The challenge is tough but fair. Whenever there’s ambiguity, the game bends the rules in your favor. Two power-ups instead of style points. Modify and upgrade your weapons through your own actions, tailoring them to the fight. Turn your pistol into a shotgun or speed up your bow’s powerful charge shot — the choice is yours. Everything pushes you to aggression. Shield ran out? Kill enemies. Need a dash? Kill enemies. Want to charge the bow faster? Kill enemies. Overwhelmed by enemy combos? Kill them before they do anything. Did I mention you’ll need to kill enemies? Quick restarts. Yes, you will die. Yes, you only have one life. But I made sure the flow of battle never stops. Some playtesters literally burned out from the intensity.

rows.name: Dwarfare: All For The Forge
rows.short_description: Be the dwarf you know you are! Build towers to protect the beacons and keep production in motion! Use your weapons to corner any enemies that scrape through. Do it- do it ALL FOR THE FORGE!!
rows.description_html: Dwarfare: All for the Forge! is a single player first-person tower defense game. Defend against Mother Natures' hoards of enemies as they try to stop you from the ultimate goal- profit! Build towers and use weapons to protect the beacon and keep the forge safe. Utilize a wide range of towers to defend against he hoards. if that ain't good enough, do it yourself! Grab your choice of weapons to take out any enemies that slip through your defenses. Choose your loadout casually to synergize with your towers and playstyle.  Brush up on your typing, dwarves- our technology ain't touchscreen! Utilize the terminal systems to build & manage towers. The wrath of nature never rests! Time between waves is limited, so make the most of what little time you have to repair towers, upgrade your arsenal and prepare for the next onslaught!

rows.name: Halmgaard MMORPG
rows.short_description: Step into Halmgaard — a nostalgic yet fresh 2D MMORPG where freedom, challenge, and community meet. Explore an open world, master magic and skills, forge your destiny, and take risks for legendary rewards.
rows.description_html: Enter the World of Halmgaard A nostalgic yet fresh 2D MMORPG experience — built for adventurers seeking challenge, freedom, and community. 🌍 Cross-Platform Gameplay Play seamlessly across mobile and other devices. Your journey follows you wherever you go. ⚔️ Features: Leveling System – Grow stronger as you fight, explore, and discover. Skill System – Train melee, accuracy, magic, and more. Customize your playstyle. Spells & Classes – Choose from various classes and unleash a wide range of powerful spells. Enchantment & Blacksmithing – Upgrade your gear through a risk-based enhancement system. PVP Combat – Engage in high-stakes player-versus-player battles. Team Hunts & Solo Play – Join others or face the world alone. Rune Crafting – Unlock powerful magic by creating your own runes. Open World Exploration – Discover quests, secrets, and hidden dangers. High Risk, High Reward – Take bold risks for legendary rewards. World Bosses – Face epic bosses with your team for rare and powerful loot. Player Housing – Own property, decorate your space, and showcase your rare equipment. 🧭 Inspired by Classic 2D MMORPGs Built with love for the golden age of online RPGs — where every corner hides a story, and every decision matters.

rows.name: Trail of Stars
rows.short_description: A short and (bitter)sweet fairy tale visual novel about first love and longing.
rows.description_html: A noble lord brings two squires along on a hunt. One is a gentle boy who should not exist. The other is a girl who dreams of plunging a dagger into her master’s heart. Trail of Stars is a short, bittersweet visual novel about two vulnerable souls navigating first love, growing up, and protecting what they have—when all they have is each other. A short and (bitter)sweet tale , under 3k words with two endings. A moving story you can finish in one sitting.  Beautiful visuals . Fairy-tale scenes are laid out like a storybook along with three fully rendered illustrations.  An emotional original score featuring cello performances by ArcanaXIX.  One knightly kiss on the hand . A must for fans of tender romances and childhood-friends-to-lovers. Story, programming, GUI, logo, project direction: ENDYSIS Character art, cover illustration: Pauline Reinacher Background art: Sparrowling CG illustrations: Akua Music: ENDYSIS, Calamanser, ArcanaXIX Ambient SFX: Calamanser Cello performances: ArcanaXIX Created in one month for Sealed with a Kiss Jam (2025). See more of this world (and the characters many years in the future) in my upcoming game The Last Winter Knight.

rows.name: Gestalt System
rows.short_description: This is a multiplayer mech FPS game. You will choose your favorate robots, and work with teammates capable of different careers. Conquer the enemies, break the defense, activate energy core, destroy the buildings and finally win the game.
rows.description_html: This game is still approximately one year away from its minimum viable version. The following content will be gradually updated and added in future versions. ASSEMBLE YOUR TEAM Gear up and log in—it's training time! Seven minutes of intense action stem from 7,000 attempts! What? No gaming in the lab? Captain, let me explain... FIGHT WITH STRATEGY Control tactical bonus points, infiltrate enemy backlines, focus fire on high-value targets—collaborate with teammates to execute tactics and secure victory. DESTROY THE BASE Train yourself and your AI through FPS MOBA gameplay. Break through enemy lines, destroy their base, and claim ultimate triumph. CHOOSE YOUR MECH (currently not supported) Damage dealer? Support? Or a nimble scout? Select a mech configuration that matches your style and training goals. Gain experience in battles and fully prepare for the upcoming offline tournaments. OR PERHAPS YOU HAVE YOUR OWN PRIDE (currently not supported, will support through workshop) Use the Workshop to add mechs designed by yourself. Bring your own creations into battles and explore uncharted arenas. TRANSCEND TIME AND SPACE (only 2026 & 2024 version maps are implemented for now) The past you speak of... Is it the past we once shared? Those arenas we once conquered or never set foot on are now possible here. // AI gameplay overlay GIF CONNECT YOU, ME & HIM/HER/THEM (AI protocol rules are still under discussion; join our QQ groups for more info) Human-to-human collaboration, human-to-AI collaboration, and even AI-to-AI collaboration. We will use gaming as a medium to explore the future of human-machine cooperation and competition. We look forward to the day when they transition from the virtual world to reality.

rows.name: Top Heroes
rows.short_description: ◆ Embark on an Adventure Explore unknown lands, unlock ancient ruins, and brave dangerous dungeons! ◆ Build Your Kingdom Create a thriving realm from scratch and turn your dream city into reality! ◆ Achieve Glory with Your Guild Form powerful alliances with players worldwide, and conquer the world!
rows.description_html: Join 50 Million Players and Counting! Top Heroes is an RPG strategy game set in a captivating fantasy world. A thrilling adventure awaits as you explore uncharted lands. The world is under siege by an ancient evil, threatening to plunge everything into chaos. Will you lead your heroes to victory and restore peace to the land? Recruit legendary heroes from across the realm, each with unique abilities and skills. From valiant knights to cunning sorcerers, assemble your dream team and lead your empire to glory! ◆ YOU ARE THE ADVENTURER! Venture into uncharted lands filled with ancient ruins, hidden treasures, and perilous dungeons. ◆ YOU ARE THE CREATOR! Build your territory and transform it into a thriving kingdom from the ground up! ◆ YOU ARE THE WARLORD! Command your armies and engage in epic wars where strategy and tactics determine victory. ◆ YOU ARE THE DIPLOMAT! Forge alliances with other players, negotiate agreements, and form powerful guilds to dominate the world together. Strength lies in unity! ◆ YOU ARE THE CONQUEROR! Expand your territory, exploit resources, and eliminate your enemies to become the ultimate ruler. Shape your own story today! Enjoying Top Heroes? Join our Discord community at the link below to discover more about the game!

rows.name: Loutra: Inaugural Group Show
rows.short_description: A loitering simulator and dreamcore powerhouse, Loutra opens its inaugural group show. Thirteen artists display their work within a world of crude, deteriorating pixels.
rows.description_html: Introduction Loutra is a geothermal bathhouse and its surrounding outbuildings, inspired by the municipal baths of Mandraki in Nisyros, Greece. It is a virtual art space for you to reside in - a small, contemplative world to return to from time to time. Loutra receives regular updates that manipulate and subvert its environment, introducing new experiments, artworks, and ideas. Come back whenever you like. Features A unique digital atmosphere with a nostalgic, decayed aesthetic In-game tools that alter your perception of space and content A hand-crafted world filled with quiet details and subtle quirks A persistent environment with a fragmented history that changes over time, hosting new exhibitions and experiences A nonlinear, hybrid walking simulator / immersive sim - a 'loitering simulator' Over 20 artworks spanning sculpture, painting, audio, film, installation, and interactive digital media An exhibition guide listing all contributing artists and their works Online chatroom Make a coffee, take a bath, sit by the water Statement '...But it will be wonderfully pleasant to be able to transform at will an empty hour, an interminable evening, an endless Sunday, into an enchantment, an expression of tenderness, a flight of the spirit.' The Conquest of Ubiquity , Paul Valéry (1928) Loutra situates itself in the unstable terrain between memory and simulation - a nostalgic yet bit-rotten cyberspace that resists the smooth veneer of corporate virtuality. In its inaugural group show, Loutra accommodates the voices of thirteen artists within a world of crude, deteriorating pixels. What emerges is a slow unfolding of atmospheres. Born from an artist residency in 2019, Loutra began as both an act of preservation and a response to the rise of digital-curatorial experimentation. Initially a virtual artist residency in the form of a videogame, it evolved through a series of beta exhibitions and exercises in subtractive design, becoming a continuous, dreamlike digital space. Loutra is a living work. Though complete in form, it continues to change through periodic updates, new exhibitions, and online events. Loutra is self-funded and free-to-play. External links are provided where you can support its continued development; any donations are deeply appreciated. rows.name: Raise the Colours
rows.short_description: Raise the Colours is a satirical 4-player co-op physics game where you race to plant flags before the timer runs out. Work together (or trip each other up) while dodging pesky council workers who’ll do anything to shut down your fun. Not allowed!
rows.description_html: Grab your friends, grab a flag, and try not to fall flat on your face! Raise the Colours is a satirical 4-player co-op physics game where your only mission is to fly as many flags as possible before the clock runs out. Easy… until the local council shows up to shut you down. Expect complete mayhem as you stumble, trip, and collide with each other in a desperate scramble to get those colours flying. The more you cooperate, the smoother it goes… but when has cooperation  ever worked? Features: 4-player chaos – online multiplayer madness. Physics-driven slapstick – carrying flags has never been harder (or funnier). Not Allowed!  – cones, barriers, and local council officials determined to ruin your fun. Satirical pastiche – a tongue-in-cheek party game that doesn’t take itself seriously. It’s dumb, it’s chaotic, it’s about raising flags against all odds. Raise the Colours is just a meme — play it for laughs, not for meaning.

rows.name: Not Raised By Wolves
rows.short_description: Not Raised by Wolves is a third-person shooter starring La Coyota, an anthropomorphic gunslinger. Dash, aim, and shoot with your revolver while your robotic sidekick hacks enemies to stun them and expose weak points in your fight to rescue the colony’s pups.
rows.description_html: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. Not Raised by Wolves is a third-person shooter where you play as La Coyota, an anthropomorphic gunslinger fighting through an ancient AI facility to rescue her colony’s pups. Armed with a trusty revolver and aided by your robotic sidekick, you’ll dash, aim, and shoot your way to victory. Use your revolver’s dual firing modes to adapt to every encounter, and unleash your drone’s hacking ability to temporarily stun enemies, expose their weak points, and set up the perfect kill shot. Every fight demands quick reflexes, clever use of your tools, and the grit to keep moving forward.

rows.name: Pulsagon
rows.short_description: Welcome to Pulsagon, a high-speed, shape-shifting rhythm game where reflexes meet geometry in a dance of perfect timing. Every beat is a test. Every shape is a challenge. And every misstep? A pulse closer to chaos.
rows.description_html: 🎮 Pulsagon – A Rhythm Game of Perfect Shape and Precision Welcome to Pulsagon , a high-speed, shape-shifting rhythm game where reflexes meet geometry in a dance of perfect timing. Every beat is a test. Every shape is a challenge. And every misstep? A pulse closer to chaos. In Pulsagon , the music isn’t just background noise—it’s the battlefield. Shapes descend to the beat in all directions, and your job is to match their form and rotate your shield to meet them head-on. Sounds easy? You’ll be switching between Circle, Triangle, Square, Pentagon (and beyond) in milliseconds, all while staying perfectly synced to the pulse of the soundtrack. 🕹️ How It Works: Use your mouse to rotate a 360° shield around a glowing central core. Tap keys (1–4 or QWER) to instantly morph your shield into the correct shape . A Circle can't stop a Triangle. A Pentagon won’t block a Square. Match shape for shape, beat for beat. Some shapes don’t stop at one hit—you’ll need to stay focused for what's next… 🎵 Features That’ll Keep You on Your Toes: Several handcrafted levels , each synced to original high-energy music spanning EDM , Chiptune , Glitch , and more. Progressive difficulty curve : start slow, then dive into complex combos, fakeouts, and relentless beat streams. Shape-switching madness that demands both mental agility and lightning-fast reflexes. A crisp, minimalist aesthetic with vibrant geometry that pulses in time with the music. No distractions —no story, no fluff. Just you, the beat, and your instincts. A Functioning Level Editor  where you can create your own levels in a .parlev file format. Whether you're here to chase a high score or survive the last 30 seconds of a Very Hard track, Pulsagon will push you to think fast, move faster, and master the art of rhythmic precision. There’s no margin for error—only shape, sound, and symmetry. Are your reflexes sharp enough? Hit play and find out. TIPS FOR .parlev LEVELS SHARING If you want to play an unofficial .parlev level made by users, or if you want to upload your .parlev files to the public, make sure you check out our discord!

Some shapes don’t stop at one hit—you’ll need to stay focused for what's next… 🎵 Features That’ll Keep You on Your Toes: Several handcrafted levels , each synced to original high-energy music spanning EDM , Chiptune , Glitch , and more. Progressive difficulty curve : start slow, then dive into complex combos, fakeouts, and relentless beat streams. Shape-switching madness that demands both mental agility and lightning-fast reflexes. A crisp, minimalist aesthetic with vibrant geometry that pulses in time with the music. No distractions —no story, no fluff. Just you, the beat, and your instincts. A Functioning Level Editor  where you can create your own levels in a .parlev file format. Whether you're here to chase a high score or survive the last 30 seconds of a Very Hard track, Pulsagon will push you to think fast, move faster, and master the art of rhythmic precision. There’s no margin for error—only shape, sound, and symmetry. Are your reflexes sharp enough? Hit play and find out. TIPS FOR .parlev LEVELS SHARING If you want to play an unofficial .parlev level made by users, or if you want to upload your .parlev files to the public, make sure you check out our discord!

rows.name: Capella

This game is more like the beginning of a larger journey, a free test run, and the first of many adventures to come.
rows.description_html: Capella is a third-person action-adventure game that places you in the role of a skilled military operative assigned to multiple challenging tasks. Capella is the first step into an expanding universe filled with adventures, mysteries, and battles yet to come.

rows.name: WeilerVR PPE Trainer
rows.short_description: Step into a fully interactive VR locker room and master proper personal protective equipment procedures. Grab, equip, and prepare a mannequin with safety gear in a short but sweet training experience.
rows.description_html: WeilerVR: PPE Safety Trainer is a complete virtual reality training application centered on personal protective equipment (PPE) and workplace safety. Key Features   Full interactive training scenario – Learn correct PPE procedures in a realistic setting   Hands-on interaction – Grab, equip, and apply protective gear   Physics-based realism – Natural motion and tactile precision   Educational focus – Reinforces awareness and decision-making   Authentic environment – Modeled after real industrial locker rooms Step into a realistic locker room where your task is to prepare a mannequin with the correct protective gear and task-specific gear. The experience emphasizes accuracy, awareness, and safe preparation practices. Physics-based interaction and intuitive VR controls let users naturally engage with each item, reinforcing industrial safety standards. Developed for Weiler Abrasives, this standalone experience demonstrates how VR can enhance training, reduce risk, and reinforce safety culture.

rows.name: Good Morning My Darling
rows.short_description: Mailey wakes up and goes to make her morning tea. However, something strange is going on inside her house, and her housemate Derthan is nowhere to be seen. Perhaps, the answer lies somewhere in her memories?
rows.description_html: Description: In this game, you play as Mailey, who is looking to prepare herself some morning tea while waiting for her housemate, Derthan, to return. However, all the tea ingredients have gone missing, nothing is where is should be, and there are puzzles littered throughout the rooms. You will need to carefully inspect her house, look for clues as to where things might be hidden, and solve a variety of puzzles to progress through the game. As you make more progress, Mailey will start to remember some of her forgotten memories, and by interacting with them, you will be able to uncover even more. However, the memories that you will bear witness to may not be the happiest... Features: This game was created by one person, and features an original soundtrack. It contains a variety of different puzzles... And several interesting characters that you talk with and learn more about throughout the game's runtime. There are four different routes by which you can go through the game, affected by in-game choices. You can access a memory world which allows you to move further in the story! There are several different methods in which you can discover new memories, encouraging different approaches on subsequent playthroughs, and increasing replayability. There are many hours of gameplay ahead of you if you're aiming to complete multiple endings. This game contains a multitude of unique visuals, including... A menu visual that changes depending on which ending you got last. This game can be played entirely with just a mouse and keyboard. It contains 8 different endings... And 33 unlockable achievements!

rows.name: Shadow's Grove
rows.short_description: Step into the serene yet ever-shifting afterlife on a journey to reunite with your lost wolf companion. Explore surreal environments, solve thought-provoking puzzles, and navigate distorted enemies as you work through the tangled emotions of loss and moving forward.
rows.description_html: Shadow’s Grove is an emotionally-driven action adventure game following the journey of Astrid, a young spirit guide struggling to accept the loss of her lifelong companion, Eri. As she navigates the Valley of Souls, Eri’s fading presence becomes invaluable to her as the two rely on one another to uncover new paths and confront powerful spirits. But, the longer Astrid remains in the afterlife, the clearer the truth becomes to her and Eri: that moving forward may mean letting go. In this journey, you’ll guide Astrid through a world brimming with heart and mystery, uncovering the true nature of the afterlife while forging an unbreakable bond with Eri. Traverse a range of hand-crafted, otherworldly environments while carefully shifting between human and wolf form Solve environmental puzzles to forge a path through the malleable fabric of the afterlife Vanquish corrupted spirits using the collaborative power of Astrid’s magic and Eri’s strength I mmerse yourself in the rich, emotional soundtrack that deepens the narrative of loss, connection, and discovery This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Before I Come In
rows.short_description: A visual novel/block-breaker hybrid. Make choices that shape the story and stats, which affect your projectile strength in the block-breaking mini-game. Follow a young man's journey of growth and sexual self-discovery. 2-4 hours of playtime.
rows.description_html: Before I Come In is a narrative-driven interactive storytelling game that blends emotional depth with social impact. Players will embark on two very different journeys, each offering meaningful choices, branching paths, and unique outcomes: • Dennis’ Story Follow Dennis on his path of growth, navigating relationships and personal challenges. Players make impactful decisions and collect six symbolic gems, each unlocking new insights and serving as keys to advance the story. • Tyler’s Story Based on the real-life story of Tyler Clementi, a young Rutgers student whose tragic death brought national attention to issues of privacy, bullying, and LGBTQ+ acceptance. This storyline invites players to step into a powerful narrative where every decision underscores the importance of empathy and courage. Created in collaboration with the Tyler Clementi Foundation, a portion of proceeds will be donated to support their anti-bullying and LGBTQ+ youth empowerment initiatives. Core Features • Interactive storytelling with branching narratives and multiple endings. • Choice-driven gameplay: Your decisions directly shape each character’s journey. • Unique character growth system through symbolic gem collection. • Authentic emotional soundtrack, including recordings of Tyler Clementi’s violin performance, bringing his presence into the experience. • Estimated playtime: 1–2 hours per storyline, designed for replayability. • Social impact focus: A portion of proceeds supports real-world advocacy. This is more than a game — it’s an interactive experience where your choices carry weight, and your presence helps keep Tyler’s memory alive.

rows.name: Hydrodynamics of Hope & Optimism
rows.short_description: Is the glass half-full or half-empty? What does you answer say about you? Explore your outlook on life by filling glasses with your friend Tea-Total in Hydrodynamics of Hope & Optimism (in short, H2O). But are you ready to hear those answers? Are you reeeeeeeeeally sure?
rows.description_html: Self-Delusion – A Modern Plague Are you happy in life? Do you sometimes feel dehydrated? Is the glass half-full or half-empty? Are you prone to self-delusion?   Hmm… I see. You are declared the target audience for Hydrodynamics of Hope & Optimism - in short, H2O!   On the topic of water Do not fret, self-delusion is not an incurable condition! One of the best solutions to prevent self-delusion is drinking water! It is extremely important to stay hydrated during your day, as a lack of water could lead to several conditions, such as headaches, stomach-aches, headaches, syphilis, headaches, cancer, headaches, job-loss, and many other problems including headaches. To further illustrate the importance of water, please note that you are composed of approximately 60% of water (70% if you’re a child). Some parts of your body have an even higher percentage of water: your brain, for example, is composed of almost 90% of water (source: me). If it helps, you can therefore see your brain as a jellyfish. With eyes. Yes, I know it doesn’t help. But now, how do you know if you’re self-delusional?   Hydrodynamics of Hope & Optimism Discover the shameful fallacies of your brain by using Hydrodynamics of Hope & Optimism -in short, H2O! With this software, you can be declared sane. Officially sane. How does it work? You will be asked to fill a series of glass halfway. Of course, you will probably fill them a little too much, or a little not enough. Our counselor, TeaTotal, will analyse your glass-filling trends, and then assess your mental state to see if you are sane or self-delusional. No refunds. Do not fear, happiness is within your grasp! Stay hydrated!   What this game features Wait. Is this actually a game? Yes. No. Who cares? If you actually care, the only element of answer the team shall provide is the definition given by Salem, K. and Zimmerman, E. in their 2003 book  Rules of Play: Game Design Fundamentals: ' a game is a system in which players engage in an artificial conflict, defined by rules, that results in a quantifiable outcome.' Now then, the artificial conflict here is the 25 or so glasses to fill  and 20 questions to answer leading you to a quantifiable outcome of  questioning your life choices , although existential doubt should emerge around the 15th glass. And at the end, you get a nice final Hope & Optimism score because god knows ya’ll gamers need a satisfying conclusion. Of course, for the sake of achievement-addicted Steam players, this game features 17 achievements for increased replayability value (wink wink, nudge nudge).   Won't somebody please think of the gameplay? Oh, right. Well, you will use a whopping FOUR buttons  to play this game! Hold space to fill the glasses, only to release it when you think you've reached the halfway point. Press left  or right  when choosing an answer to declare which glass you shall fill. Press enter  to advance in the therapy ( i.e. the dialogues). Technically, you can also use escape to quit the game, but we don't think it counts.

rows.name: Thirty Seconds: Slain At Home
rows.short_description: Thirty Seconds: Slain At Home is a first-person simulator where you only have two things to do: interact with things and hide. You can interact with the furniture, the train set, and the door to help conclude your story. Hide once you make your decision or leave the simulator anytime.
rows.description_html: Slain at Home is the first chapter of Thirty Seconds. It all started in a child's bedroom. When you interact with the door, that's when the story begins. It's up to you to determine how to conclude the story. In this game, you only have two options: interact and hide. Certain interactions will be guessed to reveal the alternate ending. Some of the choices you make can be good, and some can be bad.  Interact Train Set Door Bathroom/Bedroom Lights Bed Desk Tub Hide wardrobe under the bed closet  inside the tub

rows.name: Too Many Bots
rows.short_description: TOO MANY BOTS is a first-person action arcade. Dive into brutal, retro-PS1 mazes, alternate between prey and hunter, face endless bot swarms, collect temporary power-ups, and adapt to ever-changing rules. Every run ramps up difficulty, testing your reflexes and strategy.
rows.description_html: TOO MANY BOTS is a first-person action arcade built on a relentless hunt-or-be-hunted loop, a twisted test of survival inside retro-styled mazes. Before each run, choose a map and enter the experiment. Rules twist, roles flip, and the bots never stop. You’re prey one moment, hunter the next, caught in an endless cycle where adaptation is your only weapon. Every completed run increases the game difficulty, so mastering the mechanics is key to survival. Features Pure skill challenge with no metaprogression, only your ability to adapt and improve. Unlock new game modes, each with unique rules and objectives that rewrite how you play. Cycle endlessly between prey and hunter as the power balance shifts. Explore retro-PS1 maps, each with its own atmosphere and hidden pulse Survive endless swarms of bots, always there, always looming. Collect temporary power-ups to boost your survival just a little longer. Every run ramps up the difficulty, pushing your reflexes to the limit. In Too Many Bots , you're on your own. Every mode is a puzzle where you must find the winning strategy under pressure. Adapt. Survive. Repeat.

rows.name: Beer Machine
rows.short_description: Your father needs a beer, and it's your job to get it. He doesn't care what it takes, so do what you must. Be quick though - it's not so safe in the dark.
rows.description_html: Your father needs a beer, and it's your job to get it.   You’re just a kid, but you have work to do. Search across your house, neighborhood, and mind to find what your father needs, and bring it back to him. Be quick though, it isn't safe for children to be alone. Watch out for yourself. No one else will do it for you. Beer Machine tells the story of a child and his abusive father. Jump into the child’s mind and see how it came to be this way, and do what you can to help your father. Beer Machine is a story-driven walking sim with mature and horror elements. You will be searching for objects and completing small activities as you play through the narrative.

rows.name: TEMPUS: A Wizard Awakes
rows.short_description: Lead the critters home as a retired Wizard, a caretaker of the world in this charming student project that takes you across floating islands and magical puzzles. Harness the energy of nature to fuel helpful spells. But beware, nature might fight back.
rows.description_html: A Wizard alone in a shattered world Journey across Tempus, a world of floating islands flora and fauna. You are a lonely wizard, once a caretaker of the temporal flows, now retired and hoping for the world to return to what it once was. With no purpose left a call to action comes from a small rock critter, crying for help as it finds itself far from home and lost in the wilderness. Use your magic to guide the critter and it's family home while you traverse hostile terrain, solve puzzles, fight vegetative enemies and find secrets in this charming student-made action adventure game. And if you don't want to save the critters... There's always the alternative.. Magic In the world of Tempus, magic is not free. Every action has consequence and as such you must be careful when harnessing the energy of your surroundings to fuel spellcasting. Carelessness will limit your options and you may just find yourself in a pickle. On the flipside, move  without haste and the friends you make along the way might lend you a hand or crystal to aid your spell slinging adventure. A Reactive world With only a simple projectile TEMPUS aims to provide some engaging moments and fun interactions through handcrafted challenges, puzzles and environments. Take your time to explore a small world and journey through the clouds. Blast a companion, hug a 'friend', the world will carry on without you in the end. Secrets While the main story is short, we've made sure to include several achievements and secrets for curious players to find and hopefully enjoy, give it a whirl if you dare, take a leap of faith and don't trust a flower by it's petals. Thank you for playing!

rows.name: Cardinal Fall
rows.short_description: Cardinal Fall is a nonprofit, community-developed, story-driven, 3d side-view, survival-horror, single or co-op game set within an original far-future dystopian sci-fi universe where you play as a clone—known as an Echo, located in a research facility where catastrophic events are unfolding.
rows.description_html: Brought to you by Metahusk, this game is an educational Unreal Enigne project that is intended to help others learn how to develop games. If you're curious, give it a try. The game is more bug-free than a lot of commercial releases. But if you're expecting a similar experience to what you get from a paid game, this game may not be for you.  Note: This is an early release.  Networking and co-op are implemented, but this release only includes the introductory level where there is no co-op gameplay outside of finding each other through coordination and having the correct items. If you are looking for a co-op game to play with friends, check back in the future. Until then, we recommend playing the game by yourself . About the game: Cardinal Fall is a nonprofit, community-developed, story-driven, 3d side-view, single to four player multiplayer, survival-horror, co-op videogame set within an original far-future dystopian sci-fi universe. Set in the year 2742, you play as a clone—known as an Echo—located in a research facility where catastrophic events are unfolding. In the game, players will explore a series of sprawling locations while planning a way to escape their eventual fate. Having multiple outcomes, Cardinal Fall will test the player and their friends as they navigate, learn, and survive the hostile environment they find themselves trapped within. Shepherded by Metahusk, a US based IRS 501(c)(3) nonprofit, Cardinal Fall is a community project that is being developed for free by volunteers. This is an entirely donation driven game. If you like this project, you can donate by purchasing our Donation DLC on Steam or by visiting our website at more information. The game is currently in production. This is an early release that features the introductory level. If you are a developer and would like to contribute, we would love to hear from you. This side-scroller version is an early prototype of a larger first-person edition we plan to produce in the future. In the first-person release of the title, the focus will be placed on the immersion, horror, and atmospheric elements of the game.

rows.name: Kino
rows.short_description: Odesa, 1929. A woman wakes up. This will be her last morning. An all-powerful film camera forces her to watch her life again. Can she find what was missing? A very short choose-your-own-adventure based on Dziga Vertov's Man with a Movie Camera.
rows.description_html: In this very short visual novel, you wake up and get hit by a tram. After your untimely demise, an all-powerful film camera forces you to watch your life again. Can you find what was missing? A choose-your-own-adventure based on Dziga Vertov's 1929 masterpiece Man with a Movie Camera . Gameplay Get hit by a tram Reflect on your life and beyond Speak to a sentient film camera Reminisce about drinking beer in the afterlife Toggle music on/off Over 128 unique endings!

rows.name: You Were There -君はそこにいた-
rows.short_description: You wake up in a hallway that you've never seen before. When you stand up, you see a girl. When you try to ask her something, she runs off as if she's fleeing. You chase after the girl, and set off to unravel the mystery of this situation.
rows.description_html: You find yourself on the ground, losing your memory. When you wake up, you find yourself in a hallway that you've never seen before. It feels like you're in a dream. When you stand up, you see a girl. When you try to ask her something, she runs off as if she's fleeing. You chase after the girl, and set off to unravel the mystery of this situation. (It's a short game with a play time of about 2 hours) The actions of the main character 'boy' include running, walking, jumping, picking up items, crawling underwater, falling, and sometimes fighting. When I feel like I'm about to fall, I crawl back up. Passing through the gap... Maybe you can help the girl. Mysterious enemies attack... We decipher the present from various situations. What will be revealed in the end...? This action-adventure game lets you control the boy to improve his relationship with the girl, understand the current situation, and unravel the mystery of this situation.

rows.name: Fate of the Minotaur
rows.short_description: Within this narrative VR experience FATE OF THE MINOTAUR, players descend into the mythical labyrinth, learn about the Minotaur’s tragic story and confront him to escape.
rows.description_html: In FATE OF THE MINOTAUR you embody the role of a human sacrifice from Athens who is sent into the labyrinth designed by the architect Daedalus. It was commissioned by King Minos of Crete to contain the ferocious Minotaur. Throughout this 10-20 minute experience players will enter the labyrinth below King Minos palace navigate through it with an interactive torch to unveil the story gather insights into the ancient Greek myth by encountering key characters and narrating murals solve user-friendly puzzles decide the fate of the Minotaur in a final confrontation Play by navigating through the scenery and interacting with your controllers. We carefully minimized motion sickness through vignettes and seamless level transitions. A guiding thread will help you if you get lost. Development background information In a unique approach, this content can be experienced in different immersive scale options, depending on the technical and physical limitations of the location presenting the experience. From a technical perspective, a novel engine-agnostic and flexible open-source virtual production framework was used to realize the multiplayer network aspect of the game. This is the singleplayer only version. The 8x8m free-roaming or controller-based setup for up to 4 players is currently only to be played on-site at conferences/trade fairs. Our stylized visual approach is inspired by ancient Greek murals and vases, allowing us to provide the experience with a small footprint in energy consumption and required equipment.

rows.name: Tichupro by Spectrum
rows.short_description: Enjoy Tichupro, inspired by the famous strategic card game! Play with real users from around the world!
rows.description_html: Discover TichuPro, one of the most thrilling strategic card games in the world! Played by two teams of two players, each team competes to reach the required points, while bonus points are awarded to the team that gets rid of their cards first. Play the popular card game Tichu online! 🔥 Key Features: ✅ Online Multiplayer – Play with friends or challenge real players worldwide. ✅ Strategic Gameplay – Use smart tactics and teamwork to win. ✅ Special Cards – The four unique cards (Dragon, Phoenix, Dog, Mah Jong) add depth to your strategy. ✅ Fast & Dynamic Rounds – Enjoy quick-paced matches with an intuitive interface. ✅ Tournaments & Leaderboards – Compete in events and climb the rankings! ♠️ Join the TichuPro Community and play like a Pro! Are you ready to master Tichu? Download now and start playing! 📥 Play Tichu today and test your strategic skills! TichuPro by Spectrum is an independent online version of the classic Tichu game and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the creators or owners of the Tichu trademark.

rows.name: Gnomes on the Roam
rows.short_description: Fend off endless waves of increasingly difficult Gnome attackers that will stop at nothing to destroy humanity. Can you foil the Gnome plans and send them back to their dimension or will you shatter under the pressure?
rows.description_html: Gnomes on The Roam is set in a world where a race of interdimensional gnomes that feed off sunlight have come to our world seeking our sunlight whether we like it or not. Their world has become uninhabitable as the Gnomes have harnessed and taken all of the energy from their sun causing it to extinguish. In true gnome fashion they decided to use the remaining sun power they had to travel dimensions to ours, they may not have come in peace, but we will send them back in pieces. Gnomes on the Roam is an infinite horde survival game where you have to defend yourself against the gnome onslaught. Use Plants to help you along your quest and find a way to harness the power of the sun to send them back to where they came from. Key features: Infinite rounds - see how long you can survive against an endless swarm of gnomes that all want you dead. weapons - find an upgrade both a pistol and an assault rifle within the game to help arm yourself against the gnomes plants - Find and plant seeds around the map to create plants that will assist you in your mission  Easter egg - There is a secret way to win the game if you can harness the suns power, can you find it?

rows.name: Exit Dream
rows.short_description: A free short first-person horror game of dream puzzles - unsettling, surreal, and hauntingly atmospheric.
rows.description_html: Step into a series of surreal dreams where nothing behaves as expected. This short first-person horror game blends unsettling atmosphere with puzzle-like challenges, creating moments of confusion, tension, and discovery. Psychological Horror - Fear born in the mind. Dream Puzzles - Each dream presents a unique challenge with its own strange logic. Atmospheric & Surreal - Minimal UI, no dialogue, just raw immersion. Compact Experience - Designed to be finished in one sitting, but with difficulty that rewards persistence and experimentation. Explore, adapt, and escape the logic of dreams - if you can.

rows.name: Ephemeral Art: Shapeweaver
rows.short_description: Create, destroy, and discover. Ephemeral Art: Shapeweaver is a 2D digital playground where you can let your creativity run wild. Whether you're an aspiring artist or just looking for an art sandbox game, Shapeweaver offers a unique and engaging experience for everyone.
rows.description_html: Ephemeral Art: Shapeweaver is a unique art sandbox game where you create interactive artwork with shapes. It's designed for anyone curious to explore and play — no artistic skill required. With simple controls and endless possibilities, this 2D world of color, shapes, and motion is your personal creative playground. Your creations are temporary, destined to fade, giving you the freedom to experiment without limits. Unleash the artist within by crafting a relaxing visual spectacle, or embrace chaos — flinging shapes across the canvas and combining special effects for spectacular results. The choice is yours; there's no wrong way to play. A Universe of Customization at Your Fingertips Endless Shape Variations: Choose from a wide variety of shapes, including circles, squares, triangles, stars, hearts, and many more. Customize your shapes with a vast color palette, or let the game cycle through colors for a dynamic visual experience. Adjust the size, style, and weight of your shapes. Make them bold, outlined, or even dotted for a unique look. Apply different fill patterns and textures to give your creations a distinct personality. Over 30 Animated Backgrounds: Set the mood over 30 unique animated backgrounds to choose. Each background reacts to your clicks when placing shapes onto the canvas, creating a truly immersive experience. From tranquil starry nights to vibrant, pulsating nebulae, there's a background for every mood and style. Unleash Your Inner Artist with Powerful Tools: Grab Shape Tool: Take direct control of your creations! A simple click selects a shape, while a long press and drag allows you to select multiple shapes. Once selected, edit your shapes, move them to the perfect spot, or even fling them across the screen and watch them bounce off the canvas and other shapes. Undo and Redo: Experiment without fear! Instantly reverse any action with the Undo and Redo buttons, giving you the freedom to explore every creative possibility. Gravity and Physics: Bend the laws of physics to your will! Apply gravitational forces to your shapes and watch them interact in fascinating ways. Make them fall, orbit a central point, or float weightlessly in your digital canvas. Breakable Shapes: Introduce an element of controlled chaos with breakable shapes. Watch as your creations shatter into pieces upon impact. Fuse and Unfuse: Combine multiple shapes to create complex and intricate designs. The fuse tool allows you to merge shapes into a single, cohesive object, while the unfuse tool lets you break them apart again. Custom Animations: Control the lifecycle of your shapes with customizable Entry and Dissolve effects. Have shapes bounce, spiral, or construct themselves onto the canvas, and watch them fade, pixelate, or shatter into pieces when they disappear. Special Effects: Elevate your art with a plethora of special effects. Make your shapes glow with a neon aura, imbue them with elemental powers like fire and ice, or make them transparent for a ghostly effect. Tailor Your Creative Space: Flexible Interface: Make the game truly yours by customizing the user interface. Choose from a variety of themes, adjust text sizes and styles, and even change the position of the control panel to best suit your workflow. Resizable & Pinnable Windows: Adjust the size of settings windows to fit your needs, and pin them to the screen for easy access while you continue to create and edit shapes on the canvas. Sculpt Your Atmosphere: Full Edit Mode: Take your creativity to the next level with Full Edit Mode. This feature pauses all shape animations and movements, allowing you to fine-tune your creations with precision and ease. Canvas Settings: Perfect your masterpiece with a range of canvas settings. Apply special filters for extra visual flair, add a blurred background to make your shapes pop, and adjust the scene lighting to create the perfect atmosphere. With HDR support, the vibrant colors of your shapes and the dynamic animated backgrounds will truly pop, creating a stunning visual experience. Personalize Your Experience: Favorite Your Settings: With so many customization options, you're bound to find your perfect setup. Favorite your most-used settings for quick and easy access in any creative session. Curate Your Soundtrack: Love a particular song? Add it to your favorites list to create a personalized playlist that perfectly matches your artistic vibe. Steam Cloud Support : Your personalized game settings are saved to the Steam Cloud, so you can pick up right where you left off on any computer. Capture Your Masterpiece: Photo Mode: Become the director of your own digital gallery. Freeze the action to compose the perfect shot, and independently manipulate background and shape movements to align effects precisely how you want them — even while time is paused. Professional Composition: Use the Zoom and Pan tools to frame your art perfectly. Choose from stylish Canvas Frames like Classic Gold, Neon Cyber, or Rustic Wood to give your screenshot a polished, professional look. Visual Filters: Transform the mood instantly with artistic Canvas Filters (Sepia, Vignette, etc.) or inject a dose of nostalgia with retro Screen Filters like CRT Scanlines, Dot Matrix, and Pixelate. High-Fidelity Exports: Photo Mode automatically shifts the game into Quality Mode, ensuring every screenshot is captured with maximum particle counts and the sharpest resolution possible. Game Modes for Every Playstyle Regular Mode: Challenge yourself against the clock in this classic mode. Create as much as you can before time runs out and your masterpiece begins to dissolve. Creative Mode: Unleash your creativity without any time pressure. This mode is a pure sandbox where you can experiment, explore, and create to your heart's content. More Than a Game Screensaver Mode: Activate Screensaver Mode to sit back, relax, and enjoy a seamless, ever-changing showcase of the game's animated backgrounds with multiple timer options. Or you can interact with the animated backgrounds by clicking on them for the full Screensaver Mode experience. Features Intuitive and easy-to-learn interface. Two distinct game modes to suit your playstyle. A chill collection of music to accompany your creative journey. A vast array of shapes, colors, and customization options. Over 30 unique animated backgrounds. Powerful tools including Grab Shape, Undo/Redo, gravity settings, breakable shapes, and shape fusion. A dedicated 'Full Edit Mode' for complete control over your creations. Photo Mode gives you a comprehensive suite for capturing high-quality screenshots with zoom, frames, and filters. Customizable Entry and Dissolve animations for your shapes. A wide variety of special shape effects to make your creations pop. Fully customizable user interface, including themes, text styles, window management, and layout options. Various canvas settings like special filters, blurred backgrounds, and scene lighting. HDR support for stunning, vibrant visuals. Steam Cloud support ensures your game settings are always saved and available. Favoriting system for quick access to your preferred settings and songs. Screensaver Mode allows you to enjoy the animated backgrounds with ease. Whether you want to create a breathtaking work of 2D art with shapes or just have fun playing with physics, colors, and animated backgrounds, Ephemeral Art: Shapeweaver is the perfect digital canvas for you. Get ready to shape your imagination!

rows.name: HERE - Immersive Music Theater
rows.short_description: Step into the future of immersive storytelling with HERE, a groundbreaking app for PCVR that brings music theatre into your home.
rows.description_html: Created by Michel van der Aa Award-winning composer and director Michel van der Aa brings his passion for innovative narrative forms to the digital realm. HERE offers a unique blend of cinema and interactive performance. Users can shape the narrative, creating a personalized experience that explores the boundaries of reality and identity. This launch comes fresh off Michel van der Aa's win for Best Immersive Work at Cannes International Film Festival 2025 for his latest VR creation 'From Dust.' HERE makes cutting-edge music theater accessible to a diverse audience, including those who might not typically attend traditional venues. Using VR on your PC, this app offers a fresh way to engage with contemporary performance, bridging the gap between creator and audience in the comfort of your own space. Step into a virtual grand theater and be captivated by Julia Bullock's stunning aria from the acclaimed film opera 'Upload.' Immerse yourself in 'Eight,' the groundbreaking VR opera installation that has wowed audiences at festivals around the world, soon available in your living room. Explore 'The Book of Sand,' a VR adaptation of Jorge Luis Borges' novel that pushes the boundaries of digital storytelling. And that's just the beginning... HERE is produced by the doubleA foundation with support from DigitALL and Fonds Podiumkunsten.

rows.name: World War Chess
rows.short_description: This is 1000+ player chess! You are in a war, where every player matters and contributes! Your king is no longer the center of the world, but rather your Commander's king, a bossfight piece, is the new captain, and must be protected at all costs. Can you carry your comrades to victory?
rows.description_html: What is it? World War Chess is the first ever chess variant to feature a battle royale style of gameplay, with no limit to how many people can join! Content *Many different maps *Many different enemies controlled by unique AI *Battle against Bosses, and endless waves of enemies *Many other weird and interesting features like Conways Game of Life as an enemy Extra In case you are new to chess, there is a tutorial, and an easy-to-understand highlighting system to guide you as to where you can move.

rows.name: atomica
rows.short_description: Atomica is a 3D exploration game where you walk across the surfaces of proteins, discover ligands, and experience the nanoscale world as an immersive landscape.
rows.description_html: Atomica is an immersive 3D exploration game that shrinks you down to the nanoscale and places you directly on the surfaces of proteins. Walk across vast molecular landscapes, climb over ridges, descend into grooves, and discover ligands as if they were hidden landmarks in a strange new world. Atomica blends science and adventure, turning the invisible world of biology into a place you can truly explore. Key Features Explore proteins in 3D – Wander across realistic molecular surfaces built from actual scientific data. Discover ligands – Find small molecules nestled in binding sites and learn their biological role. Immersive scale – Experience what it feels like to stand on the nanoscale architecture of life. Simple controls – Walk, look, and interact using only a game controller. Relaxing gameplay – No combat, timers, or stress; just exploration and discovery. Educational and fun – Perfect for players curious about science, students, or anyone who enjoys walking simulators with a twist. Why Play Atomica? If you’ve ever wondered what it would be like to step inside the microscopic world, Atomica lets you do just that. It’s a calm, surreal experience that blends gaming with science, offering a new perspective on the building blocks of life.

rows.name: Heartopia
rows.short_description: Welcome to Heartopia, a multiplayer life simulation game crafted for creativity, freedom, and peace. Build your dream home, explore a wide range of hobbies, and forge warm connections with friends in a town full of endless possibilities.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Heartopia, a multiplayer life simulation game crafted for creativity, freedom, and peace. Build your dream home, explore a wide range of hobbies, and forge warm connections with friends in a town full of endless possibilities. [Game Features] ◆ Let's Connect! Create Unique Memories Chat with the charming residents of Heartopia Town, hang out with old friends, and meet new friends every time you log in! ◆ Let's Explore! Gardening, Fishing, Birding... Hobbies are yours to enjoy, not chores. In Heartopia, feel free to develop six major hobbies, including fishing, cooking, gardening, birdwatching, and more. ◆ Let's Build! You can also invite your friends over and build your dream home together. ◆ Let's Dress Up! 1000+ Daily Outfits Mix and match casual wear, elegant gowns, and whimsical costumes to create the perfect look for any occasion. Express your mood and show the world who you are. ◆ Let's Pet! Adopt Cats and Dogs Meet your very own animal companions in Heartopia! While each of your furry friends may come with different colors and personalities, they can all bring you warmth and comfort. rows.name: Spray N' Pray
rows.short_description: Spray N' Pray is a fast-paced boomer shooter where you play as Justinian, a priest armed with dual revolvers. Dash, run, and jump through a demon-infested cathedral, vanquishing hellspawn and fallen angels to earn your righteous place in heaven.
rows.description_html: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. Spray N' Pray is a fast-paced first-person boomer shooter where you play as Justinian, a priest chosen by God to purge the Earth of demons, hellspawn, and fallen angels. The cathedral is overrun, and only your faith, speed, and firepower can cleanse it. Armed with your signature dual revolvers, you’ll unleash a storm of righteous bullets while mastering smooth movement; dash, run, and melee-strikes that close the distance between you and your enemies. Unleash your ultimate power by merging your revolvers into one divine weapon, unleashing a blistering hail of bullets. And when demons close the gap, crush them with a brutal melee strike to break their ranks. With every kill, you climb closer to your holy reckoning.

rows.name: Sprite's City Scramble
rows.short_description: A 3D puzzle-platformer where you play as Sprite, an alien parasite who can possess creatures with unique abilities. Explore, solve puzzles, and collect everyday artifacts to understand our world and find your way home.
rows.description_html: Sprite's City Scramble is a 3D exploration-based puzzle platformer revolving around Sprite, an alien parasite who has come to our world to learn more about its inhabitants. As Sprite, you can take over different creatures that each have unique abilities which assist in exploring your environment, solving interactive puzzles and collecting “artifacts” which are random everyday items that, to Sprite, are invaluable sources of knowledge. Use all resources available to progress through various challenges so you can eventually return home with your newfound understanding of this strange and interesting planet. A game-jam game made by: Ewan Burkinshaw Henry Bunn Joshua Mahil Killian Khada Max Senior Ricco Vergara Robin Crews

rows.name: TERPENIE
rows.short_description: In the gloomy atmosphere of post-Soviet everyday life, routine tasks like cleaning, cooking, and exploring your own room hide something much darker. Survive and uncover the truth before the maniac comes for you.
rows.description_html: After a long day at work, you return home. Everything seems ordinary: preparing dinner, tidying up, and trying to put your life in order. But as night falls, the mundane becomes a fragile illusion. Someone is watching you. Someone is hunting you. In this game, you will explore the confines of your room while uncovering a terrifying truth. Balance the normality of everyday chores with a growing sense of dread, because the maniac may strike when you least expect it. Set against the backdrop of a post-Soviet setting, this game captures the haunting feeling of domestic horror and paranoia — the fear of being trapped with nowhere to run, even inside the walls of your own home. Can you keep your sanity and survive before the darkness takes over? Key Features Domestic Horror – a unique atmosphere inspired by life in the post-Soviet era. Routine Meets Fear – cook meals, clean your room, and explore while being watched. Unpredictable Threat – the maniac can appear at any moment, when you least expect it. Gritty Visual Style – a bleak, realistic environment of an old apartment. Psychological Tension – fear builds gradually, relying on atmosphere rather than cheap jump scares.

rows.name: Duelyst: Blitz
rows.short_description: Lightning-fast reimagining of the beloved tactical card battler Duelyst, designed for intense, strategic matches you can finish in just a few minutes. Engage in dynamic, turn-based duels where every move matters.
rows.description_html: ⚡ Duelyst: Blitz is a lightning-fast reimagining of the beloved tactical card battler Duelyst. Engage in dynamic, turn-based duels where every move matters. With a streamlined 6-mana cap and a consistent 2-card draw each turn, Duelyst: Blitz delivers tight, decision-rich gameplay that rewards smart plays and bold tactics. Build your deck from a diverse roster of powerful units and spells, each brought to life with stunning hand-animated pixel art . Position your forces on the battlefield, outthink your opponent, and strike with perfect precision. Whether you’re a returning Duelyst veteran or a newcomer to tactical card games, Blitz offers the perfect mix of accessibility and depth. ⚡ First truly  cross-platform  version of Duelyst. 📱  iOS, Android and Steam releases 🍎 🤖 improved client performance 🏃‍♀️ touch (swipe) gestures support ☝️ 6 max mana, 60 seconds per turn ⏳ based on early Duelyst mechanics - 2 draw, no Bloodbound Spell 🧙 all profit from Orb purchases goes back into advertising budget (ads, influencer marketing, prized tournaments) 💸
