rows.name: WAVEBEAM
rows.short_description: 2-4 local players navigate the darkness while battling one another to be the last ship left. Fire your BEAM to destroy other ships and stay hidden while navigating the arena. Your PING not only reflects enemy BEAMs, but also reveals your surroundings and your location to everyone, so use it wisely!
rows.description_html: In WAVEBEAM , 2-4 local players navigate the darkness while battling one another to be the last ship left. Fire your BEAM to destroy other ships and stay hidden while navigating the arena. Your PING not only reflects enemy BEAMs, but also reveals your surroundings and your location to everyone, so use it wisely! A Note from the Designer: The concept behind this game was developed by myself and a few others during the 2017 Global Game Jam. Eight years later, I wanted to experiment with modern AI coding tools to assess their capability and limitations. I spent about an hour distilling the game's concept and writing a comprehensive game design document that aligned with my own vision, then I provided an AI coding agent with the design doc. Although it missed the mark in a few areas initially, the agent started out with something surprisingly playable that roughly reflected the design. After about 10 hours of additional tweaks, additions, and iterations, I ended up something that I was happy to share with the public - all without writing a single line of code. The product of this experiment was well worth the time and money put into it, and while I could have developed this game entirely myself as a Software Engineer, I chose to do so with the use of AI and thus can't justify charging anyone for it. HOWEVER - if you want to invest in the ongoing development of this game, I'll gladly accept donations via an upcoming 'Dev Support DLC', or you can donate via Venmo (@RyanCollins86) or reach out to me directly via . I'll be sharing a roadmap in the Discord where you can also chat with other players, report bugs, and provide suggestions new features for the roadmap.

rows.name: Sweet Dreams
rows.short_description: Sweet Dreams is a single player 2d Platformer starring 'Dream Boy', a kid Super Hero trapped in a dream world filled with sweets and candy.  Help 'Dream Boy' make it out of the Dream World and back to the real world.
rows.description_html: Get ready for the adventure of a lifetime when you join Dream Boy to help escape this Dream Land filled with Bad Sweets in this Sci-Fi 2d side scroller game. Shoot lasers and stomp the enemies on your way back to the real world. Collect all the sweets you can and beat the highest scores around. Collect Power Cells along the way and Transform into ' Mega Dream Boy ' to have unstoppable fun. Let's see if you have what it takes to defeat the Evil Boss! You're bound to have a blast when you Smash through the Sweet Baddies in SWEET DREAMS!!

rows.name: o_Ossel´s Odyssey
rows.short_description: Ossel’s Odyssey is a quirky 2.5D side-scrolling platformer in the spirit of classic Rayman-style games, but with its own absurd, dry sense of humor. Originally created by Oliver Stephan (creaturelab3d), it blends nostalgic gameplay with oddball surprises.
rows.description_html: Ossel’s Odyssey is a quirky 2.5D side-scrolling platformer in the spirit of classic Rayman-style games, but with its own absurd, dry sense of humor. Originally created by Oliver Stephan (creaturelab3d), it blends nostalgic gameplay with oddball surprises. Players can discover strange graffiti, unlock hidden music tracks, and stumble across unexpected moments that might just make you blow air through your nose. Whether you’re chasing high scores or simply exploring, the world is packed with subtle jokes and little mysteries. By Oliver Stephan creaturelab3d and Juri Knauth, past members, Carla Heinzel.  Optimized for X-Box controller. To make the X-Box controller work, please follow this:  In Steam: right-click your game → Properties → Controller → “Override for o_Ossel´s Odyssey” → Disable Steam Input.

rows.name: Havok Balloons Tech Showcase
rows.short_description: Havok usually works behind the scenes helping to power your favourite AAA games, but this tech showcase proved too popular to keep to industry only meetings.
rows.description_html: Havok usually works behind the scenes helping to power your favourite AAA games.   This year we marked the 25th anniversary of Havok Physics. And we celebrated the usual way… by creating a new tech showcase!   Thanks to Havok Physics for Unreal we were able to make a great-looking level that showcases the power of Havok Physics running in the Unreal Engine.   This showcase proved so popular at our industry meetings that we decided it should have a wider audience. We hope you enjoy the balloon-filled physics playground!   Professional developers can find out more on our website including details on all Havok products and how to start an evaluation. We have a range of flexible pricing plans for professional projects of different sizes.

rows.name: Slime Saga
rows.short_description: Train slimes, make friends, and get set for adventure! It's time to pick up your slime catcher and become the latest and greatest tamer!
rows.description_html: Slime Saga is a free-to-play third-person story-driven monster taming game, but instead of taming your monsters, you create them! Using slime, you as the next best up-and-coming tamer must make your monster, and put them to battle against the slime monsters of the wilderness. Travel through the many winding paths of the Rolling Hills, the Wild Canyon, the Mystic Caves and beyond with your friend Jasper as you meet other slime tamers to aid and befriend along the way. Discover more than 60 slime monsters of all shapes and sizes as you explore the wilderness, with more upcoming monsters and levels on the way in future updates! Train slimes, make friends, and get set for adventure! You can play solo through the main story or enjoy playing with friends in online co-op! It's time to pick up your slime catcher and become the latest and greatest tamer! Create your Own Slime Tamer Create and customize your very own tamer with a variety of clothing and hairstyles to choose from! Earn coins through exploration and battles to purchase new looks for your character. Collect a Wide Variety of Slimes for Battle There are dozens of unique slime monsters to meet in the world of Slime Saga. Battling with wild slimes gives you a chance to earn their shapestones, which can be used to create your very own monsters. Mix and match slime cores to create the ultimate slimes for battle in a complex element-based system. High Octane Real Time Combat Take control of your slimes in battle where you can lock in to enemies, guard and interrupt attacks. Use a plethora of skills that your slime can learn through the lab to get the upper hand in battle, as well as making use of inventory items and special attacks in a clutch. Story-based Branching Dialogue and Relationship System Enjoy a story told through multiple cutscenes that introduce many colorful characters throughout the world of Slime Saga! Cutscenes offer players branching dialogue choices that affect relationships with these characters. Online Multiplayer Mode Slime Saga can be played alone or online with other players in the online mode. Interact with other players in the city hub using the chat features, or go explore the various field areas and battle with friends. In the stadium, players can engage in battles with other players! Furnish your Own Place (Coming soon!) Customize your own space with furnishings of your choice! Find a style that fits you and make the pad of your dreams with all kinds of furniture and color options.

rows.name: Tiempo
rows.short_description: Climb a towering clockwork spire in this 3D platformer. Use time-pausing and rewinding powers to overcome traps, puzzles, and enemies as you race to stop your rival from freezing time forever.
rows.description_html: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. Tiempo is a 3D platformer where every step brings you closer to stopping your rival’s plan to freeze time forever. Use your unique time powers; pause to halt traps mid-motion, rewind to undo mistakes, and manipulate mechanisms like moving platforms to solve puzzles and outmaneuver enemies. With every floor of the tower, new challenges emerge: shifting hazards, cunning foes, and clever contraptions designed to block your ascent. Only by mastering your control over time can you reach the top and restore the flow of the world.
rows.about_html: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. Tiempo is a 3D platformer where every step brings you closer to stopping your rival’s plan to freeze time forever. Use your unique time powers; pause to halt traps mid-motion, rewind to undo mistakes, and manipulate mechanisms like moving platforms to solve puzzles and outmaneuver enemies. With every floor of the tower, new challenges emerge: shifting hazards, cunning foes, and clever contraptions designed to block your ascent. Only by mastering your control over time can you reach the top and restore the flow of the world.

rows.description_html: Climb, leap, and persevere. Step into the shoes of May on a journey to conquer the peak of a mysterious mountain. This pixel-art adventure combines precision platforming with fluid parkour-inspired movement, challenging your reflexes while surrounding you with charming environments. Every step upward brings new trials—perilous gaps, shifting ledges, and obstacles that demand patience and skill. At its heart, this is a game about determination. No enemies, no combat—just you, the mountain, and the will to keep climbing. Features: • cool movement • cool pixel art • dog It's a short game for a cozy evening Hope you enjoy!

rows.name: emerald
rows.short_description: what do you fear?
rows.description_html: It drags down on you... It's been so long since you've last been with her, seen her... Something inside of you eats at you. The world around you is bleak and dark, but the thought of meeting her once again keeps you going.  Follow the short linear story as you fight with your own mind, your fears and worries taken form, as you search for the part of yourself you've lost. This short adventure serves as a companion piece to vai5000 and maji*'s 2025 track of the same name, emerald , and expands on the story of the song. It builds on vai5000's prior release of oath , acting as a smaller self contained experience in the same vein. Features: A mostly linear narrative: Explore a small top-down RPG world as you progress through the story of emerald , talking to mysterious characters along the way and fighting off Wraiths originating from your own mind. The main game will take you around 2 hours to complete, longer if you aim for all achievements - but you're free to sprint to the end too! Multiple unique encounters: Each battle is with a unique Wraith with properties and strategies specific to it - each battle a representation of that Wraiths personality and how it relates to your own feelings. Who you decide to take on might even determine how your story plays out in the end... Hand-drawn art and animation: A combination of custom pixel art and hand drawn designs shape the world of emerald , including segments of bespoke animation work and effects by vai5000, building on top of the style of the previous game, oath - now expanded with more animation work than ever before. . One story, multiple outcomes While the story of emerald  is a linear adventure, taking place across a singular day, depending on what you discover and what you choose to do, your ending may change...  Please note: as a free experience, 'emerald' is intentionally not as expansive as 'oath', and a decent bit shorter. If you would like to play a longer and more fleshed out story, check out 'oath'!

rows.name: Not My War
rows.short_description: Explore, survive, escape as a resourceful ferret on a deadly island where robots patrol and time runs out. This 3D perspective-isometric stealth game blends infiltration, scavenging, aiding survivors, and racing against the clock in a war that was never yours.
rows.description_html: The island remembers the war. Abandoned trenches. Ruined depots. The skeletal remains of humanity's last stand against the machines they created. Now, only the robots remain, patrolling endlessly through the wasteland. And you—a clever ferret, an experiment designed for a war you never chose—must escape before time runs out. Not My War is a 3D top-down stealth and exploration game where tension never fades. The machines don't sleep. The clock doesn't stop. Stealth Navigate deadly patrols using wits and gadgets . Blind sensors with flashlight bursts. Obscure vision with smoke. Create distractions with thrown objects. Hide in burrows when all else fails. Every encounter is a puzzle of sight lines, sound, and split-second decisions . Day-Night Cycle Time is your greatest enemy. The day-night cycle changes patrols and danger levels , forcing you to adapt your strategy. At night, visibility decreases and threats intensify as the clock ticks toward your deadline. Exploration and Narrative The island is littered with debris from the war. Search ruins for boat parts, gadgets, and resources. Find other survivors—forgotten experiments like you—and learn their stories through dialogue and environmental storytelling . Explore abandoned military installations to piece together how humanity fell and why you were left behind. Scavenging and Survival Every item scavenged brings escape closer, but navigating this desolate land while avoiding patrols is treacherous. Aid them with what they need. This war was never yours. But freedom is . Made by 24-Pack Studios, in U-tad, University of Technology, Arts and Design.

rows.name: Cat Puzzle
rows.short_description: Rescue as many cats as you can within the time limit! Combine puzzle and roguelike elements to achieve the highest score possible.
rows.description_html: A troupe of wandering cats performing across the world. But a witch, who disliked the sound of their performances,  cast a curse on them... Save the cats who have turned into blocks because of the witch’s curse! A puzzle game where you match three cat blocks to rescue the cats trapped inside the blocks. Controls Fire cats with the Z key Switch position before firing with the X key Fire special cats with the Spacebar Retrieve and relaunch dropped cats with the C key Game Objective Match 3 or more cats to level up and strengthen cat blocks. With stronger cat blocks, aim for the highest score within 600 seconds! Shop When all cats are upgraded, you can enter the shop upon leveling up. In the shop, you can purchase time, score boosts, or further enhance the equipment of normal cats. Synchro When certain conditions are met, additional effects will appear. Match the right combinations to achieve higher scores. When There’s No Place to Put Cats If you stack blocks incorrectly and have no space to place cats, press R to clear the cats on the map. (However, some score and time will be deducted.)

rows.name: Monster Lab Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Monster Lab Simulator is a creature collector where you create, raise, and battle monsters in your own lab. Synthesize essences, hatch eggs, expand your collection, and build the ultimate team!
rows.description_html: In this prologue, you step into Monster Lab Simulator: Prologue – experience the first steps of becoming the ultimate monster creator and battle master! Discover the thrill of synthesizing mysterious essences, hatching rare eggs, and expanding your lab in this limited free version. Buy mysterious essences to hatch unique Fulus from fragile eggs. Every experiment is a chance to create something new. Discover hidden recipes by combining different essences. Unlock surprise creatures and expand your growing collection. Enter turn-based battles in the station. Compete in tournaments for big rewards or test your team in free matches. Orb your creatures to keep them forever in your permanent collection. Store their stats and create powerful combinations. Sell your stored orbs for profit and invest in powerful new machines. Expand your lab, speed up production, and unlock stronger creations. Combine three Fulus into one evolved form with the merge machine. Unlock stronger abilities, higher essence yield, and powerful new battle options. Keep your playful Fulus out of trouble, look after them when they get mischievous, and make sure your lab stays a place where creatures feel happy and healthy. Monster Lab Simulator delivers the thrill of synthesis and battle, the joy of collection, and the magic of uncovering the unknown all inside your very own monster lab.

Every vase, every book, every seemingly ordinary item hides secrets that may reveal the path to your freedom. WRONG WAY is not just a game – it’s a psychological experience where every decision matters: DEEP EXPLORATION Investigate over 20 types of interactive objects Discover hidden notes that gradually unveil the story Solve complex puzzles using logic and keen observation INGENIOUS PUZZLES Keypad systems with encrypted codes Combine objects to unlock new areas Each room conceals clues leading to the next one PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR Constant tension without cheap jump scares Oppressive atmosphere built through subtle details A story that unfolds gradually through the environment

rows.name: Unknown Fluffy Object
rows.short_description: Play as Buddy the sheepdog in this 3rd-person puzzle game. Herd sheep across rivers, cliffs, and rolling hills of Scotland while fending off mischievous UFOs with your mighty super bark.
rows.description_html: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. In Unknown Fluffy Object, you play as Buddy, a loyal sheepdog tasked with rescuing your flock from mysterious UFOs haunting the Scottish hills. Each sheep has wandered far and wide, and it’s up to you to guide them home safely. Use Buddy’s movement and powerful bark to overcome natural obstacles and outwit alien patrols. Herd your sheep across rushing rivers, along narrow cliff paths, and through fields buzzing with UFO activity. Every level challenges your puzzle-solving skills, reflexes, and strategy as you balance protecting your flock with keeping them moving forward. Will you outsmart the UFOs’ baa-d schemes and bring every last sheep back to the pasture?

rows.name: Shibuya Bullet
rows.short_description: Infinite bullet patterns?! A fresh take on bullet hell—fused with live-action footage and color-based mechanics!
rows.description_html: - How to Play This game cannot be played on its own. To play, open a live video (e.g. YouTube) on the left half of your monitor, and run this game on the right half. Align the frames carefully, then control Shibumaru using the WASD keys or your mouse. You can find the live video on the Steam forums. Where is everyone hanging out? - Story One day, a baby alien named Shibumaru crash-landed in the middle of Shibuya Scramble Crossing—one of the most famous intersections in the world. Shibumaru is terrified of humans. Your mission is to guide him to a safe place—away from humans. - Behavior Not much is known about Shibumaru’s biology. He loves mouse cursors, and for some reason, he’s not afraid of white or gray humans. Maybe they resemble the colors of his missing parents? Sometimes he trips over nothing (which results in a game over). But hey, he’s just a baby—please be gentle! - How to Play This game cannot be played on its own. To play, open a live video (e.g. YouTube) on the left half of your monitor, and run this game on the right half. Align the frames carefully, then control Shibumaru using the WASD keys or your mouse. - Game Mechanics Hit detection is based on color: everything except crosswalk white and road gray is considered a target. In other words, Shibumaru might just slip right through people dressed in white or gray—oops! Also, no AI is used for detection, so if you trip in an empty spot, it's not intentional (there’s no “falling” logic built in). - Development Challenges This game relies on color-based detection, which can behave very differently depending on your PC or display environment. Older machines—and surprisingly, even some newer laptops—can reproduce colors in ways that drastically affect detection accuracy. Fine-tuning the collision logic has been one of the hardest parts. On the desktop PC used for development, everything works smoothly. But on two different laptops I own, the character barely reacts to people—even when clearly colliding. Please note that gameplay may vary depending on your system. - Copyright This application is completely free. It does not store, redistribute, or monetize any external video content.

rows.name: Queen Anne's Lace
rows.short_description: As the Night Auditor at the Queen Anne's Lace, you only have one job: keep your guests checked in. Forever.
rows.description_html: PLAYABLE TEASER This game is a playable teaser for our upcoming title, Fourth Time Around. If you find this game's world and aesthetic interesting, please consider clicking here to wishlist it on Steam! What could be so important to say – and requiring such careful consideration, no less – that one would hole themselves up, typing madly like ticker tape for days on end, yes? I should very much like to read another letter for myself, one of these days. Speaking of, I might soon fetch the mail again, yes. Inspired by surreal horror classics like  Twin Peaks and The Shining , Queen Anne's Lace is a  free to play hotel-themed anomaly horror game (a la The Exit 8, The Cabin Factory, and other genre classics) with a twist: you hide the anomalies for your guests to find. As the Night Auditor at the Queen Anne's Lace hotel, your job is to curate an experience for your guests that will keep them from ever checking out. Your subject in this short experience is Bill — over the hill, full of regret, and recently checked in to room 402. Hide anomalies around the 4th floor, and watch from the Showroom as he tries to find them. The game is  a light horror - more unnerving & unsettling than outright scary - though there are a few jumpscares throughout. FEATURES Draft your favorite of 3 anomalies each round, pulled from a pool o f 15 unique total anomalies, and hide them from Bill Each anomaly relates to Bill's story  - piece it together bit by bit as you play (ask your chat for help!) Play against an  intelligent AI agent  that searches the hotel in a believable way Learn the  best hiding spots  for your anomalies as you revisit the hotel Enjoy a  fully original soundtrack,  including   the looping original title track, faithfully written and recorded in a retro 1960s style Secrets, easter eggs, and lore throughout Short & sweet ( ~20-30 minutes ) Watch out for other Patrons No generative AI is used anywhere in this title

rows.short_description: Assemble your own figure collection! Open surprise boxes, collect legendary warrior figures, and join tabletop battles against rivals in the city. rows.description_html: In this prologue, you step into Table Battle Simulator: Prologue -  experience the first steps of becoming the ultimate figure collector and table battle champion! Discover the thrill of opening mysterious surprise boxes, collecting rare warrior figures, and setting up your own store in this limited free version. Unlock and sell different figure series. Build your collection and join the battles. Display your figures on shelves, set their prices, and sell them to collectors. If you wish, keep rare pieces to complete your collection. Design your own figure store. Unlock figure series, order surprise boxes, and sell them by placing them on your shelves. Choose a unique name for your store. Create the perfect store for collectors. Expand your collection with rare and valuable warrior figures from surprise boxes. You can earn money by selling these figures or complete your collection. Grow your store and attract more customers! Gain new customers and increase your profits with new shelves, race platforms, and figure boxes.

rows.name: Galaxy Card Game
rows.short_description: Sci-fi strategy card battler. Build galactic fleets, consume supplies to deploy units, and battle across the stars. Unique supply mechanics break traditional cost limitations - every deployment is a choice between survival and expansion. All cards free, skill determines victory.
rows.description_html: Sci-Fi Setting & World Building In a distant galaxy, major factions wage fierce wars for stellar dominance. As fleet commanders, players command various combat units and strategize across interstellar battlefields. All Cards Free Simulator All cards are fully unlocked, no gacha or payment required - pure competitive experience. Focus on strategic combat where skill determines victory. Build any deck freely and jump into battle immediately. Core Mechanics That Revolutionize Traditional Card Games Supply System : Each unit deployment consumes precious supplies, balancing risk and reward in resource management, breaking through traditional cost limitations. Health System : Units lose health in combat and are destroyed at zero, capable of participating in multiple battles, eliminating one-shot kill mechanics. Redefined Combat Damage : Unit battles don't harm commanders; only direct attacks reduce influence, creating more dynamic breakthrough and interception gameplay. Special Deployment System : Unlimited deployment mechanism - as long as supplies last, continuously expand your fleet to create overwhelming advantages or surprise tactics. Strategic Depth Turn Phases : Acquire combat resources, activate tactical preparations, deploy units, place facilities, use support cards, command space fleet battles, post-battle adjustments and redeployment, end turn processing. Strategic Elements Resource Management : Make crucial choices between survival and expansion - every supply point matters. Unit Configuration : Multiple unit categories including Human, Mammalian, Arthropod, each with unique tactical characteristics. Trait Combinations : Legion and Fleet trait systems that create powerful synergies. Tactical Timing : Master optimal moments to play support and tactical cards, controlling the battlefield tempo. Unit Types : Basic units, large units, support facilities, and more - build diverse tactical systems. Game Features Complete Battle System : 2-player and 4-player modes with online, LAN support, and spectating. Deck Management : Intuitive card collection manager, powerful deck builder, search and filter functions, import/export capabilities. Interface & Experience : Modern UI design, full Chinese localization, sound effects and visual support. Join the galactic battlefield now and experience unprecedented strategic card gameplay! All cards free, fair competition - your tactics decide everything! Note: This game is adapted from an open-source project. Currently in early access with fully playable core mechanics. Full version will continuously add more cards, modes, and features - stay tuned!

rows.name: Mouse Fart
rows.short_description: Mouse Fart, an RPG style adventure where you play as a Mouse that will navigate a randomized maze in search of food. Fight the Food Monsters in turn-based combat with quick-time events. Eat the food to create Gas Clouds.
rows.description_html: Mouse Fart is a RPG style game in which you will navigate a randomized maze in search of food items to collect.  You will always have a dog as your trusty Companion. It's populated by different Food Monsters you will have to fight in combat. Choose between different attacks in turn-based combat. Master quick-time events to deal higher damage and block attacks. A dog will give you company in the combat and represent the bulk of your main offensive and defensive capabilities. The food you collect is taken with you home where you can eat it. Produce different colorful clouds that you can now light and generate over 70 different authentic fart sounds. Discover combinations of food to unlock special effects within the clouds which are stored in jars on the shelves for your repeat viewing enjoyment. Totally not creepy at all! Unlock rats as another main character and 4 more dog characters as companion to choose from. Gain experience from all actions, level up and gather skill points to enhance your characters. Choose between 3 different soundtrack styles: Cartoon, Epic, and Jazz. Explore various secrets to free the Goddess and fight the boss Vulcan. With this game, it's OK to have your head in the clouds!

rows.name: Stay Alive For Me
rows.short_description: Survive a gripping psychological thriller in this visual novel. Make critical decisions, face a disturbed captor, and experience multiple chilling endings.
rows.description_html: Based on the psychological thriller film Connection Step into the basement. The lights flicker. You’re not alone. Stay Alive For Me is a psychological horror visual novel inspired by the indie thriller movie Connection . You play as Allie, trapped with a disturbed captor, and every choice you make brings you closer to the truth...or to doom. Experience a tense, intimate story with horror at every turn. Will you survive the night, or will the darkness claim you?

rows.name: The Last Elixir
rows.short_description: You are a journeyman alchemist: experiment to learn the secrets of the alchemical sciences, and leverage them to produce a diverse menu of potions for a procession of weird and spooky customers in this compact narrative puzzle experience.
rows.description_html: With the abrupt death of your mentor, you have become the sole proprietor of an alchemy shop in a world of magic and bizarre creatures. You will quickly learn to fill his shoes. Experiment with precise combinations of plants and minerals to learn the principles and the systems of the alchemical sciences. Use the knowledge you gain to produce the elixirs requested of you by a diverse set of creatures, monsters, and who-knows-whats. Will your arts surpass those of your mentor, allowing you to succeed where he failed? Alchemy isn't a simple matter of combining the correct ingredients. Ratios matter, and there are multiple paths to a final result. With a deeper understanding, identify what went wrong and improvise to bring an elixir back on track. Only the mouse is necessary to manipulate ingredients, containers, and tools. Carefully pour a tiny drizzle of liquid to reach a precise ratio, or quickly mash a root to harvest its essence.

rows.name: Poker Fate - ACG Texas Hold'em
rows.short_description: Poker Fate is an anime-style Texas Hold'em game featuring beautiful heroines. It combines easy-to-learn tutorials for beginners, high-stakes duels for top players, and a variety of thrilling tournaments. Join now and uncover the cards of your destiny with us!
rows.description_html: Poker Fate – Choose your poker partner and enter a duel against fate! Play for free! Dive into thrilling Texas Hold'em with charming characters, dazzling effects, and endless excitement. 'In this battle of wits, your hand decides fate—yet it's you who will rewrite the ending.' When rivalry and cooperation collide at the table, when the balance of strategy and luck shifts— your destined poker partner awaits, ready to fight at your side! Join Poker Fate and experience heart-racing poker matches! Whether you're brand-new to the game or a seasoned veteran, there's joy waiting for you at every table! Poker Fate Features ♦️ Classic Texas Hold'em – Free to Play ♦️ • Authentic Texas Hold'em rules: two hole cards plus five community cards—build the strongest hand and claim victory! • Multiple modes and tournaments: completely free to play, no pay-to-win! Enjoy whichever mode you like as you climb the rankings. • Abundant rewards: log in daily, complete missions, and play anytime, anywhere to earn exciting prizes! ♦️ Adorable Live2D Characters – Double the Bonding Fun ♦️ • Cute, fully animated characters stand by your side in every match! • Express yourself with exclusive emotes and voice lines at the table. • Raise Affinity through poker and make a vow to your characters to unlock new outfits, voices, and emotes for deeper interaction! ♦️ Beginner-Friendly with Full Support ♦️ • A complete tutorial makes learning easy for anyone. • Hand Replay lets you revisit your game history, analyze plays, and sharpen your strategy. • Share your hands with friends or watch top players in action to grow your skills! ♦️ Special Modes and Unique Mechanics ♦️ • Try the fast-paced AoF (All-In or Fold) mode—every hand will get your heart racing! • Win or lose, enjoy dynamic outfit-breaking animations that make each moment unforgettable. • Customize characters, tables, and backgrounds with stunning effects to create your own poker space! ♦️ Famous Japanese Voice Cast ♦️ • Characters brought to life by top voice actors! • Uesaka Sumire, Hara Yumi, Tachibana Hina, Nishio Yuka... • And many more new voices and characters coming in future updates! Recommended For ♥️ Poker Lovers ♥️ • Fans of Hold'em, Blackjack, or other card games looking to try Hold'em or Omaha • Players eager for real-time worldwide battles, testing both strategy and psychology ♥️ Anime Enthusiasts & Collectors ♥️ • Those who love collecting characters, outfits, and special effects, or customizing their tables • Casual players seeking stress-free games against AI or relaxed matches with friends ♥️ Strategy Game Fans ♥️ • Players who enjoy analyzing hands and tactical play • Bluffing masters who live for mind games • Risk-takers who thrive on precision and calculated strategy ♥️ Competitive Multiplayer Players ♥️ • Pros looking for real-time global competition • Friends teaming up to climb the rankings • Players eager to meet fellow poker enthusiasts ♥️ Fans of Free Casual Games ♥️ • Newcomers who want a high-quality poker experience at no cost • Gamers who prefer casual play, anytime and anywhere Notes • All in-game currency, items, and characters are virtual and limited to gameplay. • The game does not offer real-money gambling or rewards. • Poker Fate welcomes beginners and pros alike—everyone interested in poker is invited to join!

rows.name: Soulcrossed
rows.short_description: A visual novel with SRPG battles that will test both your mind and heart.
rows.description_html: Soulcrossed is a story-driven visual novel with tactical SRPG battles. You play as a demon bound to a girl, navigating both the grid of combat and the twists of your soul in the world of siphony. While there are player choices, Soulcrossed is primarily a linear story. Its focus lies in storytelling mixed with tactical combat. Each encounter is designed as a puzzle, where true victory comes from strategy and adaptation rather than raw power. rows.name: Deskworm
rows.short_description: A tiny desktop worm pet that moves when you type, click, or play. Dress it up with hats and skins, park it in a pocket where its gaze follows your mouse, and let its Anti-Shrimp reminders nudge you to sit up and stretch.
rows.description_html: A Little Worm for Your Desktop Meet your own tiny desktop worm pet . It moves when you type, click, or play with a gamepad . Every input makes it crawl a bit further until it reaches the screen edge and turns around . It is small, calm, and just hangs out with you while you use your PC. Pocket Mode If you want less movement, put it in Pocket Mode. The worm sits in a small pocket on your screen and its head follows your mouse cursor . It stays close, quietly judging your life choices while you work and play. Items & Customization As you use your PC, you earn points by typing and clicking. Spend those points on item drops to unlock new hats and skins . Make your worm cute, silly, stylish, or totally cursed – it is up to you. Common (85%), Uncommon (10%), Rare (4%), Epic (0.95%), Legendary (0.05%) Crafting & Upgrading Have duplicate items or styles you do not use?  Combine items of the same rarity to craft one from the next tier. You can also feed items to your worm to add more body segments, so it slowly grows longer over time. Comfort Settings You can scale the worm to be tiny or big , just how you like it. Resize the pocket, and adjust many settings  to make your companion feel cozy on your desktop. Made for Focus & Breaks Use the Pomodoro timer to work in gentle focus blocks with clear breaks. Turn on the Anti-Shrimp stretch reminder so the worm can remind you to sit up straight, stand up, and stretch. It is a small, friendly nudge to take better care of yourself while you are at your PC.

rows.name: Ocean Fishooter
rows.short_description: Try the best fish-shooting game and experience the most thrilling shooting action and the most immersive adventure! Start your hunting journey now — challenge sea creatures, zombie hordes, fantasy monsters, and ancient dinosaurs to hone your shooting skills!
rows.description_html: Dive into the Thrilling New World of <Ocean Fishooter> After years of dedication and passion, we're thrilled to unveil our most magnificent creation yet—a fishing adventure like no other! [Why You'll Love Ocean Fishooter] Shoot, Score, and Conquer! Arm your cannon, take aim, and fire at a dazzling variety of sea creatures. Reel in big wins with every shot and dominate the deep! 【Enhanced Fishing Gameplay】 The era of Strategic Fishing is here! Your choice of firepower determines your victory! Phonix Power (Single Target Annihilation): Target locked! Summon a Fire Phoenix with a 5x Reinforced Bullet to focus fire directly on the Boss's weak point, dramatically reducing kill time! Dragon Power (Area Sweep): Area bombardment! A 7x Reinforced Bullet triggers chain lightning, its widespread attack leaving no small fish hidden, easily achieving a clean sweep! 【Mighty Bosses】 Fortune King: 【Treasure Bag Draw!】 Chance to pull a multiplying 'Golden Dragon' or a prize-winning 'Koi'! Experience the thrill of opening a lucky chest! Coin Clown: 【Hat Trick】 The surprises never stop! The unpredictable jester's magic randomly conjures a multiplying 'Tiger King' or a prize-winning 'Rabbit'! Raging Dragon: 【Go All Out!】 Capture the Dragon and don't let it break free from its chains! Test your sustained firepower and precision! Vampire King: 【Multiplier Accumulation】 Continuous shooting builds up the prize pool! After the final kill, the accumulated prize is multiplied for a massive burst of earnings! Rock Skeleton: 【Sound & Light Shockwave】 Cool concert-level special effects! The sonic shockwave causes area damage! Rock! Tiger King: 【Speed Rush】 Challenge your ultimate reaction time! The more fire rings you fly through, the more prizes you accumulate. Go for the rush! Thunder Dragon: 【Full-Screen Lightning】 Attacking from all sides! The Thunder Dragon's impact triggers full-screen lightning strikes, resulting in first-class group damage efficiency! 【Rich Marine Life】 Stunning! Dive into the deep-sea sanctuary and embark on a 'True-to-Life' visual fishing feast! We've invested heavily to create over dozens of lifelike marine species, ensuring you never face monotony—every shot is a surprising encounter! 【Vibrant & Colorful! Reef Sparklers】 From the lively Clownfish and graceful Angelfish to the mysterious Lanternfish. These high-frequency species are your best choice for accumulating small prizes! (Includes: Lionfish, Flounder, Lobster, Swordfish, Octopus, Sea Turtle, Crab, Manta Ray...etc.) 【Deep-Sea Giants! A Challenge of Sight and Firepower】 Get ready to face the true ocean dominators! Fierce Sharks, massive Humpback Whales, elegant and mysterious Mermaids, and lurking Crocodiles—these large targets not only bring intense visual shock but are also the primary source of big jackpots! 【Fortune Zombie】 Enter a post-apocalyptic world where the undead roam and survival is the only goal. Face terrifying foes, each with their own tragic story. INFERNODRAC：A noble vampire count who transforms into a well of blood beneath the moonlight. DOOMTRAIN：A devoted conductor who keeps managing the train station—even after infection. FERRIS WHEEL：A carnival performer who turns his hand drum to spin his beloved wheel. MECHZOMB：A monstrous Frankenstein zombie with giant mechanical arms crushing all in its path. LUNORIA：A silent soul who waits eternally for the love she could never forget. MECKONG：A mechanical gorilla destroying bridges and annihilating intruders. GRIMBADGE：A brutal prison warden from whom no prisoner has ever escaped. 【Dino Shooter】 Travel back to a primal world where dinosaurs roam free! Gear up for a prehistoric adventure like never before. Encounter a variety of ancient beasts in lush, untamed lands. Hunt down mythical creatures like the Crystal Dragon and Gigantic Golden Dragon! 【Lucky Shooter】 Step into a whimsical fairytale kingdom filled with magical creatures and thrilling challenges. Defend your enchanted castle from beneath the moat. Discover the wonder and mystery of a world beyond imagination! 【Diverse Welfare & Benefits】 Luxury Login Rewards: Sign in consecutively for seven days to unlock an exclusive rare wing grand prize! Lucky Wheel: Test your luck for free! Massive amounts of Gold and Diamonds are waiting for you to spin out! Monthly Pass: Upgrade to the VIP Monthly Pass to enjoy an ad-free experience and early access to unlock game levels for the ultimate fishing journey! 【Diverse Level Design】 Quiet Deep Sea: Feel the calmness and mystery of the deep sea, searching for big prizes lurking in the deep blue. Rock Stage: Follow the rhythm of the Rock Skeleton! Fire away on a stage filled with sound and light shockwaves for the wildest fishing night! Crazy Circus: Enter the domain of the Coin Clown and Tiger King! Challenge thrilling, high-multiplier prizes in the bizarre and festive setting! Ice Canyon: Delve into the habitat of the Ancient Crocodile! Test your extreme firepower in the cold, chilling ancient canyon. Lava Volcano: Challenge the lair of the Raging Dragon! Engage in an all-out ultimate hunt within the environment of the searing volcanic lava! Note ● Ocean Fishooter does not offer real money gambling. It is intended for an adult audience for entertainment purposes only. ● Any success in social casino gambling is not indicative of future success at real money gambling. ● This game includes in-app purchases.

rows.name: Slug Survival
rows.short_description: Survive endless waves of evolving slugs in a fast-paced top-down shooter. Adapt, Upgrade your weapon or not and blast your way through slug swarms that are more chaotic with every wave. One arena, Infinite chaos.
rows.description_html: Survive. Adapt. Destroy. Welcome to Slug Survival , a fast, chaotic top-down arena shooter where every second counts. Face off against bio-engineered slugs that learn, adapt, and strike harder with every wave. Move fast and blast through relentless slug swarms that grow faster, meaner, and more unpredictable each round. Keep moving, keep firing or get overrun. Collect power-ups to boost your firepower and unlock devastating multi-shot upgrades. Stack your boosts to unleash up to five shots at once , melting everything in your path.  Every pickup is a step toward survival or total annihilation. Face powerful, tougher, smarter, and far more dangerous  boss slugs  that get even tougher at key milestones. Defeat them to earn massive bonuses , unlock game-changing upgrades , and push your survival to the limit. Compete for the top spot and show off your survival skills. Earn higher scores, survive longer, and cement your name among the best Slug Slayers.

rows.description_html: In Full Steam, take control of Scrapper and fight for your freedom in this 2D, side-on, endless runner - with survivor like elements. Bust free from the iron grip of the tyrannous overlord in a ruthless steampunk world. Survive the pandemonium and battle through hordes of volatile enemies, collecting experience to upgrade your rig from tin shell, to battle hardened. Keep up the pace, or the Steam King will catch you and send you to the scrap heap. How Long can you run for?

rows.name: Pac-Snec
rows.short_description: Have a nostalgic trip back in time to experience a fresh take on some classics. Eat orbs and extend your Snec to become the longest and coolest in the world!
rows.description_html: A Clash of Arcade Classics  Pac-Snec is the ultimate high-score hunting challenge of two beloved arcade genres into a single, intensely replayable experience. Grab that nostalgia and hold it close as you deep dive into a retro-inspired world where every move counts and the maze is your hunting ground. Core Gameplay & Mechanics  You control the Snec , a snake like entity tasked with navigating a procedurally generated Labyrinth . Your one true goal is consumption and dominance: Consume & Grow: Weave through the maze and devour scattered Orbs . Each orb increases your score and, crucially, your length. The Deeper Challenge: The longer your Snec grows, the more challenging the Labyrinth becomes. Collision with your own increasingly lengthy tail results in a game over. Goal: Survive, grow, and secure your position at the top of the Global Leaderboards (WIP) for ultimate bragging rights. Key Features & Content The Labyrinth is not empty. Lurking within are Spectres , agile creatures that patrol the maze. Avoid the Spectres: These creatures will chase and trap you. Mastering the map layout and predicting their movement is key to survival. Character Progression (WIP): Unlock new Snec bodies, unique visual trail effects, and spectral Spectre Skins   as you achieve high scores and complete in-game milestones. A feature-rich, dedicated arcade experience, designed for both quick sessions and deep mastery: Infinite Replayability: Navigate procedurally generated maps. No two Labyrinths are ever the same, ensuring a fresh challenge on every run. Multiple Game Modes: Test your skills in different ways: Classic Mode: The pure, unforgiving arcade experience. Dead End Mode:  Plan ahead, dead ends are unforgiving and portaling into a Spectre is less than ideal. Who You Gonna Call?: Play with NO Spectres! Easily customise your game to remove the threats and avoid your tail at any means necessary.

rows.name: Bip and Bop
rows.short_description: Help, step on, or sabotage your friend! In this 2-player only puzzle platformer, perfect chemistry is the only way through. Think your friendship can handle it?
rows.description_html: 'Not that one, you have to do the other thing first!' Remember those games you used to play on the couch with a friend, laughing and shouting side-by-side? Here comes a new challenge that will put your friendship (and your patience) to the ultimate test. This is a puzzle platformer that can only be cleared when two people truly work together. One player flips a switch while the other dashes through the door. One acts as a stepping stone so the other can reach new heights. You'll literally have to work as one to beat these challenges! Strictly for Two!: Every level is meticulously designed for 2-player co-op. Going solo is not an option! (It's also lonely.) It's Okay to Fail!: Failure is just part of the fun! Instead of blaming your friend, just laugh it off and find a new approach. You're in this together! No Game Over!: The only 'Game Over' is when one of you decides to 'give up' first! Grab your favorite co-op partner and dive into this hilarious adventure today!

rows.name: ESC/APE
rows.short_description: ESC/APE is a first-person, physics-based combat game starring Abe, a genetically enhanced ape. Slide, ground pound, and throw your way through brutal trials to prove you’re the apex specimen and finally break free from the lab that caged you.
rows.description_html: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. ESC/APE throws you into the role of Abe, a genetically enhanced ape bred for combat and locked away in a sterile testing facility. After a lifetime of experiments, you’re finally given a chance to prove your worth, and the chance to break free! Master momentum and raw power in fast-paced, physics-driven combat. Slide under hazards, ground pound enemies into the floor, and hurl objects; or your foes themselves, into walls with bone-crushing force. Every movement is a weapon, and every trial pushes your abilities to the limit. Will you be just another specimen in the lab’s endless experiments, or the first to shatter its walls and escape?

rows.description_html: Project Monster is a tower defense game with Roguelite elements. You must become the commander of an army of monsters and summon monsters and defeat them to face the incoming enemies. Evolve monsters with loot earned by defeating enemies and gain items to strengthen them. Defeat the incoming enemies to the end to clear the stage. This game was developed by a team of four university students from Sungkyul University in Korea. While it still has many shortcomings, we welcome your feedback as we continue improving the game.

rows.name: GumPop!
rows.short_description: GumPop! is a 3D Puzzle Platformer. Solve Puzzles to find a way to the next room and clear out the sweet factory from mutated sweets with your Bubble Gum Gun.
rows.description_html: GumPop! is a 3D Puzzle Platformer inspired by Portal and Bubble Bobble where you have to solve challenging Puzzles by using various types of Bubbles and Bubble abilities. You are the exterminator Wilhelmina (Billie) “Bubble” Tuck who is tasked to clear out one of the biggest and most famous sweet factory's in the world from mutated, oversized and dangerous sweets who overran the factory. The original version was created by the student project team Anonymous Animals at Mediadesign University (mdh) in Berlin. Anonymous Animals: Game Design: Antonia 'Anton' Dittmer, Leonhard Stettnisch, Samuel 'Sammy' Gower Art: Emily Schütze, Gina-Marie Bognar, Lucas Wuerth, Zhenyu Wang Programming: Conor Huismann, Isabelle Diehl Producing: Samuel 'Sammy' Gower Project Lecturers: Sylvius Lack, Heiko Ihde, Henning Janssen, Dustin Paasch

rows.name: Genesis
rows.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in an abandoned village. Scavenge notes, ammo, and supplies while being relentlessly hunted by a terrifying monster.
rows.description_html: Enter an abandoned village where silence hides something far worse than decay. Genesis is a first-person survival horror experience where every shadow threatens to reveal the monster stalking you. You are not alone. The creature hunts relentlessly, forcing you to scavenge what little remains: revolver rounds, bandages, and scattered notes that hold the key to your escape. Each discovery brings you closer to freedom — or face-to-face with what lurks in the dark. Features First-person survival horror set in a desolate, abandoned village A terrifying monster that hunts and chases you without mercy Collect scattered notes to unravel the path to escape Manage scarce resources: revolver, bandages, and precious ammo Tense atmosphere with constant dread and no safe place to hide Will you escape the village, or will the monster make Genesis your final chapter?

rows.name: Chronigma
rows.short_description: Master time in this story-rich time-bending puzzle game. You travel back in time to be in two places at once, to solve puzzles impossible to complete alone. Your success hinges on your ability to collaborate with yourself. Can you learn to manipulate time to save humanity?
rows.description_html: Who is this made for: Gamers who love hard-core time manipulation puzzles.  Story:  They called it the Time War. A conflict where humanity's greatest achievement, time travel, became its tombstone. Your father (Kronos) has dedicated his life to one purpose: your (Cygnus) training. This puzzle adventure is a series of his lessons (puzzles), and each one a challenging test of your ability to manipulate time.  Game: This is a single-player, story-rich, time-bending puzzle game. You use time travel to be in two places at once to solve increasingly complex puzzles. With the Chronigma device, you are never truly alone. The Chronigma device records your actions, allowing you to travel back in time, and team up with your 'Past Self' to solve puzzles impossible for a single person. Key Features Completely free game. Time Manipulation Puzzle Game: This is a challenging puzzle game and is meant for those that enjoy time manipulation puzzles. Team Up With Yourself: Record your actions and collaborate with your own 'Past Self' to overcome obstacles. A Journey Through Time: Explore 50+ handcrafted levels, from simple logic problems to multi-layered temporal challenges. Providing 4-6 hours of mind-bending puzzle gameplay. Play the Game Your Way: Stuck on a tricky paradox? Get a nudge in the right direction with in-game hints, or skip a level to come back to it later. You can also unlock all levels to explore the story at your own pace. And if for some reason you are not interested in the story, you can disable the dialogue in settings.  A Story of Hope at the End of Time: Uncover the secrets of the Time War and the heavy burden shared between a father and son, training to save a world they've never known. Bonus Challenge: For the truly dedicated, seek out and conquer difficult levels that will test your mastery of time to its absolute limit.

rows.name: Frontier Outpost
rows.short_description: Escape from a strange base
rows.description_html: Playtime Approximately 1.5 to 3 hours Gameplay You step into an abandoned military base. There, you will face unspeakable horrors… and your only goal is to survive and escape. Background The story begins when a curious child enters a restricted military zone. Inside, they experience terrifying events that defy explanation. Developer’s Note Frontier Outpost is the very first horror game created by a solo developer who learned Unreal Engine through self-study. The game may have many shortcomings, but this project represents my passion for learning and my determination to grow. I want to continue making horror games and improve step by step. If you share the same dream, feel free to reach out — I’m looking for people to join me on this journey. Distribution & Streaming Guidelines When streaming or uploading gameplay videos, please include the game’s title or a Steam link in the stream title or video description. This small gesture means a lot to a solo developer. The developer is not responsible for any damages or losses caused by the distribution of videos of this game.

rows.name: Journey to Slimetopia
rows.short_description: Venture into an unknown world in this first-person arena shooter. Tread on paths none have walked before and search for secrets to upgrade your weapons. Wield a sword and wand to face hordes of slimes gone mad. Meet curious characters and become the hero which Slimetopia awaits.
rows.description_html: Will you be the hero for this lone world? Set out on a journey through a minimalistic low poly world, once so peaceful, that fell into turmoil after the slimes have gone mad. Discover different environments, their inhabitants and secrets, climb the highest mushrooms of the mysterious swamp and fight your way into the depths of the crystal mines. Intense battles Use your wand to tackle hordes of slimes and feel the rhythm of battle as the portal opens and waves upon waves of slimes will charge your way. Use your sword to deal with groups of slimes, but wield it with caution, for it strikes slow. Keep track of all enemies around you and keep watch for those that trick your senses. Never rest, never hesitate, for the next wave is coming. A world full of secrets Many secrets await, big and small, for the eyes of a watchful hero. Discover all that this realm has to offer and listen to the retro soundtrack of worlds long past. Stare into the dancing flames and watch the sparks rise to the night sky as the mysteries of Slimetopia unfold.

rows.name: Let's Save Mice
rows.short_description: Join up to three friends in this mouse-sized adventure! Explore, gather resources, solve puzzles, and battle enemies as you try to bring your kidnapped brothers and sisters home.
rows.description_html: Custo mice ! Create and personalize your mouse to your own liking. Change color, pattern or even the size of the ears, cheeks and teeth. Experience the story! Experience the island’s story through interactive cutscenes, where you and your friends vote to decide what happens next. Fight! The rude and rowdy mice of this island have captured your friends! Whip up some trusty weapons and give them a good bonk before they get to you first! Explore! As a tiny mouse, you can climb, squeeze, and scamper through every nook and cranny of the island. Hidden secrets are everywhere—so get exploring! From towering trees to winding roots and mossy caves, every path leads to a new discovery just waiting to be found. Free your friends! The island you and your friends explore is filled with fellow mice waiting to be rescued. Each one is locked away, and only the right key can set them free! Search every corner of the island or take on quests from its quirky inhabitants to discover the keys and bring your companions back to safety. Features: Explore and solve puzzles with up to 3 friends Over 25 rescuable mice for now! Crafting and looting Quirky inhabitants with quests to complete Character customization Online co-op Gophy the Gopher!

rows.name: Sunday School
rows.short_description: You are trapped in a Sunday School, plagued by eerie childlike hallucinations. Observe your surroundings carefully to spot anomalies, and descend deeper only when you’re certain it’s safe.
rows.description_html: Sunday School is a short psychological horror inspired by surreal titles like The Exit 8 an P.T.  Step into a distorted world born from children’s drawings.  In 30–60+ minutes of tense, immersive gameplay, you’ll descend through haunting visions that blur the line between innocence and nightmare. GAME OVERVIEW You are trapped in a child’s mind, where trauma takes the form of a looping Sunday School corridor, you must distinguish normal rooms from those tainted by disturbing anomalies. Only by choosing correctly you can break the loop. Choose wrong exit from the room, and the cycle begins again. Pay close attention to the signs guiding your way, and descend through all eight floors to uncover the unsettling truth that waits below. MULTIPLE ENDINGS The story doesn't end with just one playthrough. Replay the game to find all the anomalies. Each anomaly is a key that brings you closer to the truth. There are three main endings. From the developer:  This is a free game made with love, if you’d like to support future development, take a look at my other titles.

rows.name: DarkOrbit Reloaded
rows.short_description: Dark Orbit is a free-2-play space MMO where three companies battle for galactic domination. Customize ships, trade resources, fight aliens and uncover a grand conspiracy on your epic cosmic journey. Thrilling PvP and PvE missions await! Will you lead your faction beyond the final frontier?
rows.description_html: Humanity’s reckless use of Jump Gates triggered a brutal alien retaliation that almost annihilated Earth. In the aftermath, three rival conglomerates emerged: Earth Industries Corporation (EIC), Mars Mining Operations (MMO), and Venus Resources Unlimited (VRU). For generations, their strife has cloaked  the stars in a never-ending fog of war!   Dark Orbit is a long-running free-to-play space MMO. Join the fray today and battle for dominance across a fractured galaxy alongside millions of players!   CHOOSE YOUR ALLEGIANCE and become an elite pilot! CUSTOMIZE YOUR SHIP from a wide variety of designs, outfitting it with drones, weapons, generators, and specialized equipment. TRADE VALUABLE RESOURCES like Prometium, Endurium, Terbium and many more! BID ON ELITE ITEMS and auction off spare loot to gain the upper hand! EPIC MAIN QUEST: Explore the dark history behind the three conglomerates and uncover a galactic conspiracy threatening the fabric of the whole universe! THE LORDAKIA ARE WATCHING: Encounter a wide variety of alien species from all over the universe! BUILD GALAX GATES to access hidden sectors and make your way through a whole new galaxy! Uncover RARE REWARDS! VISIT YOUR SKYLAB to allocate resources and fine-tune your gameplay strategy!   Whether you're diving into PvP combat or tackling PvE missions, DarkOrbit offers a sprawling universe filled with danger, intrigue, and opportunity. Will you rise through the ranks and lead your company beyond the final frontier?

rows.name: Ressolve Steps
rows.short_description: A simple 3D top-down puzzle game that requires precise movement and strategy.
rows.description_html: The goal of this game is to step on checkpoint tiles in the level and return to your respawn point. Press R for respawn. When you step on any tiles (except the respawn point) and move on to another tile, the previously stepped tile will dissolve. When you step on the checkpoint tile (black tile) and make the tile dissolve, the checkpoint's remaining number on the top left will decrease. Once you dissolve all of the checkpoints in the level, the stripe color of the respawn will change to green. Stepping it grants you access to the next level. From level 2, you can place a tile by clicking the cell; however, each level has a limited number of tiles you can place, so be careful.

rows.name: Loser Named Hana
rows.short_description: Loser Named Hana is a friendship-building visual novel. You respond to an ad advertising $100 a week to be the lonely college student, Hana, friend.
rows.description_html: About You have found a strange ad at your local convenience store advertising $100 a week to be someone’s friend. The catch? The girl is an incredibly lonely girl named “Hana” with a strange, high-pitched voice. Regardless of how you treat Hana, one thing is for certain: she is desperate for friendship. Your New Friend Hana Mendoza Birthday: October 13th 1999 Sexuality: Desperate (bi/pan) Gender: Cis Woman She/Her Age: 19 Height: 5’3’’ Personality: Sensitive, Clumsy, Lonely Occupation: College Student Features Ability to play as cis, trans, or various other genders  (She/Her, They/Them, He/Him) 25K words of girl failure interaction About an hour and a half of gameplay 3 Endings Partially voiced Ability to mute voice acting

rows.name: RATMOUSE
rows.short_description: it's rat vs roach in this arcade style romp... RATMOUSE is a fast-paced, challenging, arcade style romp where you play as a RAT, with your MOUSE (get it yet?)
rows.description_html: RATMOUSE is a fast-paced, challenging, arcade style romp where you play as a RAT, with your MOUSE (see what i did there?) Guide Barbra the rat through several NASTY, dilapidated, harsh environments INFESTED with bugs, its your job to clear them out, and eat some crumbs while you're at it. Think fast, move faster. RATMOUSE captures the spirit of many classic phase based arcade games, while twisting it into something new. Every stage is hand-crafted, every animation drawn frame by frame, and every second pushes you to stay as sharp as the knife you wield.

rows.name: Warriors Across Worlds
rows.short_description: Even When Separated, Miracles Can Happen. A short, indie JRPG about what happens when the dimension's strongest team gets split apart. They'll meet new friends and foes...mostly foes.
rows.description_html: Get ready for the next generation of Warriors! After a brutal battle with a new threat, three Warriors are separated and are forced to survive in strange, new worlds with only their wits about them. They’ll meet familiar faces and fight alongside them in an attempt to stop the Desolate Demon from combining the Desolate Dimension with their dimension. Featuring fact-paced, turn-based JRPG combat and an explosive soundtrack you’re sure to remember; this is a JRPG that’s gonna take you on a wild ride. Features: Three main playable characters that put in work and three supporting characters that provide their own benefits and keep the main characters mentally sane during their adventure. Explore the mysterious worlds of Zuld, Meelon, Even Newer York, and the Floating Islands. You’ll get to see a forest, a prison, the equivalent of Hell, some islands, the future, poison swamps, the inside of something, and a prism world. Over 100 new attacks! Each one is flashier than the last. A lot of banter between characters that’ll make you laugh. There’s even side-conversations that’ll randomly appear now and again. Animated cutscenes! Several segments of the story are fully animated to help better immerse the player. A soundtrack of over 50 songs composed by me! I hope you like drum & bass! 7 difficulty options! If you want a leisurely stroll or an absolute onslaught, this game has you covered. (W.M.D. is ONLY meant for JRPG experts. Maybe even beyond expert, like super-expert.) Over 40 achievements! Can you collect them all? View artwork of the characters, battle backgrounds, and moments from the story in the Gallery! EP Styles: Select from 10 different styles to best fit your playstyle and help you perform devastating, ultimate attacks! (Beyond the standard 9999 maximum, you get to see the exact amount of damage you inflict). Six new, unique classes! Wield the power of Space, Time, Doom, Dread, Blood, and Storm!  An Enemy Guide that shows you every detail about an enemy with special dialogue for each one! Wanna move faster? Just Boost with a press of a button! All of that and more awaits you in this badass JRPG!

rows.name: Shadow Of Winter
rows.short_description: A narrative-driven survival horror set in the frozen wilderness of 1985. Descend into an abandoned Soviet bunker, uncover its dark secrets, and fight to survive the terrors lurking within.
rows.description_html: Winter, 1985. A storm forces an emergency landing deep in the Canadian wilderness. You are Joseph, a young man stranded in the snow with no way out and one mission: find your missing brother. The search leads you to a place long forgotten, an abandoned Soviet military bunker, sealed away beneath the ice. What begins as a rescue quickly becomes a fight for survival. The bunker isn’t empty. Its halls are scarred with roots that push through steel, its silence broken by something that moves when you’re not looking. Every room holds fragments of its past: Cold War paranoia, failed experiments, and a story buried under layers of secrecy. As you descend deeper, you must: Survive the Elements – Manage limited supplies, craft essential tools, and endure the harsh winter pressing in from above. Explore and Uncover – Search through detailed Soviet-era environments filled with journals, notes, and relics that reveal the fate of the facility. Face the Horrors Below – Evade twisted creatures and environmental hazards that stalk the dark. Solve and Adapt – Restore power, bypass locked systems, and use your wits to push further into the unknown. This is not a fight you win with firepower. Every decision matters. Every step forward carries risk. The deeper you go, the closer you come to uncovering the truth - and the cost of survival.

Explore and Uncover – Search through detailed Soviet-era environments filled with journals, notes, and relics that reveal the fate of the facility. Face the Horrors Below – Evade twisted creatures and environmental hazards that stalk the dark. Solve and Adapt – Restore power, bypass locked systems, and use your wits to push further into the unknown. This is not a fight you win with firepower. Every decision matters. Every step forward carries risk. The deeper you go, the closer you come to uncovering the truth - and the cost of survival.

rows.name: Cosmic Cargo
rows.short_description: Embark on a daring journey in 'Cosmic Cargo,' a thrilling space adventure where you're the architect and captain of your own spacecraft. Carry cargo from station to station while fending off enemies and avoiding stellar hazards.
rows.description_html: Embark on a daring journey in 'Cosmic Cargo,' a thrilling space adventure where you're the architect and captain of your own spacecraft. Carry cargo from station to station while fending off enemies and avoiding stellar hazards, using your spoils to upgrade your vessel into a formidable space fortress. Each run promises a thrilling path to becoming the ultimate cosmic courier in a galaxy teeming with risks and rewards! Modular, tile-based ship building that encourages creativity and requires strategy to ensure survival. Five main levels with three difficulty settings , and an endless mode that lets you test how far your ship can go! Face a wide variety of enemies and environmental hazards. You will face increasing risks - and rewards! More money means a bigger ship with more cargo and even more guns! With each successful delivery earn more for each cargo block your ship carries. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Serene Night Dreamlight
rows.short_description: A game made by 5 high-school students, is finally here! This is short yuri-themed galgame which tells a story between two high school girls. Please forget your worries and enjoy this beautiful yuri world.
rows.description_html: NOTE: English is NOT currently fully supported. As for now, only GUI (text of the main story not included) is supported in English. Full translation will be available soon, please stay tuned. Story Introduction Dreama, an otaku girl constantly torn between her love for anime, daily routines, and last-minute assignments, never imagined her life would be completely turned around by a limited-edition poster blown away by the wind. On that late autumn afternoon, she met a mysterious girl named Lyra on the cherry blossom-lined path in the park. A first encounter over a poster and a shared 'duty' in the library became the starting point of their bond. From their casual chats during library work, the heart-racing moment of an accidental fall in the storage room, the warmth of sharing a red umbrella in the rain, to the dazzling sunset glow during their confession. Two contrasting souls gradually drew closer amidst exam papers, homework, club rumors, and the confusion of youth. Here, there are no complicated relationships or heavy family burdens. Just the pure and authentic daily life belonging to these girls in their youth. Being punished for not memorizing English vocabulary, getting caught playing Gomoku during evening self-study, feeling their hearts flutter at a confession under the romantic sunset, feeling bewildered and overwhelmed by the other's radiance, and finally rushing recklessly toward the stage after acknowledging their true feelings. When ideals collide with romance, when confusion about the future intertwines with present courage. Can they run toward each other once more, and let the spring cherry blossoms bloom for them again? Features 150,000-word script with multiple endings Lighthearted, slice-of-life stories Created by high school students, filled with authentic high school details Character Introduction Dreama Mung Lyra Ye

rows.name: A Game About Boxes
rows.short_description: 'Boxes are the most wonderful things ever! Truly they are, didn’t you know?' A Game About Boxes is a quirky little adventure that shifts from minimalist aesthetics to uncanny atmospheres, all while you jump around, summon boxes, and slowly learn to love them. :) or else <3
rows.description_html: Boxes?!? This is a game about boxes! Where you play as a box, summoning boxes, while learning about boxes and all their useful uses. Will you accept our cardboard overlords? Will you not do that?.. It's up to you I guess. Do You Love Boxes? A GAME ABOUT BOXES is a short platformer based story where you interact with the games narrator whilst learning all about boxes and their useful usefulness. As you make choices whether to follow the narrators instructions or delve into its frustrations you'll discover multiple endings and secrets whilst deciding your little boxes fate. Don't Be Square!! Enjoy the hollow, empty atmosphere, accompanied by original ambience and music including 'Eating Chicken Almonds and Rice' by ACardboardBox, ' Forest Noise ' by ACardboardBox and hit song ' Unpalpable Joy' by ACardboardBox.  Think Outside The Box but not too outside cause then you might break the experience and we wouldn't want that now would we... WARNING! This Game Includes Flashing Lights EPILEPSY WARNING!! Potentially creepy/disturbing subject matter

rows.name: Purrfect  Stall
rows.short_description: Purrfect Stall! Is a game A cosy 3D management game where you serving ice cream and tanghulu to customers and fight off your boss Capymayor at the end of each day. With each day the game gets quicker and boss gets more intense. As you try and keep on top of managing the store.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Purrfect Stall! A cosy 3D management game where you run your sweet stall and serve fluffy pals! Your only mission is to make PURRfect serves of tanghulu and ice cream before Capymayor takes over it!! you only got the survey three days to win!! Game mechanics Combos Every successful order you do adds to the current combo. after reaching a certain threshold, you will gain a multiplier or added money corresponding to the money multiplier to the base total. When the coin is automatically collected, it will give an additional bonus to the base total. The combo will break when you screw up an order, but there is a brief window of time you can make use of that multiplier before the multiplier disappears. prices of food tanghulu = 5 ice cream = 8 ice cream with toppings =10 tips =2 Upgrade shop You can buy upgrades to your ingredients to increase the Max uses before a refill is needed. Also, you can also buy crystals. When crystals are used it will restore your full health. On the topic of the crystals to unselect the press mouse 2 Capymayor When the Capy mayor shows up here, he will take a chunk of your money through taxes. If you don’t have the money or if  your money runs out, you lose the game Capy mayor will ask for multiple orders and will use some tricks to throw off your game. If you take too long or mess up the order, it will cost you more of your money. After the first day, you must also deal with customers coming in. The crystals don’t work on the mayor. automatically collected Modes By default, automatically collected is turned off, but if you want to turn it on. In the main menu, the settings have a toggle that will turn on automatically collected. When it's on, the money is automatically collected after 25 seconds. Run your Purrfect Stall now!!

rows.name: Pool Live Tour Max
rows.short_description: Pool Live Tour Max is a sports and casual multiplayer billiards game featuring realistic 3D physics, competitive online play.
rows.description_html: Pool Live Tour Max is a competitive and casual 3D billiards experience designed for both new players and pool veterans. The game features realistic physics, smooth controls, and fast-paced online matches where every shot counts. Play 1v1 duels, climb ranked leaderboards, and unlock new cues, tables, and visual customizations as you progress. Each match is turn-based and skill based, with precise aiming and shot power mechanics that reward accuracy and strategy. Pool Live Tour Max includes: Gameplay Features Realistic 3D physics that simulate accurate ball movement, spin, and collisions Online Multiplayer   challenge players from around the world in real-time 1v1 Matches & Friendly Games   compete for coins or play for fun Skill based aiming system with aim guides and adjustable shot power Intuitive controls optimized for mouse and keyboard Fast paced rounds designed for competitive players and casual fans Ranked progression   win matches to climb divisions and earn seasonal rewards Progression & Rewards Earn coins and chips through matches, missions Unlock cues, cue skins, tables, avatars, and visual effects Improve your stats with cues that offer different accuracy, spin, and power bonuses Customization Choose from a wide range of cues , table designs , and player avatars Cosmetic items allow players to personalize their style Additional Features Matchmaking based on skill rating Regular content updates Pool Live Tour Max brings the classic pool hall competition to a modern online platform easy to learn, fun to play, but deep enough for serious players who want to master every shot.

rows.name: Dilemma Dungeon
rows.short_description: A co-op roguelike dungeon exploration game. As you progress with your teammates, you will face dilemma choices where growing stronger yourself means someone else becomes weaker. Each run, you must create builds by combining different maps, classes, skills, and items, and overcome the cursed dungeon.
rows.description_html: Dilemma Dungeon is a 4-player co-op top-down roguelike dungeon exploration game. To overcome the cursed dungeon, players must work together, but every choice comes at a cost. At every moment of combat and growth, players face choices: will you become stronger yourself, or sacrifice for your allies? You may raise your own stats significantly at the cost of lowering a teammate’s, or make someone else stronger while weakening yourself. The game consists of three stages, and with ever-changing room layouts, monsters, and events, each run is a brand new challenge. Players complete their own builds by combining different classes, skills, and equipment items, and must break the curse to reach the end of the dungeon. In this dungeon, where cooperation and betrayal, sacrifice and greed intertwine—can you maintain trust with your teammates until the very end?
