rows.name: hackSociety
rows.short_description: hackSociety is an immersive MMO hacking simulator. Become part of a living, breathing simulated society in the most thorough and expansive hacker sim ever made. Will you become a legend, or fade into obscurity?
rows.description_html: hackSociety is an immersive, online hacking simulator. In a persistent online world, you'll explore a unique array of opportunities and gameplay paths as a hacker. It modernizes the old, dead genre of 'click hack, steal their money, repeat'. You'll build custom exploits and malware, make them work and bypass antivirus detection, and pick what you want to specialize in. Do you want to get into the crypto market? Steal it from your victims, or would you rather harvest your compromised systems into a botnet and mine it instead? Or keep your laundered funds safer in a bank account, with less risk? Or maybe mining crypto doesn't interest you, and you'd rather use your botnet to DDoS other organizations and win territorial disputes with those who dare stand against you and your crew. A lot is possible in this world. Will you be one of the greats who makes a name for themselves, or will you be washed away? Play for Free today and begin your journey in hackSociety. Features Viruses & Exploits - Just like in the real world, malware comes in strains. Named, categorized threats. In this game, it's no different. You'll choose what you are creating, name it, and unleash it strategically on targets you think are vulnerable. You can't be careless. Messing with the wrong people will quickly get your virus detected. It would be smart to scan your targets before attacking to gauge where their defenses are vulnerable. If you are prominent and powerful enough, your virus and its name will become infamous. Simulated Environment - The world reacts to you. The in-game crypto market is dynamic and always moving. Invest in the long term, and you can become leagues richer than your enemies. Collectible hNFT items are like property, with varying supply and rarity. You'll trade, auction, and barter with real people trying to control a live market to make even more money and premium currency. The better you are at it, the more gameplay buffs and powers you can acquire unique to most others. Manage a Botnet - Pool your compromised systems together and use their processing power for your own. Mine crypto, use the power to defend yourself from attacks, or go offensive and use the power in coordinated DDoS attacks with your organization. Organizations & Social - hackSociety is a very social game. Making friends and working with people you know can make or break you. Organization Tournaments pay out in heaps, with premium currency you'll need to upgrade your tools. It also doesn't hurt to have your name attached to the most fearsome, powerful organizations around on the network. You'll customize your profile to your liking, and flex your inventory and status with it in the in-game chat. Defenses - You're a target too. In hackSociety, you'll need to learn how to keep yourself safe from people like yourself. Firewall, antivirus, drive encryption, and your opsec will all keep your system safe in their own way. You'll learn while playing that nothing is a catch-all. A good antivirus isn't a magic shield, and an intensive firewall has its own weaknesses. Live Service - You can expect lots of gameplay updates and extensions of the game. The possibilities are endless with a thorough hacking simulator like hackSociety, and you and the community control the future of the game. Suggest what you think would be cool to implement into the game on our socials like the Discord, or in-game. There's more for you to explore, and we'll leave that up to you for when the game is released. Wishlist hackSociety and be there first!

rows.name: Jumara
rows.short_description: A tactical card game of structure and precision. Build decks, charge Totems, and master the Tox System , a logic-based sequence mechanic that defines every encounter.
rows.description_html: Jumara is a strategic card game where every match is a unique challenge: choose your deck, charge the Totems, and survive by managing resources and risks. Chain cards in the stack to unleash powerful combos, balance your TOX bar to avoid running out of actions, and use Charge keywords to power up your Totems and claim victory. Each encounter rewards you with new resources, bonuses, and ways to expand your run. Build custom decks, unlock new cards, and uncover the mysteries hidden behind the Totems.

rows.name: Spacejet Pilot
rows.short_description: We meet a humanoid that has arrived on a mysterious alien island on a remote planet in a far away galaxy.  Help her explore.  Or take off in her Spacejet
rows.description_html: A Sci-Fi RPG on a small map.  We meet a humanoid that has arrived on a mysterious alien island on a remote planet in a far away galaxy.  Help her explore.  Meet some old friends.  Or take off in her Spacejet.  In this game you can explore a small map.  Basically you have a choice whether or not you want to walk around as my character The Spacejet Pilot or Fly.   The SJP's an Android many distant years in the future.  A future where anything technological is indescernable from magic.  None of that is in the game.  The game you just walk around this small map and maybe talk to some NPCs.  If you fall in a hole too bad there's no way out.  Controls are simple WASD and Space plus Esc to leave the hole you just fell into and go back to the menu where you can FLY.  Yes that's right.  Take off in the Spacejet.  Fly around a little.  There's not much else to do.  Enjoy the sunset I suppose.  Oh you can fight.  If that's what you're into.

rows.description_html: A Roguelike coin-flipper where your choices have a BIG impact. One wrong choice and you're bound to fail. Flip coins, upgrade them, flip them again, SCORE BIG!! Whether your build is based in luck, rapid coin flipping action or setting up the last turn for a massive point explosion, there's always a new way to play. With a crafted soundtrack and a unique pixel art style, you're bound to find yourself playing this game way past your bedtime. You're always one run away from a new high score. 5 original crafted music tracks A fun retro art style 30+ unique coin augments 100+ casual hours of fun This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.short_description: When the world ends, who will you spend your final hours with? A visual novel for the GBA.
rows.description_html: When the world ends, who will you spend your final hours with?  ───────────────────────────────── bygone snow is a visual novel for the GBA. The game was made in exactly two weeks. Features: A short story (around 30 minutes to an hour) about two people and their relationship as their time comes to an end. An original soundtrack by Kishan02 and Mireille Scieppan. This game is a ROM made for the GBA, and can thus be played on anything that plays GBA games. Windows emulated version that is set to try and visually mimic the looks of a GBA, and with controls set to mirror your typical PC visual novels.  ───────────────────────────────── This game is part of the Garenburg series, but it is a standalone title that requires no previous information to play.

rows.description_html: The Backrooms Deluxe 2 is a spin on The Backrooms Deluxe with new features such as: Modifiers Mix and match positive and negative effects that give you more or less Deluxe Coins at the end of your run. Much better multiplayer replication The entire game has been rewritten to support a much more seamless multiplayer experience.  More Achievements The game has received more achievements, as well as support for non-Steam achievements (only in the game but don't affect Steam progression) for harder challenges. Roguelite Elements Since the original game, permadeath has been added, which adds a new element of challenge as well as being able to earn Deluxe Coins without having to do a full run every time. All players have to die for the run to end.

Much better multiplayer replication The entire game has been rewritten to support a much more seamless multiplayer experience.  More Achievements The game has received more achievements, as well as support for non-Steam achievements (only in the game but don't affect Steam progression) for harder challenges. Roguelite Elements Since the original game, permadeath has been added, which adds a new element of challenge as well as being able to earn Deluxe Coins without having to do a full run every time. All players have to die for the run to end.

rows.name: Vacubot
rows.short_description: Vacubot is a fast-paced, top-down shooter. Players must survive increasingly challenging battlefields by using a variety of weapons to fight off swarming enemy robots and powerful bosses.
rows.description_html: A virus has corrupted a massive production robot, causing it to churn out hostile machines without end. The player must infiltrate the danger zone directly, destroy the endlessly pouring robots, and bring down the production robot—the source of chaos. - Overview Vacubot is a fast-paced, top-down shooter. The player uses a variety of weapons to face swarming enemy robots and must survive in increasingly challenging battlefields. As you fight stronger and stronger enemies, enhance your weapons and abilities, and challenge three mechanical bosses with powerful patterns. Dominating the battlefield is not just about reflexes but also about speed, weapons, and strategy. - Various Weapons Defeat enemies to collect coins and purchase new equipment at the weapon shop. The minigun unleashes a storm of bullets, the charge weapon delivers a devastating single shot, and the laser pierces through multiple enemies— each weapon provides unique performance and strategic options. - Various Enemies As battles progress, more difficult and powerful robots appear. From mobs that fire bullets in barrages, to laser shooters, armored types, splitting types, and enemies that explode upon death— new threats await in every battle. - Intense Boss Battles As the battles progress, three types of giant mechanical bosses appear one after another. Each boss tests the player with unique attack patterns and deadly techniques, Leaving no room for even a moment of carelessness.

rows.name: King's Devotion
rows.short_description: Experience a world broken by war with one hope of redemption. Follow the tale of a general whose loyalty is put to the test when his kingdom is thrown into shambles. Friends may become enemies, and enemies may turn to friends.
rows.description_html: Unique Real-time Combat King’s Devotion features combat like you’ve never seen before. Unleash combos upon your foes with intricate character kits, from devastating attacks to impenetrable defenses. With fast paced action, your strategy must be ever evolving to vanquish your enemies.  Engaging, Story-rich Campaign Experience a world broken by war with one hope of redemption. Follow the tale of a general whose loyalty is put to the test when his kingdom is thrown into shambles. Friends may become enemies, and enemies may turn to friends. The long standing kingdom of Arktiria faces its greatest peril yet. A new power has risen, a match for all the known realms together. Deceit and cunning have supplanted justice and truth. General Benaiah must find a way to overcome his enemy or become a martyr to his cause. But his greatest enemy is closer than he ever believed. 90+ Original Characters From the ever-warring nations of the Dohoda Heroes must arise amidst the chaos that plagues the land. Follow the stories of the loyal General Benaiah, the hopeful peasant Eloria, and other Heroes that will shape the future of their land and hearts, for good or ill. Each must make their own choice in the turbulent times, to choose between might or morality. Test Your Merit in Challenges Fight in epic duels to the death with expedited combat. Master your magic in a place that denies physical means of weaponry. Prove your worth by fighting the legendary Titan of Might, Kiros. Explore the forests of Muros, filled with powerful enemies, while earning artifacts of ancient strength. Experiment with a Plethora of Teams Lead your Heroes into action with a myriad of team combinations. From the uniform Humans of Arktiria, to the devious Dark Elves of Mavros, use cunning swordplay or mystical wizardry to defeat your adversaries. With a vast roster to choose from, you decide which synergies to explore.

rows.name: Palmier Island
rows.short_description: Cozy island RPG sim... but everyone only speaks French and you have to pay off your missing uncle's debt! Start a cafe, run a farm, fight demons in a school basement, go to court, and more as you discover each islander's lore and leave the island semi-fluent!
rows.description_html: PALMIER ISLAND is a cozy island RPG sim that tricks you into learning French through pure play and no curriculum. Plot: The economy is in shambles, and you're fresh outta college with no job and no prospects, so you fly to your millionaire uncle's island to catsit for the summer. However, when you arrive, you find out that all the islanders only speak French and you have to pay off your missing uncle's debt! Start a cafe, run a farm, fight demons in a school basement, go to court, and more as you discover each islander's lore and leave the island semi-fluent! Core Gameplay Mechanic: Learn French through our core gameplay mechanic, Chattle, which is like a Pokemon battle where your words are Pokemon. You capture words from the Chattle into your vocabulary to navigate each conversational puzzle.  Minigames: Test your guessing skills through multiple minigames, such as shopping with only French labels, baking treats by recognizing vocabulary, and exploring alternative Chattle routes.

rows.name: Archival Anemoia
rows.short_description: Welcome to Archival Anemoia, an archive of over 30 different games made over the course of around 13 years, all by one girl in her childhood, and all for free!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Archival Anemoia , an archive of over 30 different games made over the course of around 13 years, all by one girl in her childhood, and all for free! Archival Anemoia is a collection and museum of all sorts of different games by Mireille Scieppan over the span of a decade, as a celebration of Creatalsoftware's 10 year anniversary. From small prototypes and experimental learning projects to fully featured experiences with an overarching story, this bundles nearly every single game released under Creatalsoftware and then some. Several of the games have seen some improvements for this collection with being remastered or having additional quality of life added, helping modernize and bring more life into them. Features Over 30 different games across several different genres Several older games and projects made playable for the first time in years Some games games remastered or updated with new art, quality of life features, and bug fixes Several scrapped projects and prototypes, with many never before seen Information about the development of every game and scrapped project in the tour New arrangements of songs from the games in the collection Several different UI themes, with extras that can be unlocked based on save completion of Garenburg Woods or Garenburg Penitence Tons and tons of concept art made throughout the years Want to know what goes into making a game? Included with the collection is a museum tour giving developer commentary, context and background to all these games, with a retrospective years later on the process of making them. Insight into the development of games released separately from this collection, such as Garenburg Woods , Garenburg Penitence: The Riflebird , and  bygone snow , is also included. And to top it off are a bunch of concept art, info on scrapped ideas and prototypes for various other projects over the years! Charmolypi (2023) After a young and mysterious girl named Castranom arrives at a small hut near a lake occupied by recluse Afeil, the two begin a friendship and find solace in each other. As Castranom learns to fish at the lake, watch as the two grow closer and their own past come to light in a short little fishing game. A short and sweet fishing game that can be completed in a small amount of time. The game was originally made in a little under 2 weeks, but this re-release includes brand new artwork and fish to find. A spinoff of the Garenburg series. Kiffen & Maintane (2022) Help Kiffen & Maintane build a little house in a platforming experience, with online multiplayer support for up to four people! Gather materials and explore a small little world at your own leisure! The Möbius Strip (2019) A scientist, famous for making a sense-enhancing innovation, is recruited to work for the Silver Bed Foundation on a new project: a way to make immortality real. A short puzzle RPG with three major acts. Now including a built-in hints system for puzzles, and higher quality portraits. Part of the Garenburg series. Garenburg Penitence: Juniper Originally, the game Garenburg Penitence: The Riflebird was going to have a N3DS demake with unique levels, but it was scrapped back in 2022 with the console reaching its end of life. Now, take a look into the scrapped N3DS game with Garenburg Penitence: Juniper , ported back to PC and available to play exclusively through this collection! And more! Take a dive into several other projects, such as horror-puzzle RPG  Limp , the puzzle platformer  Twisted Mirror  and its sequel and remake, the 49 page story 'Project Gwenevere,' short stories and novellas from the Garenburg series, and much more! By no means are the games in this collection masterpieces. There are a lot of pretty badly made games in this set. But they were all made for fun and with a lot of love put into them, and are brought here to immortalize them in this bizarre little bundle. They aren't the bestest of games, but I hope you have fun taking a look at the weird stuff that's been made over the years in this collection. Thank you!!!

rows.name: 엉덩이 밀기! (Assslash!)
rows.short_description: Everyone, 'This isn't just a fight.' Get ready for the spectacular sight of adorable cute girls pushing each other off vibrant, flashy 3D stages using their 'Ultimate Butt Push' techniques. Download now and show off your 'Ultimate ASSS Power!' (Don't forget to time your moves just right.)
rows.description_html: We're excited to introduce you to a completely new kind of action game today. Get ready for the  Assslash! — The Butt-Bumping Bishōjo Battle Action Game ,  set against the vibrant backdrop of Korea —a game unlike anything you've ever played! This game is more than just a fighting game. Cute and distinctive bishōjo characters engage in a thrilling butt-bumping showdown in real-time across vibrant 3D environments! The combination of an eccentric concept and a deep storyline provides an exhilarating new action experience you've never encountered before. Core Game Features and Mechanics (Game Mechanics) This is a 1v1 casual action game that anyone can easily pick up and enjoy, regardless of complex controls. Full 3D Battle Action: Experience dynamic, real-time combat by directly controlling characters in gorgeous Unreal engine 5's 3D graphics . Casual Controls: Forget complex command inputs! All combat revolves around just two key actions: Dodge and Butt-Bump . We focused on the satisfying 'feel of the push' as you forcefully shove your opponent with a single button press. Unique Concept: This cheerful and original concept of settling scores with butts offers unexpected moments of reversal, bringing players both great laughter and excitement. Game Goal and Plot (Goal & Story) Dive into a bizarre yet profound story unfolding in the fictional city of Dalgu . Main Goal: Players team up with the NIS (National Intelligence Service) of Korea to punish the city's immoral and wicked individuals using the power of the butt . Solve the Mystery: Unravel the secrets behind the mysterious Butt-Rage Phenomenon sweeping the city and stop your friends who have been driven mad by this power. Deep Narrative: Beyond simple comedic action, the story delves into a profound and two-sided narrative as you confront a greater dark conspiracy lurking in the background. Main Challenges (Challenges) Can you defeat every enemy using only the power of the butt? Diverse Enemy Characters: A variety of enemies, each with their own traits and misdeeds, await you—from a School Principal and a Local Church Pastor to friends who have succumbed to the Butt-Rage. Special Attack Patterns: Every enemy character possesses unique attack patterns . Players must read and dodge these patterns and counter-attack using only the Butt-Bump control. Extreme Challenge: You'll even face enemies who wield guns . Can you truly decipher and destroy all enemy patterns using nothing but your butt and quick reflexes? Character Progression System (Character Progression) Experience new gameplay every time with a growth system featuring randomized elements. Random Supply Drops: After clearing each stage, you'll receive a supply drop from Officer Yook to help your character grow. Random Stat Growth: Your character possesses four stats: STR (Strength) , CON (Concentration) , LUK (Luck) , and SPD (Speed) . Receiving the random supply drops means these stats will grow randomly . Infinite Replayability: Since your character develops differently with every attempt, you'll enjoy a roguelike sense of fun and face a new challenge each time you play. Playtime and Sound (Playtime & Full-Sound) Standard Playtime: The standard playthrough for the core story and missions provides a highly immersive experience lasting approximately 1 hour to 1 hour and 30 minutes . Complete Korean Voice Acting: Nearly all dialogue from the characters has been completely recorded in Korean . Experience the passionate performances of the amazing voice actors and dive deeper into the story! Supported Languages (Support Languages) This game supports translation for global players in four languages: Korean , Japanese , English , and Spanish . - The moment you push your opponent away with a simple button press, you'll feel both awe and laughter! With comical attacks and unpredictable comeback moments, playing with friends, family, or partners is sure to create some truly fun memories.

rows.name: Miiridian Prime
rows.short_description: Miiridian Prime is a free-to-play class-based third-person PvP arena where nine unique heroes battle across surreal arenas, combining melee and ranged combat, vertical movement, and team strategy.
rows.description_html: Enter the world of Miiridian Prime, a free-to-play, class-based third-person PvP battle arena set in a striking science-fantasy universe. Every hero is unique, with their own class, abilities, and combat style, and victory belongs only to those who adapt, master their playstyle, and outthink their rivals. EARLY ACCESS BETA This is the Early Access Beta version of Miiridian Prime — an evolving experience where your feedback and participation will help shape the future of the game . During this phase, players can expect regular updates introducing new heroes, arenas, and gameplay features , as well as ongoing balance adjustments and performance improvements. Join early, share your insights, and become part of the community defining what Miiridian Prime will become. MASTER THE ART OF HEROES Miiridian Prime features nine unique heroes , each with their own class, combat style, and set of abilities. No hero is alike — every champion carries a distinct role on the battlefield and a different path to victory. All heroes wield both melee and ranged weapons, creating powerful combinations for every encounter. Some rely on speed and aggression, others on strategy and battlefield control, while a few stand as the unbreakable shield of their team. With every update, new heroes, abilities, and playstyles will expand the roster — keeping the game fresh and every battle unforgettable. MOVEMENT AS A WEAPON Verticality defines combat in Miiridian Prime. The grappling hook changes how you approach every fight — helping you escape danger, close in on distant opponents, seize high ground, or strike from unexpected angles. True mastery lies not only in combat but also in movement. Those who control space, control the outcome. CHOOSE YOUR BATTLEFIELD Miiridian Prime delivers multiple ways to prove your skill: Free-for-all battles with up to 8 players, where survival is the only law. 4v4 team clashes that reward coordination and smart tactics. 1v1 duels — the ultimate showdown, hero against hero, with nowhere to hide. Objective-driven encounters where capturing zones and completing missions under pressure is the key to victory. Each mode challenges you in different ways, pushing your adaptability and keeping every fight fresh. EVOLVING ARENAS Arenas are more than just backdrops — they shape the flow of combat. Collapsing bridges, explosive traps, and shifting terrain demand constant adaptation, turning the battlefield itself into a weapon. PROGRESSION & STYLE Forge your legacy with progression and customization: Unlock new heroes and abilities Climb competitive leaderboards Personalize your champions with distinctive skins and cosmetics Every match brings progress, rewards, and new ways to stand out. A LIVING, SURREAL WORLD Miiridian Prime blends surreal beauty with impossible architecture: Floating islands and ancient ruins steeped in mystery Striking visuals and reactive effects that bring combat to life A hybrid electronic-orchestral soundtrack that intensifies the action Impactful sound design that makes every clash feel real JOIN THE FIGHT Miiridian Prime is constantly evolving, with new heroes, arenas, and features added regularly. Step into the surreal battlefield, master your class, and claim your place among legends.

PROGRESSION & STYLE Forge your legacy with progression and customization: Unlock new heroes and abilities Climb competitive leaderboards Personalize your champions with distinctive skins and cosmetics Every match brings progress, rewards, and new ways to stand out. A LIVING, SURREAL WORLD Miiridian Prime blends surreal beauty with impossible architecture: Floating islands and ancient ruins steeped in mystery Striking visuals and reactive effects that bring combat to life A hybrid electronic-orchestral soundtrack that intensifies the action Impactful sound design that makes every clash feel real JOIN THE FIGHT Miiridian Prime is constantly evolving, with new heroes, arenas, and features added regularly. Step into the surreal battlefield, master your class, and claim your place among legends.

rows.name: Gilroy's Grove
rows.short_description: Step into the forest where your shovel is both your weapon and lifeline. Fight back against twisted forest creatures, claim their corrupted seeds, and bring them to your farm and grow your weapons. Restore the forest plant by plant, Will you break the curse, or will the forest claim you too?
rows.description_html: The forest won’t give up its secrets easily. monstrous creatures stand between you and the truth behind the corruption. Cut down what blocks your path, uncover hidden items, and unlock new areas within the forest. Your land is corrupting. Fight back with your shovel, your wits, and the seeds left behind by your enemies. Grow, harvest, and turn the plant life into your weapons. The forest doesn't just have corrupted creatures but also has towering bosses that stand in your way. Each boss is a twisted part of the curse, with unique mechanics and devastating attacks.  -3 Regions to explore-  -3 Bosses to fights-  -3 New plants to fight per region-  -A bunch of questionable weapons-

rows.name: The Roach Hotel
rows.short_description: The Roach Hotel is a first person analog horror game that drags you into its halls, where every shadow hides a question and every corner dares you to keep following its path.
rows.description_html: Disclaimer:  Purchase of this base game includes the first chapter. Further chapters will be coming soon. The Roach Hotel is an analog horror game set inside a once beloved hotel, a paradise for guest to come stay and relax. Step into its halls brought to life with a retro PS1 inspired aesthetic and unsettling VHS style visuals. THE HOTEL STORY: Welcome to the Oxley Hotel, a resort that promises comfort to every guest. But behind its doors, the walls move when you’re not watching, and something stalks you in the shadows. Guided only by a note from your missing sister, you must uncover the truth, survive the lurking hallways, and escape the roaches crawling beneath the hotel. Search for your sister and uncover the secrets buried beneath the Oxley Hotel. Discover what truly began this nightmare, but only if you step inside. Are you brave enough? ARRIVAL IN THE HOTEL: EXPLORE: Wander the halls and uncover the unsettling secrets lurking within the hotel’s walls. Reveal the hidden truths buried within the hotel’s halls and discover behind the chaos. FLASHLIGHT : Use your trusted flash light to see in the dark halls of the hotel. Be careful in the dark, there might be roaches under your feet. HAMMER : This can come in handle to break things. Could also be useful to squish those big roaches. GRAVITYPAL : Use this tool to move heavier objects to solve puzzles. Solve puzzles to unlock rooms or power up failed generators in the hotel. Why is it so complicated for power? SECRETS Deep below the Hotel you could find easter eggs or back story lore behind the secrets of the hotel. So search every corner and clean every room to see what you can find. Just be careful for any jump scares.

rows.name: Weabot
rows.short_description: Control a flying drone, possess other robots, and solve environmental puzzles in a mysterious world full of hidden challenges.
rows.description_html: Dive into an environmental puzzle game where logic and exploration guide your every step. You play as a small flying drone with a unique ability: hacking into and taking control of other robots you encounter along the way. Each robot comes with different skills that you must use to overcome obstacles, activate mechanisms, and solve increasingly complex puzzles. This demo features 4 handcrafted levels , with the first one serving as a tutorial to introduce the core mechanics. The playtime ranges from 40 to 60 minutes , depending on how much you explore—those who dig deeper will also find hidden optional puzzles that expand the experience. Whether you aim straight for the goal or take your time uncovering every secret, each level is crafted to spark curiosity and creativity. Key Features Play as a flying drone with the ability to control other robots. Use each robot’s unique abilities to solve environmental puzzles. Explore 4 handcrafted levels , including a tutorial introduction. Find hidden optional puzzles for players who love to explore. Find all the chests and collectibles

rows.name: Split Racing
rows.short_description: Arcade racing meets time-attack shooting. Fight off gun-wielding enemy cars and hazard-spawned chasing drones to earn extra time and finish the track. Solo or local 2-player co-op (driver/gunner split). 4 tracks, weapons: Laser Beam & Charge Shot.
rows.description_html: Split Racing blends time-attack racing with vehicle shooting . Your goal: finish before the timer expires . Destroy enemy cars or manage road hazards to survive—takedowns add time . Play solo (drive + shoot) or local split-screen co-op where one player drives and the other focuses on gunning. Key Features Genre : Arcade racing + shooting (time extension via takedowns) Core Loop : Tight timer → destroy enemies to gain time → manage the clock and clear Modes : Solo / Local 2-player split-screen (driver/gunner roles) Content : 4 tracks total (3 regular + 1 boss) Combat & Weapons Laser Beam : continuous fire for steady damage Charge Shot : high single-shot damage after charging Enemies & Hazards Gun-equipped enemy cars : patrol the road and shoot at the player; takedowns grant time Road hazards : stepping on them spawns chasing drones that pursue and attack Challenge Pillars Tight timer, enemy interference, drone pressure, racing line and firing-angle decisions Scope & Transparency Included : Solo, local split-screen co-op, 4 tracks, Laser Beam & Charge Shot Not Included : Online multiplayer, progression systems, deep customization, story-driven cutscenes

rows.name: The Predecessor
rows.short_description: Exploration-focused walking simulator. Traverse abstract worlds. Interact with enigmatic characters. Collect memories from the one who came before you.
rows.description_html: The Predecessor  is an atmospheric, surreal walking simulator. Traverse a series of abstract, ephemeral worlds. Interact with various strange characters and objects. Collect artifacts and memories scattered across the worlds. Follow the path of the one who came before you. This game engages in themes including the postmodern pastiche, artistic intent, and the presence of virtual spaces. Features Abstract and surreal environments to explore! Esoteric and silly characters who talk about things! Items which shed light on the world and its formation. Strong emphasis on narrative and atmosphere. A fairly short experience (1-2 hours). Worlds that will not last.

rows.name: The Mushroom Journal
rows.short_description: The Mushroom Journal is a Single-Player RPG, that takes you on an adventure to Mush Meadows. Mush Meadows is a mushroom-centered village, where you will have to help your neighbours by identifying and collecting them to uncover the mysteries that may lie under trading table.
rows.description_html: You’ve moved to Mush Meadows to recover from burnout from the city and working life. By selling all your belongings, you set out to start a new life closer to nature and buy a cabin that has been abandoned for a while. You discover that the cabin used to belong to a mushroom enthusiast, and they left their basket and unfinished journal there, among other things. It almost looks like they’ve just disappeared and when browsing through the journal, you notice some pages missing or unfinished... Roam around the beautiful woodlands, find mushrooms, and use your Mushroom Journal to identify mushrooms by selecting the correct traits. Look for the characteristics of the cap, gills and stem, and remember: you may only pick mushrooms if you're 100% sure of them! The small community of Mush Meadows relies on the mushrooms for food, trade and medicine. They welcome you, and are eager to help you, it has been a long time since an “outsider” was among them. Go introduce yourself, and you might find yourself on a journey of new friendships, fulfilling the requests of your new neighbors. The Mushroom Journal was created as a student project within the duration of three months. We carefully crafted our concept, produced all art and audio for the game ourselves, and were able to deliver our project we're incredibly proud of. Alexandra ; art & animation Dániel János Simon ; game designer & audio designer Emilia Kurkela ; art, VFX & UI Sari Ala-Ukko ; level design, narrative writer & composer Tua Nylund ; programming & implementation

rows.name: Tackle Box: The First Catch
rows.short_description: Tackle Box is a fast-paced fishing and fighting game where every catch wants to beat you up and drag you into the lake before you smack it with a rod. Cast your line, and get ready to throw hands with aquatic wildlife that absolutely did not evolve for peaceful coexistence.
rows.description_html: In Tackle Box , you play as John Tacklebox – a grizzled fisherman, quiet and stubborn as the sea itself. Your village has emptied over the years, leaving you alone with your memories, your rod, and the ocean. But when you enter a legendary fishing competition, the fight for survival begins. FISHING MEETS FIGHTING Catch fish. Fight fish. Win fights. Catch bigger fish. Repeat until your arms fall off. TIGHT, SIMPLE COMBAT Punch. Dodge. Block. Slam fish into the dirt. The controls are easy to learn and satisfying every time you land a hit. BOSS FISH WITH ATTITUDE Face a lineup of over-the-top fighters, each with their own moves and personality. Every boss has unique mechanics and a desire to ruin your day. Each boss has quotes guaranteed to make you question buying this game: “YOU WILL BE FISHED.” EXPLORE, CATCH, BRAWL Travel through lakes, rivers, and oceans to find new fish to fight and new ways to get beaten up by wildlife. Think you're the best angler in the valley? Prove it.

rows.name: ScrapBots
rows.short_description: Student Game Project- ScrapBots is a first person melee brawler where you venture through a forgotten, rusted trash planet and engage in hand-to-hand combat to fight for survival. Turn your enemies into scrap and repurpose their body parts to empower and augment your own combat abilities.
rows.description_html: ScrapBots is a first-person melee brawler developed by a team of nine undergraduate game development students at the Savannah College of Art and Design (SCAD). Designed as our capstone project, our goal was to show off our strengths while learning and growing as game designers in the process. ScrapBots is set on an abandoned junk planet inhabited by ruthless robots tearing each other apart. The player takes control of a robot named Junk Dog, a hermit on a quest to defeat the leader of the most powerful faction in the wasteland. Use junk dogs’ unique function of interchangeable arms and other combat capabilities to help survive the savage bots of the wasteland. Fast First-Person Combat: Use both fists to box other bots into scrap. Take their left-over arms to fuel Junk dog’s rampage across the wasteland. Interchangeable Arms: Equip a variety of arms from Junk dog’s defeated enemies, each with unique punches and stats. Mix arms to find the best play style for the situation. Environmental Traps: Scattered across the wasteland are dangerous traps junk dog can leverage to speed up his killing. Movement abilities: Dash around the enemy to stay in the fight longer and help get across the wasteland terrain. Will you scrap your enemies or become scrap yourself?

rows.name: EcoBeat
rows.short_description: Tap to the beat, clean the sea! Turn your rhythm into oxygen.
rows.description_html: EcoBeat is a rhythm-based plogging game where players clean the ocean by tapping to the beat. Set against a vibrant shoreline, EcoBeat turns environmental action into a stylized musical journey, combining the thrill of rhythm games with a mission to restore our oceans. 🌊 The Ocean Gives Us Oxygen Did you know that over 50% of the oxygen we breathe comes from the ocean? In EcoBeat, every piece of trash you collect helps regenerate marine life and boost oxygen levels. The more you clean, the more the sea heals, and the more rhythm you unlock. 🎵 Rhythm Meets Responsibility Inspired by OSU-style gameplay, players tap along to catchy beats as they collect trash swept along the tide. Time your taps perfectly to chain combos, earn points, and bring the ocean back to life. 🎮 Core Features Tap-to-the-beat rhythm gameplay with a unique ocean clean-up theme Immersive art and sound that reflect the health of the sea Playable without internet—anytime, anywhere Tracks that evolve with your progress—unlock new music and zones A peaceful but engaging gameplay experience that supports environmental awareness 🌱 Game With Purpose EcoBeat isn’t just about rhythm;it’s about rhythm with meaning. We believe small actions can lead to big change. Whether you’re a rhythm game pro or new to the genre, EcoBeat offers a joyful, healing way to play for the planet. Break the silence. Beat for the Earth. Clean the sea. One tap at a time.

rows.name: Around - The Game
rows.short_description: Step into a haunted mansion where reality bends. Solve chilling puzzles, offer cherries to speak with the Fiend, and escape before you're consumed by the nightmare.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Mansion. It’s Watching. In Around , you awaken inside a sprawling, decaying mansion that twists in impossible ways. Doors lead back to where you started, corridors stretch into darkness, and something is always just out of sight. Explore the shifting halls as you uncover forgotten memories, solve cryptic puzzles, and collect mysterious cherries—the only way to communicate with the ominous Fiend stalking the shadows. Speak carefully… the Fiend listens. But beware: the mansion is alive. It warps and twists the more you discover. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to tell what’s real and what’s a trap. Key Features:  Atmospheric exploration of a haunted, shifting mansion  Unique puzzles that challenge perception and memory  A lurking presence that reacts to your actions  Use cherries to speak with the Fiend—or risk drawing its attention  Looping, reality-bending level design with psychological horror elements  Immersive sound design and whispers in the dark

rows.name: Million Card Game
rows.short_description: Compete with 1-5 players in this interactive cozy indie card game! Strategize table layouts and hand placement in order to be the first top win!
rows.description_html: Million Card Game is a card game played between 1-5 players with the main objective being to be the first to get rid of all the cards in your hand! Place cards in the table either using same rank sandwiches of cards or runs of the same suit. Players are able to temporarily take cards from already placed groups on the table in order to make group in their hand allowing for dynamic and fun gameplay. The game features a tutorial. Single player bot mode and local multiplayer up to 5 players!

rows.name: Perciflette
rows.short_description: Welcome, future hero! Perciflette is a narrative adventure with a simple goal : Find the way out. Explore, move forward with caution, and make the right choices…or start over!
rows.description_html: WELCOME, FUTURE HERO! Tired of grandma’s farm, you can sens it: time has come for you to set out on an adventure. You have no idea what you’ll find out there: incredible treasures, brave folks waiting for a hero to save them, epic quests revealing your courage, or something else … It’s up to you to discover it all… No matter what, move forward with caution and make the right choices… or start over! A TEXT-BASED ADVENTURE WHERE YOU LEARN FROM YOUR MISTAKES Perciflette is a die-and-retry game, so your (bad) choices will be fatal. No save, no checkpoint, stay focused, or you might end up missing grandma’s farm. And for the true adventurers hungry for glory : we even prepared some achievements just for you. WITH MUSIC BY ALEXANDER NAKARADA You’ll spend some time trying to reach the exit. So we needed music you never get tired of. And Alexander Nakarada’s work was exactly what we were looking for. A LITTLE BACKSTORY Perciflette was born 5 years ago during a Game Jam. In 3 days, we imagined the story, developed the mechanics, created the designs, and all of it formed this adventure. A few years later, we had the crazy idea to take the project all the way and publish it here.

rows.name: Castle Femdom: Office Bot
rows.short_description: Satisfy your human 💃 owner as a robot 💀 assistant in this VR Femdom experience. Become her cog 👠 in the machine and learn your ♥️ place ♥️ as a cleaning and pleasure servant in an office 🏢 environment. Can you learn how to please your hot demonic boss?
rows.description_html: Sold and delivered to the office of a business executive, you are to become her new personal AI robot assistant. She dislikes robots, so you must prove yourself useful if you want to survive. FEEL HER DOMINANCE She might not like robots, but she enjoys being in control. Can you learn to worship her as an obedient servant, or will you run out of battery before she 'forgets' to recharge them? FREE AND KINKY As a learning project towards bigger things (follow @somecastle), this game is free! Simply clean the office from dirt and keep track of your hand indicators (battery and relationship) to gradually unlock scenes with her. Domestic servitude Owner/property Humiliation Feet Face-sitting BECOME HER BOT  A simple high quality simulation of a cruel but gentle female domination experience. This short game is our first attempt at an immersive VR Femdom experience, with progression, gameplay, and physical simulations that matter. Remember that you can always quit the game if it makes you uncomfortable.

rows.name: Humanoid
rows.short_description: Humanoid is a parody sci-fi arcade-style run-and-gun shoot 'em up in the style of an early 8-bit arcade game—with the added bonus that you can actually win. To survive, you need to play aggressively: you're rewarded for acting fast and clearing rooms. It is simple to play, difficult to win.
rows.description_html: Your challenge in HUMANOID is to escape a robot factory, destroying as many robots as you can and taking out the controllers before they launch an attack on Earth. Run through the maze blasting robots, but don't touch the walls—they're electrified! The factory contains 81 rooms to explore as you search for keys that unlock new areas. Clearing a room powers you up for the next one, but leaving too many robots alive will spawn deadly rocket robots. Take too long in a room and a Controller Demon will appear to chase you out. HUMANOID is a parody sci-fi arcade-style run-and-gun shoot 'em up in the spirit of early 8-bit arcade games—with the added bonus that you can actually win. To survive, you need to play aggressively: you're rewarded for acting fast and clearing rooms. Simple to play, difficult to master. The path you take is up to you. rows.about_html: Your challenge in HUMANOID is to escape a robot factory, destroying as many robots as you can and taking out the controllers before they launch an attack on Earth. rows.name: Grove of the Felled Olives
rows.short_description: Grove of the Felled Olives is a free virtual memorial dedicated to the over 60,000 humans killed in Gaza between Oct '23 and July '25. Pay respects to each of the departed in a peaceful refuge for their memory.
rows.description_html: Grove of the Felled Olives is a virtual memorial dedicated to the humans killed in Gaza between Oct '23 and July '25. This is the desktop version of the memorial. It is presented here as an offline experience for greater accessibility and fidelity. No such physical memorial recognizing each individual exists as of yet. Pay respects to each of the over 60,000 departed in a peaceful refuge for their memory. Come back at any point to pick up where you left off - every session in the grove begins at a new location. The grove includes a single memorial for the countless lives that remain unaccounted for. I made this memorial to humanize the statistics and provide an accessible experience for people across the world to honor those lost. I hope this can be a respectful place for loved ones and strangers alike to reflect on our shared humanity. May we learn one day to be better. -Nick Oueijan (a human being) The experience is simple yet powerful Walk through a peaceful virtual memorial Approach each of over 60,000 monuments to acknowledge the identity of the real people who they commemorate Move at your own pace Contemplate life, humanity, family, love, responsibility, scale, loss.... With atmospheric original music by Test Collage Data last updated on July 31st, 2025   Due to the limitations of ensuring the in-browser version of the memorial continues to smoothly on most mobile devices, this offline desktop version contains more up to date data . Data from Gaza's Ministry of Health provided by Tech for Palestine. I am but one person - if you encounter any technical issues, let me know and I'll do my best to resolve them.

rows.name: Hello my World! Lily.
rows.short_description: 'Hello my World! Lily.' is a visual novel about a programmer who finds an unusual way to cope with loneliness and routine. But after a while, his imagination and actions go too far, and the line between reality and fantasy begins to melt rapidly.
rows.description_html: Description: In this visual novel, the protagonist is a programmer named Alexey, whose life is drowning in the gray routine of loneliness. Tired of the endless monotony, he imagines an ideal girl, Lily, and immerses himself with her in the illusory world of a sanatorium. But over time, these fantasies expand beyond mere dreams, blurring the boundaries between reality and illusion. A story about internal conflict and the search for harmony with oneself! Game Features: A rare Tulpa game. Two main characters in the story: Alex, Lily Kinetic story. A short, captivating story (approximately 2 hours to complete). Visual style of old novels. Scriptwriter: Kket. Artists: heartwarming sprites by ppipiduster, mesmerizing dove art by luos_arts, CG art by Black on White and deathwarr. Russian voice actors by Anijoy: Alexey is Evgeny Valdanov (ShadowWarrior), and Lily is Elizaveta Dobrovolskaya (jujlu). Composers: atmospheric music by That Guy From 2015 and mc.dummy.

rows.name: Starbrew Station
rows.short_description: Build the galaxy's most efficient coffee production outpost in this sci-fi idle game. Recruit 33 unique alien workers, automate operations across 6 industrial decks, and push your station to the limit during Rush Hour surges. Prestige and expand through multiple progression systems.
rows.description_html: Your production quota awaits. In Starbrew Station, you're the operations manager of a remote coffee production outpost on the edge of known space. One rickety brewing machine. Zero workers. Can you scale this operation into a galaxy-supplying caffeine empire? SCALE YOUR OPERATION Start by manually brewing your first few coffees, then recruit a quirky crew of 33 unique alien workers to automate every step of your operation. Baristas brew the coffee. Technicians install machines. Traders generate passive income. Support units boost production. Fighters defend your station. Expand across 6 visually distinct decks : the industrial Engineering bay, the lush Hydroponics garden, the plasma-powered Reactor level, the exclusive VIP lounge, and the Administrative command deck. Each new deck unlocks more powerful units and multiplies your entire station's output. MAXIMIZE OUTPUT Active management pays off. Every 8 minutes, the station enters Rush Hour . For 45 seconds, all machines run at infinite capacity and your earnings double. Watch ships fly past your station as you capitalize on the surge. When your output is high enough, face one of 8 randomized Galactic Inspector variants in a unique boss fight. Deploy your fighter units, click frantically, and prove your station is worthy of prestige. PRESTIGE AND MASTER YOUR PLAYSTYLE Defeat the Inspector, reset your run, and earn Prestige Tokens . But this isn't just 'buy upgrades in order.' It's about building YOUR strategy. Choose Your Mastery Path: Automation Mastery - Boost trader income, technician speed, and offline production Active Mastery - Enhance rewards, frozen aliens, morale, and rush duration Combat Mastery - Increase fighter damage, shrine power, and boss click damage Chase Long-Term Milestones: 7 prestige milestones (at prestiges 3, 5, 10, 15, 25, 50, and 100) unlock permanent bonuses: extra tokens per run, new modifiers, the challenge system, and exclusive cosmetics. Take On Optional Challenges: After Prestige 15, activate up to 2 challenges per run for bonus tokens. Complete a prestige in under 15 minutes. Beat the boss without shrines. Use only traders. Risk versus reward. DEEP PROGRESSION SYSTEMS Prestige tokens are just the beginning. Multiple progression layers work together to create weeks of meaningful growth: R&D Wing - Allocate income to unlock 17 permanent quality-of-life and power upgrades Unit Specialization - Level up workers and choose between two unique upgrade paths per unit type Deck Synergies - Unlock cross-deck bonuses that keep early content relevant in late game Shrines - Enhance your fighters with damage, speed, and critical hit bonuses Achievement Buffs - 22 achievements grant unique permanent bonuses to production, clicks, and more Daily Streaks - Claim rewards daily with multipliers up to 4x Chase the ultimate goal: amass enough tokens to unlock the legendary Golden Barista , a unit that will transform your output forever. ROGUELIKE VARIETY Each prestige run features random modifiers , one positive and one negative, that change your strategy. Production Surge or Economic Crunch? Rush Hour Boost or Slow Start? No two runs feel identical, and smart players adapt their approach. TAKE A BREAK Step away from the production floor with unlockable bonus minigames : Basketball - Aim and shoot for high scores Pachinko - Drop balls and watch chaos unfold Botanical Garden - Grow and harvest plants for rewards Decorate your station with 25+ unique decorations themed to each deck. Make your outpost your own. GUIDED BY ARIA Your station AI, ARIA, walks you through every system with dark humor and dynamic expressions . She'll celebrate your victories, mock your failures, and make sure you never feel lost, even when the Inspector is breathing down your neck. BUILT FOR EVERYONE Streamers: Optional Twitch integration displays viewer names on your units and rewards chat activity. Accessibility: Full support for 28 languages, colorblind modes, controller navigation, camera shake toggle, and multiple number notation formats. Premium Polish: Bloom effects, ambient cosmic particles, screen shake feedback, and smooth UI transitions create a satisfying, polished experience. Fair and Complete: Starbrew Station is 100% free-to-play and designed to be completed without spending money. Optional cosmetic DLC and a few balanced gameplay units are available for players who wish to support development.

rows.name: OPEN YOUR EYES
rows.short_description: Fix your gaze on this grid-based puzzle game as you progress through levels by opening every eye. Discover eyes of different styles and properties and earn top ranks by focusing your vision and clearing stages with the least possible moves.
rows.description_html: OPEN YOUR EYES is a grid-based puzzle game about perception, logic, and discovery. Each level challenges you to open every eye on the board, but the rules change as new eyes are introduced. Some eyes open with a simple click, while others react to lasers, electricity, or the passage of time. To succeed, you must think ahead, manipulate interactions, and plan your moves with precision. Across 19 handcrafted levels, new mechanics are layered in to create increasingly complex puzzles. Clear each stage in the fewest possible moves to earn top ranks, and test how clearly you can see the solution. With its neon glow and surreal eye motifs, OPEN YOUR EYES offers a puzzle experience that is both logical and dreamlike. 19 handcrafted levels with escalating complexity 7 unique eye types , each with distinct rules and interactions Additional objects like redirectors to manipulate puzzle flow Ranking system (C to S) rewarding efficiency and intentional play A surreal neon aesthetic blending mysticism and minimalism 'This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.'

rows.name: If you’re a man, hold on for half a song
rows.short_description: This is an action shooter with extremely simple controls.Its gameplay duration is short but concise, with no filler content at all.The levels seem simple yet hide subtle twists, and there are plenty of little surprises waiting for you to discover!Anyway, it’s free—you can’t go wrong with it.
rows.description_html: Are you a man? If you are, hold on for the duration of half a song! In this game, players will play as a small square, dodging and defeating enemies within half a song’s time. As the difficulty increases, the excitement also increases! Feel free to take on the challenge! Game features: Simple yet smooth controls Awesome special effects 3 difficulty levels to suit all types of players 3 distinctively styled artifact weapons and 12 artifact accessories for you to mix and match The songs in the game are really catchy! Play the game while listening to the music Author's note: This is my first project while learning the Godot engine. I wanted to challenge myself to create a small game using mostly Godot's built-in assets. This game is free, and I hope everyone can show more support and come to love it.

rows.name: Jurassic Wrap
rows.short_description: Rescue baby dino eggs in a family-friendly adventure made by a father & son duo. In Jurassic Wrap, your goal is simple: save the baby dino eggs and make it safely to the exit portal. Along the way you’ll leap, dodge, and use clever screen-wrapping mechanics to outsmart threats through each level.
rows.description_html: Step back into the prehistoric age for a short, light-hearted rescue mission! In Jurassic Wrap, your goal is simple: save the baby dinosaur eggs and make it safely to the exit portal. Along the way you’ll leap, dodge, and use clever screen-wrapping mechanics to outsmart threats and discover new ways through each level. This isn’t about fighting dinosaurs — it’s about protecting them! With colourful visuals, approachable gameplay, and just the right amount of danger, Jurassic Wrap is fun for kids, families, and anyone who loves classic arcade-style platformers. Features: 🥚 Rescue the Eggs – Collect baby dinosaur eggs to complete each level. 🔄 Screen-Wrap Gameplay – Walk off one side of the screen and pop back on the other! 🦖 Face Prehistoric Dangers – Avoid hazards and threats while finding the exit. 👨‍👦 Made by a Father & Son Duo – A unique project created with love and heart. 🎮 Family-Friendly Fun – Easy to play, fun to master, and safe for kids. 🌍 Classic Arcade Vibes – Simple controls, colourful visuals, and timeless gameplay.

rows.name: Project Homecoming Haven
rows.short_description: Embark on a heartwarming journey as a home cleaning specialist.
rows.description_html: A Toge Greenhouse Project Project Homecoming Haven was created during Toge Greenhouse 2023, an internal game jam held by Toge Productions to create new, innovative, and experimental games. This is a short playable rendition of the game with the intention to blossom the idea within a relatively short development time. Project Homecoming Haven At Your Service “We know how hard it is, to see your beloved ones leave. To see the room they’ve left, their space without their presence. You don’t have to face the grief alone. We can help you. With Homecoming Haven Trauma Cleaners, we can help you clean up rooms full of memories too painful to look at and save you from the grief of facing the space initially left by your loved ones. You don’t have to face everything by yourself. Let us help you.” The Gameplay Play as a Trauma Cleaner; a housecleaning service that receives requests from bereaving families to clean up rooms and houses left by the deceased.  In your job, you will learn about those who left the world of their own volition or others. Learn about the life they lived, choose belongings of the deceased to be given to their families, or keep them for yourself to grow your Trauma Cleaning business. Uncover Hidden Stories The environment of each home tells a unique story about the homeowner's life and experiences. Items Reveal Stories Items found in the homes provide further insights into the homeowners' lives and relationships. Choices Affect Storytelling Players' decisions regarding give or kept items can influence the storytelling and reveal additional narrative elements. Control Info

rows.name: Project KILLDANCE
rows.short_description: Project KILLDANCE is a Noir tactical action featuring a one-army strategy and instant-death combat. Slowly observe surroundings, choreograph each killing move, leave no survivor, and become the spectral death.
rows.description_html: A Toge Greenhouse Project Project KILLDANCE was created during Toge Greenhouse 2023, an internal game jam held by Toge Productions to create new, innovative, and experimental games. Become the spectral death A Noir tactical action game featuring a one-army strategy and instant-death combat. Slowly observe your surroundings, choreograph each killing move, finish your mission, and leave no survivors. Features Plan your movement and perform your attack cards to clear each stage. Time is frozen in between your actions, use this opportunity to dodge bullets, take cover, and kill enemies effectively. Draft new cards to learn new skills and adapt to your missions. Once you complete your mission, replay your performance and watch your KILLDANCE.

rows.name: Party Party Anxiety!
rows.short_description: A dating card game for anxious people. Use conversation cue cards up your sleeves to make connections. But beware—the more anxious you get, the scarier they become.
rows.description_html: A Toge Greenhouse Project Party Party Anxiety! was created during Toge Greenhouse 2023, an internal game jam held by Toge Productions to create new, innovative, and experimental games. Anxiety at the Party Step into the shoes of a person battling social anxiety at a prom party. Meet people and play your cards correctly to respond to their conversation. Play the correct cards to establish relationships or play them wrong and everything will become scarier and haunt your social anxiety even more. Play cards to strike conversation Use conversation cue cards up your sleeves to make connections. Identify and follow your conversation partner's interests. Play card combos to better match the flow and gain the best compatibility rating! Feel the horror of talking to people But beware, you only have so much opportunity to strike the best conversation. Play your cards wrong and your partner might haunt your anxiety even more. Maybe it's all in your head. Manage and play your cards correctly, and if you can pull through, maybe it's all just in your head and people aren't that scary after all :)

rows.name: Rewoven Self
rows.short_description: Rewoven Self is a 2.5D side-scrolling narrative puzzle game where fantasy and reality intertwine. Through folding, cutting, and stitching, you rebuild yourself in a cycle of brokenness and renewal — a gentle yet profound journey of emotional healing.
rows.description_html: Rewoven Self is a dual-perspective narrative puzzle game that combines first-person interaction with 2.5D platform exploration . You move between two connected spaces — reality and fantasy. Actions in the real world, such as folding, cutting, and stitching, influence the journey of the paper figure in the fantasy world, gradually guiding the protagonist toward emotional repair and self-growth. The story unfolds across three chapters, following the arc of Escape – Collapse – Reweaving: Chapter I – “Escape into Fantasy” You build a personal fantasy world through folding — hiding emotions inside a paper-shaped space and using imagination to resist the loneliness of the real room. Chapter II – “Reality Cages Cage” The fantasy starts to fall apart. Caught between ideals and reality, the protagonist reaches the edge of emotional breakdown. Chapter III – “Fantasy & Reality Reweaving” You stitch the two worlds back together. While repairing emotions, you also face choices and actions in reality — no longer escaping, but moving forward with fantasy as part of yourself. The game focuses on non-combat puzzles, combining side-scrolling platforming with first-person real-world interactions to portray an emotional journey from escape → struggle → reweaving. Developer’s Note I want players to feel the weight of emotion through interaction, not just watch it. Rewoven Self is a journey from fantasy to reality, from avoidance to integration. Using folding to build a fragile refuge, cutting to break through what holds you back, and stitching to reconnect everything into a whole. For me, this game is more than a project — it is a process of understanding, repairing, and starting again. When you walk out of that final door, I hope you carry your own sense of wholeness and reweave the world in your own way. Contact Email : tangyuanyuan0329@163.com

rows.name: Ravenmoore Psychiatric Hospital
rows.short_description: Explore an oppressive and terrifying environment where you play as a young man who infiltrates the old and abandoned Ravenmoore Psychiatric Hospital in search of the harsh reality hidden behind this place. Every sound can be a sign of danger... Don't let them find you, and especially not HER......
rows.description_html: Ravenmoore Psychiatric Hospital: Enter an oppressive and terrifying environment where you play as a young man who infiltrates the old and abandoned Ravenmoore Psychiatric Hospital in search of the harsh reality hidden behind this place, but what you least expected was to end up discovering something much worse than you could ever have imagined. Remember that every sound is a sign of danger... Synopsis : Kaelix Drum, a boy obsessed with exploring abandoned places, is led by his curiosity to Ravenmoore, the abandoned psychiatric hospital in his town, where he finds what he least wanted to find... Monsters and creatures This place is full of secrets, monsters, very disturbing places, and endless horrible things... You will have to deal with every danger in this place if you want to survive and unearth what has been hidden for years. This place ceased to be what it once was a long time ago, due to inexplicable events that still offer no clue as to what happened. But what is certain is that there are extremely dangerous creatures here. Be careful when exploring this place and don't let HER fool you. What could happen to you is much worse than you can imagine... EVERYTHING WILL BE REVEALED.... Key Features: A dark and immersive atmosphere Exploration and immersive, realistic gameplay Secrets and Easter eggs Intriguing and mysterious characters

rows.name: Train Wreck
rows.short_description: Train Wreck is a 3D top-down, local co-op base defense game, where players become train operators delivering cargo across multiple stations while fending off train robbers set in the wildwest. Players must maintain fuel levels, defend their train and repair the damages to reach all stations.
rows.description_html: Train Wreck is a 3D top-down isometric, local co-op, base defense game, where players take the role of train operators delivering cargo across multiple stations while fending off relentless train robbers set in the desert environment of a steamwest world. Players have to maintain fuel levels, defend their train from bandits and repair the damages . Each delivery route is filled with danger, and players achieve victory by successfully delivering cargos to all stations. Keep the train alive. Keep it moving. Work together to manage your steam-powered train as it barrels through treacherous canyons and outlaw territory. Maintain fuel, repair damages, and fend off waves of relentless robbers who’ll do anything to derail your mission. Every player has a role: whether you’re shoveling coal, manning defenses, or patching bullet holes mid-ride, coordination is key. Get on the mounted gun and fight back against the enemies by shooting at them. Hold your ground as waves of bandits try to follow you on horsecars. Time your shots, manage your ammo, and coordinate with your crew to keep the attackers from boarding.  Be aware of the bombs, those can devastate your train. Every mile is a battle for survival in the scorching steamwest. The further you go, the tougher it gets: faster enemies, heavier damage, and tighter resource management. Only the most coordinated crews will make it to the final station. Deliver the cargo, defend your train, and prove your crew has what it takes to survive the Train Wreck.

rows.name: The Tragedy of Ezekiel Asmerom
rows.short_description: A first-person psychological horror adventure where you explore a cursed mansion, solve puzzles, and uncover dark family secrets to escape eternal damnation.
rows.description_html: You are the last heir of a cursed bloodline. At the moment of your death, your soul is destined for hell—unless you uncover the truth behind your ancestor’s betrayal and rewrite your fate. Explore a forsaken mansion, read painful diaries, and solve intricate puzzles to gather fragments of forgotten memories. These will grant you access to the mysterious Gallery of Souls, where the secrets of your dynasty await. Your journey leads to the Black Chapel, where you must confront the devil himself and attempt to barter your ancestor’s soul for your own. Your choices shape the story, unlock occult powers, and determine which of the multiple endings you’ll face.

rows.name: Maloomify the Ocean
rows.short_description: Maloomify The Ocean is a relaxing puzzle game in which you must fulfill every need of your underwater inhabitants. Each inhabitant has their own personality, so it's important to avoid complications. When all the inhabitants are happy, your game world expands and reveals new, things to discover.
rows.description_html: Relaxing puzzles Experience a small underwater world full of peaceful inhabitants, loving details, and cozy puzzles. In Maloomify The Ocean, you place, rotate, and change different inhabitants and objects until everyone is happy. Each inhabitant has their own personality, so you have to create the perfect balance in the ecosystem. When everyone is satisfied, your world expands and unlocks new wondrous things. Sit back while you ponder the puzzle and listen to the lo-fi underwater-themed soundtrack. Create your own levels With the integrated Steam Workshop connection, you can easily create your own levels with the level editor and share them with the world! Whether you want to create beautiful, difficult, or crazy levels, it's entirely up to you! Mini-games for variety Some objects cannot be changed easily, which means it's time for a mini-game! Mini-games are small events that make your stay underwater more varied and colorful. Of course, everything is done without pressure or stress. Something new to discover in every corner While you're thinking about how to make everyone happy, you can discover the colorful underwater world. Just click around and see what happens! A student project More than 60 students from the Media Informatics and Interactive Entertainment program at Mittweida University of Applied Sciences developed their own game within two semesters. The program teaches game design, computer science, engine, game art, and team management, offering insight into the gaming industry. For more information, visit:

rows.name: Night Patrol：Barracks
rows.short_description: You patrol an abandoned Chinese apartment where time loops endlessly. Watch closely, find anomalies on every floor. If you ignore them, you will never escape this building.
rows.description_html: You are the security of this old Chinese barracks apartment. Your duty begins on the first floor. Patrol each level carefully, one by one, until you reach the ninth. Remember : Always move forward, and walk to the end of the hallway. Keep your eyes open. Use your flashlight to check every corner, even the slightest anomalies could be a warning. If you notice anything unusual, turn back immediately!  Ignore it, and the loop will begin again. You’ll find yourself back where you started， and you may never escape this building. The only things you can rely on are your eyes, your memory, Stay alert, and begin your patrol. [Security Operations Manual] Basic Controls: [W/A/S/D] : Move [Mouse] : Control view [E] : Toggle Flashlight [F] : Snap fingers (Activates the voice-controlled hallway lights) Patrol Rules: Observe the hallway carefully. No Anomaly : Walk straight through, go up to the next floor. Anomaly Detected : Turn back immediately, go up to the next floor.

rows.name: Grime Reapers
rows.short_description: Grime Reapers is a first-person horror survival game where you clean haunted houses while avoiding monsters and ghouls. Complete cleaning objectives, distract enemies, or hide to survive your shift and escape the house alive.
rows.description_html: Grime Reapers is a first-person horror survival game where you clean haunted houses while trying to survive the shift. Each job places you inside a property filled with monsters and ghouls . Your task is to complete cleaning objectives  while avoiding the hostile entities that roam the house. Cleaning is never safe. Making noise, moving too quickly, or staying in one place too long can draw unwanted attention. To survive, you must work carefully , distract enemies , or hide until it’s safe to continue. Gameplay Features First-person cleaning gameplay focused on completing objectives within haunted houses Stealth-based survival mechanics where enemies react to player actions Monsters that patrol environments and investigate disturbances Distraction and hiding systems to avoid confrontation Rising tension as the shift progresses and danger increases Survive the shift by completing enough objectives to escape alive In Grime Reapers , success isn’t just about doing a good job  it’s about making it out alive . Developed as a group project as part of the Indie Game Development Course at Falmouth University.

rows.name: Gobotix: Duo
rows.short_description: Guide two tiny robots through clever 3D isometric puzzles; solo or in co-op. Every click adds a new note to the game’s looping beat, making each run sound unique. Free to play, with optional supporter DLCs that add nothing but love.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Gobotix, a robot manufacturing company that runs by robots. In this distant future, humanity is long gone. The two bots - remnants of an advanced civilization - are undergoing a quality test to prove their worth. Yet with each completed challenge, they uncover fragments of forgotten messages from the past, learning not only about their makers but about what it means to exist. About the Game Step into a world where logic meets rhythm. Control two curious robots; each with their own charm and personality - through a series of mind-bending platform puzzles. Whether you play solo or cooperate with a friend, every level challenges your perception of space, timing, and teamwork. Your goal is simple: solve puzzles, activate mechanisms, and reach the glowing portal that marks your success. But the path is never straightforward; buttons, lifts, portals, and physics-based contraptions will test your every move. A Game That Plays Its Own Music Every click, every command becomes part of the soundtrack. The game runs on an infinite looping beat, and each of your interactions adds a new musical note - creating a unique rhythm for every session. No two playthroughs ever sound the same. Your puzzle-solving journey literally shapes the music. What to expect Two playable robots with distinct personalities Designed for both single player and co-op play Isometric 3D visuals with smooth, minimalist design Reactive soundtrack that evolves with your actions Clever physics elements for dynamic puzzle solving Free to play — with optional DLC packs that simply support the developers Support the Robots The game is completely free. Optional DLCs offer no gameplay advantages; only a way to show support through the 'pay what you want' options. Supporters might just see their robots react with a little extra warmth and surprise during their adventures. The Journey Ahead The game currently features 25 handcrafted levels, each designed to test precision, logic, and rhythm. New levels will be released as free content packages, expanding the robots’ story and world over time.

rows.name: In Our Parlor
rows.short_description: In Our Parlor is a short, horror walking simulator. The player must make their way through a mysterious manor to unfold the story, find the parlor, and escape this nightmare. Navigate a series of dark set pieces and follow the music to discover the path forward.
rows.description_html: STORY - In Our Parlor tells the story of a game developer who falls asleep at home and dreams about the game world they're creating. To end the nightmare and wake up, they must make their way through their own creation and reach the parlor. THE EXPERIENCE - Atmospheric horror and realistic set pieces make this horror walking simulator an immersive and terrifying experience. The surreal settings and music drive this mysterious narrative.  GAMEPLAY - Using only the light of a lantern, navigate a series of dark set pieces and follow the music to discover the path forward. The player must make their way through a mysterious manor to unfold the story, find the parlor, and escape this nightmare. MUSIC - Featuring original music by Kyle Faber

rows.name: Lost Trust-Episode 1
rows.short_description: After years apart, you visit an old friend for what should’ve been a quiet evening. But you soon realize you’re not alone and a dark betrayal awaits .The game is a first-person, linear PSX-style experience focused on exploration and uncovering secrets.”
rows.description_html: Story: After years apart, you return to visit a friend you’ve known your whole life. It was supposed to be a quiet evening — but soon, you realize you’re not as alone as you thought. Slowly, you uncover a betrayal far darker than you could ever imagine. Gameplay:  The game is a first-person experience with a linear story, where players explore environments and uncover secrets, all presented in a retro PSX-style graphics. “A short, intense experience lasting about 30 minutes .”

By idling in the game, you can unlock new outfits—and once unlocked, you can switch to them anytime. The current version includes 3 outfits, with future updates adding more clothing irregularly, or as DLC releases.

rows.name: Milk Mafia
rows.short_description: An AI-driven narrative adventure where rival dairy and snail-slime gangs battle for control of Brine City. Engage in high-stakes debates where every word counts—argue, persuade, and outsmart unpredictable characters who think and react in real time.
rows.description_html: Brine City is a battleground where rival dairy and snail-slime cartels fight for control — turf, trade, and pride all on the line. Ever played a game and wished you could go off-script during a big conversation? Argue your point, try to sweet-talk someone, or just see what happens when you don't pick from a list of three options? That's the core idea behind Milk Mafia . While there's a main story to follow, the real heart of the game is in the Debates . These are high-stakes conversations where your words are your best weapon. Each debate is its own unique scenario, dropping you into a room with a cast of characters who have their own personalities, goals, and hidden agendas. And here's the twist: these characters aren't just reading from a script. We've built a social AI simulation that runs completely on your PC, allowing them to generate their own responses based on what you say. They'll react to your arguments, and might even be swayed if you make a good point. It makes every debate feel like a real, unscripted conversation where you have to think on your feet. It's a game about figuring out how to deal with difficult people in tricky situations.
