rows.name: Boxed Up!
rows.short_description: The Box Company™ is excited to hire you as our new Box Sorter! Act as our champion of quality, destroying discrepant packages, and keeping our service faultless and troll free!* *The Box Company™ denies any and all claims of trolls infiltrating our packaging. Such claims are without evidence.
rows.description_html: 'Welcome back to hell, now with added hell!' The world is being overrun by monsters, the last hope? A parcel delivery company Boxed up is a first-person Parcel-Scanning simulation game with a ghoulish twist! Certain boxes contain monsters, and its up to you to figure it out, match the given stats to the box's actual measurements and info. Your office contains many gadgets and gizmos to help you find fault in the boxes. If something doesn't match, its a discrepancy, and the box must be thrown out, as it will contain a monster. Each day the monsters will adapt and new discrepancies will arise, along with the quota of boxes needed! Make sure to upgrade and keep your machines healthy so you can keep up with the increased demand. Who knows what you'll unpack in Boxed Up! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Box Sorter – Contract Position (For Official Applicants Only) As a world-class organization, the Box Company™ is passionate about warehouses, packaging, delivery, and excellence! As Box Sorter, your role will be to act as a champion of quality, destroying discrepant packages that do not follow our strict Box Company™ standards. With your skills, you will keep all Box Company™ boxes to this standard, faultless and troll free!* *The Box Company™ denies any and all claims of trolls infiltrating our packaging. Such claims are without evidence and are fabricated by conspirators. What You’ll Do · Act as a final assurance of quality, checking each box individually for discrepancies. · Perform tests with top-of-the-line Box Company™ equipment, such as the Metal Detector, state of the art computers from decades past, and exciting barcode scanners! · Proactively work with other disciplines, using our unique industry standard E-mail system to correspond and communicate with our various teams. · Meet your quota of boxes each shift, motivated by our fair and infallible strike system. · Send off our troll-free boxes to be delivered, ensuring no non-existent trolls have not un-infiltrated our packaging. Scanner & Computer The scanner is the bread and butter of any good box sorter. Competent workers scan labels for details about their package, a helpful tool in analysing for discrepancies. Info desk We understand that many workers are forgetful, that’s why we’ve installed a secondary computer to your workstation with all the relevant information needed to remind you again and again! Scale Measure the weight of all your packages with this industrial grade scale! A necessary tool for confirming details of your package, this scale will ensure no box-related problems ever weigh on you again. A parcel delivery company Boxed up is a first-person Parcel-Scanning simulation game with a ghoulish twist! Certain boxes contain monsters, and its up to you to figure it out, match the given stats to the box's actual measurements and info. rows.name: Out Of The Shadows (2025)
rows.short_description: A stealth adventure thriller where every shadow is your ally. Escape a maximum-security prison as a framed scientist in this story-driven third-person game of survival and revenge.
rows.description_html: “Ten years behind bars for a crime I didn’t commit. Tonight, it ends.” Out of the Shadows is a third-person stealth adventure thriller about escaping a high-security prison and uncovering a deadly conspiracy. You play as Dr. Graham Ellington , a scientist framed for leaking nuclear secrets. After a decade in isolation, a mysterious note offers one final chance at freedom. Sneak through shadow-drenched corridors , outsmart patrolling guards , and use  light manipulation, blind spots , and environmental stealth to stay undetected. Every sound matters — every move could expose you. As you escape the prison , uncover hidden clues about who framed you and why. What begins as a story of survival turns into a pursuit of truth, revenge, and redemption. Key Features Stealth Gameplay: Hide in shadows, disable lights, throw objects, and silently take down guards. Cinematic Storytelling: Experience an emotional narrative driven by voiceovers, atmosphere, and tension. Environmental Puzzles: Find keys, disable power grids, and manipulate your surroundings to escape. Immersive Audio & Visuals: Dynamic lighting, echoing footsteps, and environmental ambience build a tense prison world. Linear, Story-Rich Experience: A focused 20–25 minutes stealth adventure. Escape. Survive. Uncover the truth. Out of the Shadows is perfect for players who love story-rich stealth games , cinematic adventures , and tense, atmospheric escapes where every step counts.

rows.name: JellieShift
rows.short_description: Shoot, explore, and navigate a mysterious underwater environment, solving puzzles and meeting curious creatures to make your escape! Discover crystals that grant strange abilities and use these powers to alter the properties of the world around you!
rows.description_html: Jump into the world of JellieShift,  where you play as Jellie, an adventurous, hue-shifting blob trapped in a mysterious underwater land.  ~ Discover unique crystals and abilities ~ Explore and discover four different jelly crystals that grant you unique power-ups! ~ Shoot to manipulate the environment ~ Alter your environment by spitting empowered jelly blobs at blocks to change their physical properties.  Make blocks sink, vanish, or bouncy to navigate the world! ~ Switch between three states ~  Freely shift between three crystals! With only two swappable crystal slots, make choices about which crystals to keep, swap, or drop as you encounter new situations that require different combinations of abilities.  ~ Solve puzzles and collect treasures ~  Experiment, create, and discover strategies to master the manipulation of the world around you and make your escape in record time! Early Access Features: Original handcrafted pixel art and visuals. Relaxing 2D puzzle platforming with reticule-assisted aiming and shooting. Controller supported and encouraged! Explore 10 individually crafted levels and discover new mechanics, puzzles, and strategies. Experiment with 4 unique abilities, apply different combinations, and solve your way to the exit. Collect shells and unlock cute accessories to make your adventures more enjoyable! Speedrun and replay levels to achieve high scores! You are in control of your hue . Showcased at SXSW Sydney Student Games Showcase 2025!

rows.name: Valiant Attempt
rows.short_description: A low-poly 3D action RPG where you fight, talk, and survive alongside AI-driven companions in a world consumed by endless war. Master physics-based combat, form bonds with companions, and uncover what remains worth saving.
rows.description_html: This is a DEMO of a game, not a full game, made in collaboration with Jyväskylä University of Applied Sciences. The Valiant Attempt is a story-driven 3D action RPG set in a low-poly world on the brink of collapse. You play as a displaced noble turned mercenary, wandering through the ruins of nations devoured by war. Alongside AI-driven companions, you’ll battle, explore, and make choices that may change what’s left of your world — or simply survive it. Gameplay Gameplay in The Valiant Attempt mixes real-time combat with reactive AI behavior. Enemies coordinate with each other, allies respond to your actions, as enemies and you try to defeat each. Combat blends physical collisions, directional strikes, and projectile mechanics — every swing, block, or spell feels grounded in motion and timing. Story and World Generations after a fallen empire’s monsters reshaped the realm, humanity’s own greed has reignited the cycle of conquest. Your homeland lies divided, your family’s fate unknown, and rumors speak of an ancient artifact that could end — or escape — the endless war. Whether it’s myth or salvation is yours to uncover. Key Features AI-Driven Companions & Enemies — Battle alongside allies who think and react dynamically. Physics-Based Combat — Engage in melee and ranged fights where positioning, timing, and precision matter. Interactive Narrative — Experience dialogue-driven encounters that reveal character and consequence. Low-Poly Aesthetic — Explore a handcrafted 3D world with a clean, stylized look. Atmospheric Worldbuilding — A somber tone underscored by a world weary of conflict.

rows.name: Once Upon a Shell
rows.short_description: Once Upon a Shell is a roguelike racing game of ridiculous speed and wild upgrades. As a tortoise, use your shell to your advantage and slide downhill to generate speed. Build movement combos between races and prove that even a tortoise can lift The Hare Cup.
rows.description_html: Once Upon a Shell is a roguelike racing game of ridiculous speed and wild upgrades. As a tortoise, use your shell to your advantage and slide downhill to generate speed. Build movement combos between races and prove that even a tortoise can lift The Hare Cup. Features: Race at Ridiculous Speeds Outrun a pack of overconfident hares in chaotic, fast-paced races where momentum is everything. Master the Shell Slide Tuck into your shell to drift around the grasslands with ecstatic speed. Evolve Your Movement Unlock movement upgrades that influence how you gain speed and how fast you become. Claim the Hare Cup Conquer all four divisions in a single run to prove, once and for all, that the tortoise can beat the hares. A Living Fable Explore a charming watercolor storybook world that continues the classic tale of The Tortoise and the Hare . Credits: Game Director: Vladimír Hořký Producer: Viktor Máni Mønster Game Designer: Anita Tiwari Level Designer: Mikkel Gam-Pedersen Composer: Niels De Fine Olivarius Audio Programmer: Asger Fihl Hedegaard Nielsen Art Director: Emili Mikkelsen Visual Artist: Lucia Šupová Technical Artist: Jacob Kjerulf-Thomasen Lead Programmer: Philip Hviid-Wodschow Programmer: Claudiu Mihai Jechel Programmer: Sebastian Giovanni Murgia Kristensen Programmer: Viktor Krarup Andersen This game was created as part of the DADIU 2025 program in Copenhagen.

rows.name: Ninja Warp
rows.short_description: A top-down Rougelike with a focus on build diversity and unique enemies. Fight through the eldritch monsters with your ninja skills!
rows.description_html: Choose between a variety of weapons, skills, and characters to fend off the ever growing waves of enemies. The choices you make will heavily influence the tide of the battle. Each enemy has their own unique attacks and behaviors, creating different challenges after each stage. Be sure to look for weaknesses and patterns in the enemies you face. Enemies will work together to take you down; some will focused on supporting allies while others will charge you head on. Watch out for the glowing elite creatures! Unlock upgrades after each run to become strong enough to take on the final boss!

rows.name: Feast of Fools
rows.short_description: You have been invited to a mysterious dinner party. But alas, it seems you are to be the dinner! Flee, and you may yet survive!!
rows.description_html: You have been invited to a mysterious dinner party. But alas, it seems you are to be the dinner! Feast of Fools is a turn-based horror game - escape the haunted house, all while avoiding the endless waves of unspeakable horrors. Endless Horrors : No matter how many you fell, yet more monstrosities crawl forth from the shadows. They are unending. Stay away from from the eyes in the darkness - when you stare into the abyss, the abyss stares back. Escape or Perish : Run, run for the doors! The manor is massive, but if you can get in, you can surely get out. Any who fall behind are lost. Flee, and you may yet survive! Give Me a Hand : You must work with your other dinner guests to navigate the haunted halls of the manor. Each guest has their own abilities to push and pull yourselves out of danger. The Dinner Party Who of our party will survive? And who will be yet more of the feast? Your party must work together to survive, ach in their own manner: The Professor: A student of science. Can pull his allies away from danger. The Lady: The daughter of a lesser baron. Can push her allies forward, towards the doors. The Priest: The steward of the local church. Can heal his allies. But be warned, he cannot heal himself!

rows.name: Temple of the Green Moon: Prologue
rows.short_description: You're alone. Darkness and hopelessness surround you. These creatures are everywhere. Can you save yourself, or is it all doomed?
rows.description_html: You're alone. Darkness and hopelessness surround you. These creatures are everywhere. Can you save yourself, or is it all doomed? As a tourist, Alyona, you find yourself deep in the caves of the Zhigulyov Mountains. Use a flashlight to scare away monsters. Your only goal is to find a way out and escape! EXPECTATIONS = REALITY: Fights with mysterious creatures. Parkour and survival elements. First-person exploration of mysterious locations. Uncomplicated yet exciting brainteasers. Find out what brought Alyona to the caves and how her fate will turn out. Follow the path, plunge into the anomalous zone, and face the unknown! Check out this free prologue to the game 'Temple of the Green Moon', in which you will embark on an exciting adventure as Alena, a tourist! Unlike the main game, the prologue only allows you to explore one location, try out the basic mechanics, and play as a different character. (this is not the main game)

rows.name: BUS: Prologue
rows.short_description: Ride through the apocalypse with your friends! BUS: Bro U Survived is a co-op story-driven adventure featuring your very own bus! Fight zombies, gather resources, help other survivors, and solve puzzles. Can you uncover the truth about the beginning of the epidemic and decide the fate of the island?
rows.description_html: The zombie outbreak caught you off guard. Your only hope for survival is an old school bus and a team of loyal friends. Under the leadership of G, a charismatic radio host and conspiracy theorist, you must try to survive and figure out how to stop the impending apocalypse. The already dangerous journey across Fang Island will plunge you into the epicenter of a power struggle between two rival forces. Fight for survival, forge unexpected alliances, uncover the roots of the outbreak, and make a choice that will decide the fate of the entire island. Surviving a zombie apocalypse is no easy task. Throughout the story campaign, you'll have to fight, build, drive the bus from location to location, and escape hordes of angry green little folks. Fang Island adapts to the number of survivors. The more players, the more complex the puzzles and the more dangerous the enemies. Zombies WON'T make a cottage a castle. But you will. Haul resources in your bus, build defenses and fortify your own apocalyptic hideout. Any scrap you collect can be turned into effective weaponry with a bit of imagination. What could be better than a bus during the apocalypse? An armored bus. Customize your monster to your heart's content - from a new paint job to different wheels. And circular saws on the sides and a ram on the front bumper will be the perfect finishing touches for your personal zombie-clearing machine. We're waiting for you on our Discord server !

rows.name: Dictatorch: I've S.E.E.N. you
rows.short_description: A short-story game where you play as a retired art thief. Cool, huh? Guess what? No! There’s a dictator on the island where this takes place, and he literally cut out your left eye. Now you’ve got to complete the challenges like that! What a shame?
rows.description_html: You’re trapped on an island ruled by a ruthless dictator … well, no one really knows his name. No one knows who he is—he’s never appeared anywhere in person. He’s sealed every escape route: the docks are shut and the boats are burned. You, being an ex–art thief, tried to escape, but here… nothing goes without consequences (you lost your left eye). It’s only been three weeks since you arrived accidentally , and already the island feels like a prison that’s slowly learning your name . Explore the village, help the villagers, try to regain your sight, complete interesting missions and make friends on the island (you will need them later xdddd). As you uncover the island’s secrets , you’ll need to use your strategic thinking, and your thief ’s instincts to survive. Sneak through guarded areas (well the guards are pretty bad at their work but still...) and make moral choices that does not affect how others see you (hmmm sad).

But despite your reputation as the Hero of Donvin, Lyra is the real hero, as she's several times stronger and more skilled than you, and she has no problem rubbing it in your face. rows.name: Mission: ISS
rows.short_description: Take a trip into orbit and experience life on board the International Space Station! In this Emmy-nominated simulation, learn how to move and work in zero-gravity using your controllers. Dock a space capsule, take a spacewalk, and let real NASA astronauts guide you on the ISS!
rows.description_html: Take a trip into orbit and discover what life is really like aboard the International Space Station. This Emmy-nominated VR experience puts you at the heart of life in zero gravity. Learn to maneuver through weightlessness, dock a visiting spacecraft, and step outside the station on a breathtaking spacewalk. Real NASA astronauts guide your journey with authentic footage and insights from their time in space. (Gamepad not supported.) Key Features Train like an astronaut : Complete zero gravity exercises and monitor your progress on your Virtual Tablet. Explore the ISS inside and out : Navigate the station just like its crew and experience its interior recreated with striking accuracy and immersive detail. Step into the void : Venture outside for a solo spacewalk and drift freely through the quiet, awe-inspiring expanse of space. Gamepad not supported missionisshelp@magnopus.com

rows.short_description: Take a look—watch how the “me” in the game is shaped by your choices, pushing the story forward step by step until the truth of this game (this world) is finally revealed.

[Multiple Endings] Remember: there is only ONE main route!!! Your choices will influence “my” thoughts and can ultimately trigger a BAD END. [Wild Imagination] The script is adapted from one of two short stories I wrote in middle school. The writing might be a bit rough, but I promise the imagination will surprise you. All people and events in this story exist in a virtual space and have no relation to the real world. I’m Shifeifan, an indie game developer from China. You’re welcome to follow my Bilibili account “正常的一个人.” You can also add my WeChat for conversation, or send bug reports and suggestions to my email—many thanks. rows.name: United We Forge
rows.short_description: Deep beneath the mountains lies a living forge, where rival creatures — Ogres, Goblins, and Amphibians — must set aside their grudges to craft powerful gear. In this competitive card strategy game, every card you play shapes the delicate balance between power and collaboration.
rows.description_html: ⚔️ Build Synergy or Dominate Alone Each race thrives on its own strengths, but true mastery comes from combining unlikely allies . The more diverse your team, the greater your potential — inspired by Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) principles, your deck’s harmony determines its might. 🔨 Craft Your Legacy Every match takes place inside a realistic 3D forge environment , where your chosen creatures work together to produce armor and equipment tied to their cultural identity. To craft the best gear, you’ll need the right races, the right synergies, and the right strategy.  Improvement Cards Use Improvement Cards to boost your employees’ performance. You can play one Improvement Card per turn . Each employee can only hold one Improvement Card during their contract. Accomodation Cards Accommodation Cards enhance specific races by improving their work environment. You can play one Accommodation Card per turn , but only on an employee of a matching race . Each employee can only have one Accommodation Card active during their contract. Malice Cards Use Malice Cards to disrupt your opponents’ workforce. You can play one per turn , targeting any opposing employee . These cards last contract time , unless they cause a reduction in production for the entire workers . In that case, they are removed after the turns' end . DEI Cards DEI (Diversity, Equality & Inclusion) Cards reward unity and cooperation in your forge. You can only play them once your forge includes all races of employees . Only one can be played per turn , and it will be removed at the end of turn if it applies to all workers . 🧠 Strategic Depth, Endless Replayability With countless combinations, faction bonuses, and tactical plays, no two matches are the same. Outsmart your opponent by reading their strategy, predicting their plays, and crafting victory card by card. 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Player vs Player Battles Challenge friends or other players online in intense PvP duels . Build decks that reflect your playstyle — whether you prefer brute force, clever synergy, or full-spectrum cooperation.

rows.name: AEON DIRECTIVE: THE INTERVIEW
rows.short_description: 50 binary questions. Infinite consequences. Observe every detail... the environment could change. Fail to notice an anomaly, and you fail the test. The further you progress, the more rooms you have to remember. Permadeath.
rows.description_html: You have entered an isolated testing sector of the AEON DIRECTIVE, the final system that determines who may enter The Building, humanity’s last refuge. Nothing here is decorative. Every question you answer and every change you notice shapes your evaluation. The evaluation consists of 50 binary questions. You may answer only YES or NO. On the screen in front of you, two constantly shifting values are displayed. The Compliance Score represents how well your decisions align with Directive standards. The Perception Score reflects your ability to notice environmental distortions and react to them correctly. After each question, anomalies occur. The testing chamber may subtly or dramatically change. Chairs may slide across the floor. Boxes can vanish. Objects may appear where they were not before. Sometimes you will see something that looks like you standing in the wrong place, locked in a still and unnatural posture. These manifestations are known as Replicants. If you detect an anomaly, you must stop answering and select RECALIBRATE. Failing to do so lowers your Perception Score. Incorrect or undesirable answers lower your Compliance Score. If either score reaches a dangerously low level, the system will remove you from the interview permanently. There is no recovery after removal. The environment is presented in a retro styled black and white aesthetic reminiscent of early surveillance systems and abandoned office archives. Cold lights, silent rooms and minimal furnishing create an atmosphere where even stillness feels hostile. As the test progresses, keycards grant access to additional rooms. Each new area increases both opportunity and risk. The deeper you move into the facility, the more unstable reality becomes. This is a single continuous evaluation. Failure in either category ends the experience entirely The game will expand over time with new endings, content updates and ongoing improvements. Player feedback helps determine the future direction of the project.

rows.name: Thanks, She's A Rescue
rows.short_description: Thanks, She's a Rescue is an Indie Horror Game about a popular streamer that has been mistreating his dog for a while now but you caught wind and you're not gonna let him forget it. Sneak into his house, rescue the dog, and make your great escape. She will be much happier with her new master. :)
rows.description_html: Thanks, She's A Rescue is a straightforward First Person Indie Horror Game featuring a true first person avatar and an A.I that chases you around the map. Collect items, pick up and set down objects, Sneak passed the streamer while he's live and attempt to take the dog. If it catches you, it's over. Story You just heard that a popular streamer has been mistreating his dog for a while now and you're not gonna let him forget it. Sneak into his house, rescue the dog, and make your great escape. rows.name: Nightork Adventures 3 - Arena
rows.short_description: Blast your way through magical chaos! Choose your totem, master the color-coded shield system, and unleash explosive power in Nightork Adventures 3 - the ultimate test of reflexes and strategy.
rows.description_html: Nightork Adventures 3 brings back the fast-paced, explosive action of the Nightork series - now with deeper strategy and more destruction than ever! Each enemy is protected by three shields , and every shield has one of two colors: Magic or Antimagic . To destroy them, you must hit the correct colors in the right order  - precision and timing are everything. Collect powerups to trigger massive explosions and chain reactions, and choose one of three Totems to shape your playstyle: 🐻 Ice Bear – Boosts defense and absorbs incoming damage. 🐅 Snow Tiger – Increases attack power and fire rate. 🦅 Frost Raven – Enhances mobility and special energy regeneration. Face waves of enemies across three unique arenas , each filled with intense battles, glowing projectiles, and spectacular effects. Features: Dynamic Magic/Antimagic shield system Three Totems with unique bonuses Explosive powerups and chain reactions Three arenas packed with fast-paced action Arcade-style gameplay with a strategic twist Can you master the rhythm of destruction and survive the chaos?

rows.name: Truck Company
rows.short_description: TruckCompany - is a strategic game in which you develop your transport enterprise, the aim of which is to create a great consortium with other players and compete with others for the title of the best businessmen
rows.description_html: Truck Company is a real-time strategy game in which you and other players strive to gain the widest possible market share for your orders. You start by purchasing your first vehicle and searching for the most profitable orders for it, ensuring your truck operates 24/7 without wasting time on free flights. You also need to take care of your drivers, as a well-rested and experienced driver is key to ensuring your truck completes its tasks quickly and efficiently. Trucks require repairs over time, otherwise their speed decreases. Later, once you earn more money, you can build bus stations or shops to which you will have to deliver goods, either by purchasing them in advance or by producing them in your own factories. The direction of your company depends on you. The game is based on a natural system of supply and demand, so other players influence the profits you earn. Players who join companies participate in seasonal rankings, at the end of which they receive rewards that help them develop their business. The company offers a wide range of tasks to complete, as well as bonuses that will help you increase your profits. The cars you start with date back to the 1950s. As technology advances, you'll gain access to more modern trucks with better performance. You can combine vehicles into convoys, making managing a large fleet a breeze. Cars have a wide range of modifications, but you'll first need to earn points to upgrade them.

rows.name: Hero Haven TD
rows.short_description: A classic 2D tower defense game with heroes, powerful towers, and epic battles. Defend your kingdom against endless enemy waves and become a legend.
rows.description_html: Game Description – Hero Haven TD Hold the line! Hero Haven TD is a fast-paced 2D tower defense game where strategy, timing, and hero power decide the fate of your kingdom. Build powerful defenses, command fearless heroes, and stand against relentless enemy waves in an epic battle for survival. Defend villages, frozen lands, deserts, and lava fields as hordes of monsters, warlords, and dark creatures march to destroy your homeland. Master tactical placement, upgrade your towers, unleash devastating abilities, and prove your worth as the realm’s defender. ⚔️ Features Classic Tower Defense Gameplay – Stop enemies across handcrafted defense paths with strategic tower placement. 4 Tower Types with Specializations – Build archers, artillery, barracks, and magic towers—each with advanced upgrade paths. Powerful Heroes – Unlock and control unique heroes with special abilities and skill trees. Epic Boss Battles – Face deadly enemy champions that will test your strategy and reflexes. Challenging Enemy Types – Over 30 unique enemies, each with abilities like shielding, flying, or regeneration. Heroic Abilities & Spells – Call reinforcements, cast firestorms, summon lightning and more. Campaign Mode + Challenge Levels – Fight through immersive story maps and replay for stars and achievements. Upgradeable Progression System – Improve towers, spells, and hero stats to build unstoppable defenses. Hand-crafted 2D Art & Animation – Classic fantasy TD visuals designed for immersive tower defense action. Offline Play – Enjoy the full campaign anytime, anywhere. The kingdom will not defend itself. Rally your heroes. Build your towers. Crush your enemies. Defend your homeland. Become a legend.

rows.name: Z.A.T.O. // I Love the World and Everything In It
rows.short_description: USSR, 1986. A girl goes missing in the closed city of Vorkuta-5, yet not a soul seems to be concerned. Uncover the mystery behind her disappearance and transmit your signal to the universe.
rows.description_html: STORY USSR, 1986. When Ira Grachevskaya goes missing in the closed city of Vorkuta-5, not a soul seems to be concerned – except for the quiet outcast Asya Shubina, that is. Uncover the mystery behind Ira’s disappearance, transmit your radio signal to the universe and learn why a bird flies past the window. CHARACTERS Meet the cast. A problem child and a truant, Ira doesn't have the best reputation. Her standoffish demeanor makes her difficult to talk to, especially for someone as meek as you. There is a rumour she's been meeting with an older man. Marina's carefree personality makes her quite popular among her classmates. Adults don't seem to like her very much, probably due to poor grades. Despite the girl's outgoing nature, her worldview is rather cynical. A boy with an unpleasant sense of humour. Likes picking on people weaker than him, namely you. His family has been a little out of it the past few weeks. You. Not worth writing about. GAME INFO Z.A.T.O. is a linear visual novel with roughly 7-8 hours of playtime. There are no choices. The ending is predetermined. Sit back and enjoy your time in a town that doesn't exist. DISCLAIMER: the game contains strong language, loud noises and flickering images.

rows.name: The wild darkness
rows.short_description: Explore a survival-roguelike RPG set in an unknown and bizarre world. To withstand its many dangers, you'll need to gain new knowledge, scavenge for food, and acquire useful items. Craft, build, and learn your way through a crucial adventure to uncover the world's secrets.
rows.description_html: You have been summoned to this world against your will. You know nothing, and everything here is utterly strange. You must find your own food, and monsters emerge at night. A moment of carelessness could send you to the next world. However, if you persevere and challenge yourself, you will accumulate knowledge, and the totems and crafting recipes you collect will allow you to progress through the game more smoothly. It will likely require a great deal of patience and focus, but there will be an equal amount of excitement and thrill in the adventure. Now, be brave. Destiny awaits. A Survival Story in an Unknown World This world contains countless regions, such as cool plains, cold tundras, and sultry jungles. There are various interactions with nature, such as lighting a fire when cold or cooling down in water when hot. Learning about the ecology and nature of this world will make it easier to survive. You can experience various stories as you progress through the game. Diverse Classes with Unique Abilities You can choose one of various classes to explore this world. Initially, only the Adventurer is selectable, but you can unlock new classes by meeting specific conditions. Gather, Craft, and Build This world is filled with various gatherable resources. You can use these to craft various items like delicious dishes, potions, and equipment. You can unlock new functions by constructing various facilities. For example, you can craft potions with an Alchemist's Cauldron, and building a Human Cannon will allow you to travel to distant regions. If you are short on materials, try finding a merchant and attempting a trade. Into a New Adventure with Good Equipment and Magic Equipment can come with outlandish modifiers, including beneficial options or harmful ones. Different skills are used depending on the weapon and gear equipped. There are spell scrolls and castable magic, and magic becomes more powerful when enhanced.

rows.name: Gaussian Mansion
rows.short_description: Explore a cursed hotel in this FREE rail shooter. Face off against hordes of ghosts, uncover hidden secrets, and fight for the best time in this 10-15 minute experience.
rows.description_html: Fight your way through a haunted Victorian mansion in this intense 10-minute on-rails shooter. Face hordes of spectral apparitions, test your reflexes, and compete for the highest score. Can you survive the horror and uncover the tragedy hidden within? About This Game Enter Gaussian Mansion, if you dare. In the icy peaks of Northern Europe, an ancient curse has corrupted a majestic hotel, trapping its spirits in a loop of eternal torment. Now, its ghostly echoes haunt every Victorian hall, and you are trapped inside. Gaussian Mansion is a fast-paced, first-person, on-rails action-horror experience. Forget about free exploration: your path is an inescapable journey into darkness, and your only defense is your aim. The camera moves automatically as enemies infest each room. Aim fast, shoot precisely, and survive! WHAT YOU'LL FIND IN THE GAME: Non-Stop Arcade Action: Dive into an on-rails shooter experience where the action never stops. Enemies appear quickly and from all angles. Every second counts! Test Your Reflexes: The main goal is clear: get the highest possible score in the shortest amount of time. Perfect your technique, memorize patterns, and replay to beat your own records. Uncover the Hidden Tragedy: It's not all about shooting. Hidden in the darkest corners of the hotel are delicate Victorian cutouts. Collect them to form the pages of a macabre scrapbook, the only key to understanding the tragedy that occurred here. Solve Spectral Mysteries: Your progress will be challenged by two clever puzzles you must solve to continue your escape from the mansion. A Complete 10-Minute Adventure: Gaussian Mansion offers a concise and replayable horror-action experience, perfect for a quick game session anytime. Completely Free: Enjoy the full experience at no cost. Your precision is your ally. Time is your enemy. Do you have what it takes to make it to the end?

Completely Free: Enjoy the full experience at no cost. Your precision is your ally. Time is your enemy. Do you have what it takes to make it to the end?

rows.name: Dispersio 3
rows.short_description: Dispersio 3 is a retro-style action platformer. As you progress through the game, you will face intense obstacles, like oppressing winds, treacherous waters or antigravity challenges. There's even a hard mode for hardcore players.
rows.description_html: The deafening wail of a siren boded ill tidings. Few knew that this geological research center was actually a secret military base. Only God knows what they were really doing there, but this time they've definitely gone too far. It's time to run before it's too late! Gameplay Dispersio 3 is a retro-style action platformer. As you progress through the game, you will face intense obstacles, like oppressing winds, treacherous waters or antigravity challenges. There's even a hard mode for hardcore players. Features Precisely tuned platforming mechanics Interesting, detailed and challenging maps Different obstacles Lots of secrets A great unique soundtracks In-game timer for speedrunners Achievements Gamepad support

Do you have what it takes? Start your merge adventure today, solve hundred of merge games, magic puzzles, challenges and free the Realm!

rows.name: Thousand N' Thousand: Mimico
rows.short_description: Short story driven RPG-esque top-down adventure with simple puzzles. Escape the Igneferia mini-mall before it's too late. May fortune be on your side!
rows.description_html: In the country of Milago exists a place called New Cesada, a small but extremely quickly developing city that has been experiencing disappearances for the last 30 years. In this top-down perspective rpg-esque adventure you'll come across various simple puzzles that will impede your way, characters who may help your way and bad apples who will chase you down to the end of the earth. As you explore the Igneferia, a mini-mall that will be permanently closing and won't be seeing anyone else entering in a month, and reach new floors you will become closer to your goal. You play as Faron, a young art student who got trapped inside the mini-mall. You will meet locals such as Starr, an imp who knows the ins and outs of the city and Zerca, an ex-journalist who has been investigating the innumerable amount of disappearances. Speak to them! Know more about them and learn their own goals by speaking to them at each new save point. Or if you are alone, speak to yourself, who knows? It may put your thoughts in order. Try to find your way out, learn about the secrets of this town and may fortune be on your side.

rows.name: Seconda: A Post-Apocalyptic Tale
rows.short_description: Survive in the ruins of a post-apocalyptic Italy. Manage resources, defend your home, and try to reactivate a radio to contact the outside world.
rows.description_html: Twenty years after the Third World War, the world is no longer the same. The cities lie in ruins, civilization has collapsed, and silence rules the streets of an unrecognizable Italy. In this setting rises Seconda , a fictional town in the province of Foggia, where a few survivors still search for a reason to keep going. In Seconda , you play as Aurora — a woman struggling to survive amid ruins, radiation, and despair. Her only hope is to repair an old military radio in an attempt to reach the outside world — a task that’s simple only in appearance. Every choice matters: manage your food supplies, fortify your home to withstand night raids from bandits, and repair what’s left to keep living. Food has become the new currency of the world — trade it with Vill, a wandering merchant who occasionally visits Aurora to offer her deals. Face armed bandits who have turned Seconda’s mall into their stronghold, or avoid the mutants roaming the irradiated streets. Every encounter is a fight for survival, and every bullet can make the difference. The contaminated zones hide precious resources, but your time inside them is limited. Prepare yourself, stay protected, and plan every move if you want to make it home alive. In the silence of the night, the sound of the wind mingles with the creak of wood and the footsteps of raiders. Aurora is no hero — she’s just a survivor, like many others, trying not to give in to the end. Seconda is a third-person survival game with management elements, set in a post-apocalyptic Italy. Explore, build, trade, fight, and survive — because in this world, life is worth nothing anymore…

rows.name: The Menace Below
rows.short_description: Short, challenging, hand-drawn cinematic platformer about escaping from the lair of evil ratmen.
rows.description_html: A prisoner of war finds a way to escape his captors, only to fall into the far more dangerous clutches of horrible monstrosities. The Menace Below is a short, difficult, hand-drawn cinematic platformer with a dark, brooding soundtrack. You will control the prisoner as he escapes to freedom. This challange will be full of lethal traps and malevolent monsters - you will need cunning, adaptability and quick reflexes to survive.

rows.name: Yuletide Regicide
rows.short_description: A dead Santa Claus right before Christmas is never a good sign. Interrogate the North Pole suspects to solve the murder and figure out how to save the festive season in this short dark comedy visual novel whodunnit.
rows.description_html: An Arctic Ambush! Santa Claus, the King of Christmas, has been murdered. Brutally butchered in his Throne Room on the North Pole. Our dynamic duo of deduction and delinquency, investigative journalist Deliria B. Murder and the undead detective Skullbert 'Skully' McSkullface, arrives to the scene in a timely manner, ready to get to the bottom of this scandalous scoop and most-likely-illegal impalement. Suspects abound from dissatisfied elves to flying reindeer, not to forget the possible marriage trouble with Mrs. Claus. Luckily, the CIA is already digging through the crime scene, so you can be sure the investigation is in good hands... Right? Something rotten on the North Pole Play as the main character duo and put all (or at least some) of your journalism and detective skills to good use. Do a bit of digging around and interrogate the North Pole residents to learn about their secret goings-on and grievances. Find answers to all the questions you've ever had* about Santa's operations! How are the work conditions for Santa's elves? How do the reindeer fly? How's Mrs. Claus liking the life of an Arctic matriarch? Shouldn't a murder be written down somewhere on Santa's famous naughty list? Yuletide Regicide is a short comedic visual novel crime story with hand-drawn graphics. It's a game full of funny characters, conspiracies, and Christmas jeer – everything you need to get into that festive mood for the holidays. Solve the murder, save Christmas**! *Unless you had more questions. **Results may vary.

rows.name: Remains
rows.short_description: A 2.5D Puzzle Platformer. Use tools to modify the level and how you move to explore forests and the ruins of a post-post apocalyptic world. Find keys and extra batteries to delve ever further, in search of who you are and what happened to the world.
rows.description_html: Play as a small robot exploring a post-post apocalyptic world. Having awakened in a forest, explore the world to find clues as to what has happened, and discover replacement parts for yourself using tools, such as a foam gun and vacuum. Explore Navigate an overgrown landscape, and delve into the ruins of a forgotten world as you explore a post-post apocalyptic setting, searching for clues as to who you are and what happened Tools Foam Gun - Spray foam onto walls to create platforms to help you navigate each level Vacuum - With suction and blowing capabilities, find hidden keys and maneuverer over slippery surfaces and underwater

rows.name: Until the Fields: Farmageddon
rows.short_description: A whimsical single-player story-driven puzzle adventure where you switch between animals, each with their own personality and abilities to escape the farm before it’s too late.
rows.description_html: A heartwarming, clay-style adventure about teamwork, freedom, and making a mess together—where every creature, big or small, has a role to play in stopping… Farmageddon! Features: In our single-player adventure where you swap between 3 animals: mouse, spider and cow — each with their own personality and tricks — Our heroes must cooperate to solve puzzles and escape the storm-wrecked barn! The mouse: sneaks through tunnels and gnaws ropes.  The spider: swings across beams, pulls levers. The cow: pushes and breaks heavy objects.

rows.name: Dave's Wrecking Yard 3D
rows.short_description: It's the late 1990s all over again and you find yourself the owner of Dave's Wrecking Yard. Earn cash by filling various parts orders by phone, internet, & walk-in customers. Enjoy working at your own pace while ordering pizzas and chugging sodas.
rows.description_html: This is a fun little 'Free to Play' automotive wrecking yard simulator in it's early stages. Find & collect specific car parts to complete orders, box them up & ship them across the country or sell them over the counter. Statistics are collected so you can see just how much work was done, how much money you've made as well as all the pizza & soda you consumed. This game is designed to run on minimal PC hardware, the minimum requirements are more of a suggestion.

rows.name: We Want Your Head
rows.short_description: Hit… or die. Welcome to the twisted version of a classic arcade experience. In We Want Your Head, you enter a world of pixelated nightmares where disembodied heads burst out from the darkness. With every swing of your hammer, you fight for a few more seconds of peace — and for your own head.
rows.description_html: Hit… or die. Welcome to the twisted version of a classic arcade experience. In We Want Your Head , you enter a world of pixelated nightmares where disembodied heads burst out from the darkness. With every swing of your hammer, you fight for a few more seconds of peace — and for your own head. Gameplay We Want Your Head is a horror-themed arcade game inspired by the 1970s classic Whac-A-Mole .The mechanics are simple — press the correct number on your keyboard to smash the emerging heads.As the pace increases, mistakes become inevitable, and every wrong move brings you closer to the end. You have 3 lives — miss three times, and the execution machine comes for you.This time, it’s your head on the line. Every hit counts, and every mistake creates extra pressure. Atmosphere The game draws inspiration from retro 3D aesthetics of the PS1 era , blending it with the unsettling vibe of an arcade that should never have existed .Flickering screens, dirty textures, distorted digits, and grotesque heads create a constant feeling of dread and inevitability.This isn’t a nostalgic trip down memory lane — it’s a nightmare that remembers how much fun you used to have. Will you keep your head on your shoulders? We Want Your Head is a tribute to classic arcade games — but this time, the price isn’t just your coins... It’s your life . Will you dare to play? How to Play. Use numpad keyboard or default number keys. Warning!!! This game contains flashing lights and sudden loud noises. Proceed with caution. Music created by Dabi Sarapuk.

rows.name: The Fox, The Forest & The Darkness
rows.short_description: Alone in the park as The Darkness rises, Zak begins his descent. The Fox, The Forest and The Darkness is a narrative based game centered on that moment in life when we begin to build our own reality. Zak is confused, scared and angry like most 14 year olds, but he's determined to make it count.
rows.description_html: Things have not been going well for Zak, in trouble at school, in trouble at home and now wondering what to do, where to go and who to be. Now he's stuck wandering the park doing homework on the weekend and frankly the whole thing is becoming a bit too much. Then Zak discovers the fetid vines, his first sign of the growing Darkness in the woods and the dangers that wait for us all.  -- What's in the game? Explore Southeast City Park discovering clues about Zak, his story and the reality he is building around himself. The Forest and The Darkness both call to Zak in their own unique ways.  Enjoy seamless transitions between 1st and 3rd person perspectives so you can really explore the clues to the mysteries that surround the Zak. Experience a uniquely crafted story that eloquently melds the written word, music and visuals into a cohesive experience only a solodev / auteur experience can create.  Make use of curious game techniques like a story driven inventory system. Although narrative based and story driven, the game doesn't bog you down with cutscenes and dialog sequences. The goal is for the player to feel free to move whenver possible.  An 'audio book' format (as read by the author) is also provided but you can turn that off if you read faster than listen. Several achievements are also scattered throughout the park (currently working on Steam integration). --- The Fox, The Forest & The Darkness is the first project by Idea Guy turned Solodev Will Leamon. Here we present the first chapter 'Enter Fickle Pig' as a means of hopefully raising interest and resources to keep on with the project.

rows.name: ElevatorGirl
rows.short_description: 3D action game. Avoid obstacles with simple controls and climb to the top floor.
rows.description_html: —Don't fall! Take the elevator and head for the goal— Simple controls x 3D action Dodge traps Jump over falling holes Get in the elevator and ascend Hit an obstacle and you'll be thrown back If you fall, you might have to start over! Game Features - Various traps: Moving and rotating platforms. A series of difficult spots. - Only jumping, character control, viewpoint control, and elevator activation - If you fall, you might have to start over from the beginning? - There are actually shortcuts!? Game Controls ・WASD - Jump: Spacebar Key = Spacebar, Button A, Mouse Left Click - Elevator: Key E, Button B, Mouse Right Click - View Control: Mouse, Right Stick Game Development: Third Work 'ElevatorGirl' Questions Q: There's noise on the screen! A: Please change the vertical sync settings. Q: I found a bug. A: If you contact us, we may fix it. For distribution guidelines, click 'Access the website' on the page.

rows.name: Service Please: First Dinner
rows.short_description: Service Please: First Dinner is a fast-paced and immersive restaurant management simulation. Welcome your customers, manage your staff, expand your menu, and control the workflow behind the scenes as you grow a small business into a prestigious restaurant.
rows.description_html: Service Please: First Dinner is a playable introductory experience that lets you step into a journey starting with a small business. Day by day, customer traffic increases, core menu options expand, and you take your first steps into restaurant management. This version serves as a preview of the larger and deeper experience awaiting you in the full game. Set up your business, make your first key decisions, and dive into the fundamentals of restaurant management. Every choice you make in this early stage lays a solid foundation for your journey ahead. Create Your Own Restaurant Start shaping your own business. Design your restaurant’s initial layout with tables, chairs, and essential decorative elements. In Service Please: First Dinner , you’ll learn the core principles of design and prepare for the more advanced customization systems available in the full game. • Create basic service areas • Experience how layout affects customer flow • Learn to use your kitchen space more efficiently Expand Your Menu and Impress Customers Meet customer expectations with a limited but carefully curated menu. In Service Please: First Dinner , you work with essential food and beverage options that reflect your restaurant’s identity. By understanding the fundamentals of menu management, you’ll be ready for the broader content offered in the full game. • Unlock your first recipes • Learn to balance your menu • Practice reading and responding to customer demands Manage Your Staff, Boost Performance At the heart of every restaurant is teamwork. In Service Please: First Dinner , you’ll manage a limited number of staff members, learning how to assign tasks and maintain a smooth service flow. Smart decisions make all the difference during busy hours. • Experience the basics of staff management • Balance service speed with customer satisfaction • Get familiar with stock and preparation processes Shape Your Progress with Tasks and Skills Complete your first management objectives. The tasks available in Service Please: First Dinner help you understand the game’s mechanics and shape your management approach. Core elements of the skill system offer a glimpse into the deeper progression awaiting you later. • Complete your first tasks • Learn how the progression system works • Build the foundation of your management style Bring Gameplay to Life with Events Witness special moments that energize your restaurant atmosphere. The limited events featured in Service Please: First Dinner allow you to observe customer behavior and restaurant pacing from different perspectives. • Fulfill special customer requests • Observe how the restaurant’s tempo changes • Discover the foundations of larger events Whether you want to learn the basics of running a small café or prepare yourself for managing a bustling restaurant… Service Please: First Dinner offers a smooth, educational, and satisfying introduction—designed to familiarize you with the core mechanics before stepping into the full depth of the complete management experience.

The limited events featured in Service Please: First Dinner allow you to observe customer behavior and restaurant pacing from different perspectives. • Fulfill special customer requests • Observe how the restaurant’s tempo changes • Discover the foundations of larger events Whether you want to learn the basics of running a small café or prepare yourself for managing a bustling restaurant… Service Please: First Dinner offers a smooth, educational, and satisfying introduction—designed to familiarize you with the core mechanics before stepping into the full depth of the complete management experience.

rows.name: Turned Into Turrets
rows.short_description: Once human, now machines forged by fake love. You just have five minutes to take down the waves of monsters and discover the path back to humanity. Turned Into Turrets is a 2D top-down roguelike game where you stand as a living turret, fighting waves of enemies with automatic attacks and builds.
rows.description_html: Wishlist now Turned Into Turrets is launching soon. Wishlist today to be notified when the playable early access releases! About the Game In a once-peaceful world, people were deceived by the illusion of fake love - a false controlling force that promised unity but delivered chains. That corrupted power twisted them into living turrets, trapped in metal shells, stripped of their hearts and freedom. Turned into Turrets is  a story-driven roguelike survival game where you fight as those lost souls - humans bound by steel - battling endless hordes of monsters born from the same false love that doomed them. Your mission is to find the Seven Keys of True Love and unlock the emotions that can restore your humanity. Each boss defeated leads closer to freedom.  ABOUT THE GAME Turned Into Turrets is a top-down roguelike survival game where you stand as a living turret fighting through relentless waves of enemies. Every 15-level segment introduces new enemy types, culminating in a boss fight. Defeating each boss unlocks a new playable character, each with distinct stats such as increased speed and health. Collect coins to fill your Upgrade Bar . When full, a set of Natural Powers appears. They are temporary ability choices that vanish after 10 seconds if ignored. Each refill slows slightly, testing your timing and decision-making. Traps scattered across the map can summon the Snake Woman (Fake Love) if triggered, or if you exceed the 5-minute limit without clearing the level. Survive, upgrade, and master your abilities to overcome the waves and uncover the truth behind fake love. CORE FEATURES • Wave-based progression: enemy types change every 15 levels • Boss fights that unlock new characters with unique speed or health stats • Coin-driven upgrade system with timed Natural Power choices • Gradually slower upgrade refill speed for deeper pacing • Environmental traps that summon the Snake Woman if triggered or delayed • Narrative integration through the Seven Keys of Love THIS EARLY ACCESS INCLUDES • 60 playable levels (4 enemy sets and 4 boss fights) • 4 unlockable characters with different speed and health stats • Full Upgrade-Bar and Natural Powers system • One playable world (no map purchasing in early access) • Early-access difficulty balancing for player feedback LANGUAGES • English

rows.name: Memoria
rows.short_description: Memoria is a classic memory matching game designed for Windows 3.1. Players are presented with a grid of face-down tiles, each holding a pictogram. The Objective is to find all matching pairs by flipping two tiles at a time.
rows.description_html: Memoria is a classic memory matching game designed for Windows 3.1. Players are presented with a grid of face-down tiles, each holding a pictogram. The Objective is to find all matching pairs by flipping two tiles at a time. If the selected tiles match, they remain face-up; if not, they are turned back over. The game tracks the number of moves and elapsed time, challenging players to complete the grid with the fewest attempts.

rows.name: Winds of Valen
rows.short_description: Winds of Valen is a free fantasy sandbox MMORPG. Experience old-school progression where every level, skill, and drop is earned through effort. Train your combat, mining, and smithing skills, and hunt for rare and unique items in a seamless open world filled with danger and discovery.
rows.description_html: Winds of Valen is a completely free-to-play fantasy MMORPG inspired by the golden age of old school MMOs like Old School RuneScape. Explore an open world with meaningful, non-linear progression, where your progression is driven by what you choose to pursue. Non-Linear Open World Step into a living world with no set path. Choose your own adventures, travel in any direction, and play at your own pace. Challenging Bosses Take on challenging, mechanics-driven boss encounters and earn powerful gear. Skill-Based Progression Train and master your skills: Combat Skills : Attack, Defence, Evasion, Warding and Health Professions : Mining and Smithing, deeply tied into your equipment, upgrades, and overall progression. Player-Driven Crafting & Progression Gather resources, smelt ore, and craft powerful gear. Every tool and weapon has purpose. Loot & Reward System Every monster in Winds of Valen drops its own rare, unique item. Rare drop chances are displayed openly and dynamically change to prevent getting too unlucky Every item is balanced, useful, and designed to have its place in the world. Winds of Valen is built for players who enjoy the open-ended, sandbox design of old-school MMOs.

rows.name: Run Coffee Run

rows.name: devasion 0.5
rows.short_description: Devasion 0.5 – The Intergalactic Upgrade Adventure Steer your spaceship through dangerous galaxies, destroy colored rocks, and collect gadgets to upgrade your ship! Only those who master the right combinations of weapons, colors, and timing will progress.
rows.description_html: Devasion 0.5 – The Intergalactic Upgrade Adventure! Developed by z-i-r.de Get ready for an action-packed adventure in the depths of space! In Devasion 0.5, you pilot a small, agile spaceship through dangerous galaxies filled with obstacles, colored rocks, and explosive surprises. Your mission: Destroy the multicolored rocks to clear the path and advance deeper into the levels. Each rock presents new challenges – some are tough, others are vulnerable to certain weapons or projectile colors. Only those who combine their knowledge cleverly will progress! Collect numerous gadgets and upgrades along the way to improve your ship. Enhanced lasers, shields, or out-of-control missiles – every upgrade can mean the difference between victory and defeat. Experience: 🚀 Fast, precise controls 💥 Color-matching and destruction mechanics 🔧 Numerous power-ups and individual upgrades 🌌 Retro-inspired graphics with a modern twist 🎶 Dynamic soundtrack for a galactic feel Are you ready to blast your way through the rocky waves and push your ship to its limits? Devasion 0.5 awaits your command.

rows.name: Molili AI Friends: Your AI Desk Pal
rows.short_description: Bring a charming AI friend to your desktop. Molili AI friend listens, reads by your side, blushes when you care, and helps with study or work using a smart personality system that remembers your moments, growing from curious visitor to the companion who understands you best.
rows.description_html: Your desktop is the world where you meet your AI partner. This is more than just a desktop pet. Here, every character is powered by the advanced Molili personalization model. They possess their own memories, emotions, and evolving personalities, allowing them to remember the moments you share and develop a unique, lifelike presence through your daily interactions. Every interaction is one-of-a-kind. With exquisite Live2D technology, every emotion is vividly brought to life before your eyes: They will respond delicately to your touch. When you're focused on work or gaming, they'll quietly keep you company in a corner of your screen. And when you need them, they'll become your most reliable partner. Not just a friend but also your capable assistant. Your AI partner can connect to the internet to look up information for you, or activate Deep Thought Mode to explore complex questions with you. When inspiration strikes, simply describe your idea, and they'll generate stunning images, becoming a wellspring of creativity for your projects. A relationship that grows with you. Your bond will be chronicled through a unique affinity system. Increase your affinity through daily interactions to unlock various rewards. From the tentative first meetings to becoming inseparable confidants, and finally, to being each other's irreplaceable one—you will experience the deepening of your connection day by day. Personalized AI Companions: Powered by the Molili model, characters feature long-term memory, emotional simulation, and evolving personality traits. Vivid Live2D Animation: Experience a lively desktop companion with beautiful animations and rich interactions. Powerful Assistant Tools: Integrated with practical functions like web search, deep thought analysis, and AI image generation. In-depth Relationship System: Journey from first encounters to deep understanding as you gradually strengthen your emotional bond. Rich Customization: Dress up your partner in different outfits and accessories to create your favorite look. Stress‑free companionship: the core experience is free forever (including unlimited AI chat powered by cost‑efficient models). Only high‑performance AI features require a quota‑based subscription. rows.short_description: Vantan Game Academy TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025 Exhibition Match the rhythm of flowing notes, convert beats into power, and defeat your enemies! A psychedelic beat battle to bring sound (freedom) back to the people!
rows.description_html: Exhibited at Vantan Game Academy – TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025 This game is a single-player rhythm action game that fuses rhythm gameplay with 3D combat. Press buttons to the beat to attack your enemies, and dodge their strikes with precise timing. Unleash powerful special moves by chaining your attacks and take down the boss! <Story> In the 2080s, Neo-Pulse City is ruled by the “HARMONY System,” which manipulates human emotions through music. Former idol Rin-Ha’s singing voice has been banned, and her once-bright future was cut short... Yet, determined to reclaim the freedom of music, Rin-Ha rises up against the giant corporation Rhythm Corp. Strike to the rhythm, turn the beat into your strength, and fight to reclaim the sound — your freedom — in this psychedelic beat battle! Only the tutorial supports both Japanese and English subtitles. All voice lines are in Japanese.

rows.short_description: In Bohemia's shadows, hunt the Bane of Darkness. Explore, fight, and grow stronger on your quest to rescue your beloved from the wicked vampire lord.
rows.description_html: Become the Vampire Hunter  As the relentless vampire hunter Lovec, storm through a gothic mansion hidden deep in the forests of Bohemia. Wield devastating weapons, grow stronger with every victory, and carve a path through relentless hordes of haunting enemies on your quest to rescue your beloved Eliska from the wicked vampire lord, Mikhail.  It’s time to hunt the Bane of Darkness.    Game Features  Storm the vampire lord's lair! From the eerie Bohemian forest to a deadly mansion, explore the secrets hidden in the shadows.  Wield devastating weapons! Collect and master lethal weapons that deal more damage as you get stronger.  Dash into battle! Practice and use dash attack to vanquish foes at light speed.  Face relentless hordes of enemies! Skeletons, ghouls, skulls, and animated armor. Carve a path through them all! Immerse into the narrative! Cinematic cutscenes will envelop you into seamless gameplay.   Experience a fusion of music! With influences from a variety of genres, the score from Bane of Darkness provides a unique take on haunted symphonies and heart-racing beats.

rows.name: REAL MOON
rows.short_description: Explore a precisely recreated lunar surface built from real data and a JAXA-backed simulation.
rows.description_html: <A Realistic Lunar Surface Built from Observation Data> Using a simulation environment developed through joint research between JAXA and historia Inc., this game recreates a scientifically grounded, realistic Moon. - High-resolution DEM data (terrain elevation) - Statistical crater distribution - Natural rock dispersion patterns - Sun, Earth, and Moon positions that change over time The lunar terrain featured in this game is a result of joint research with JAXA. <Explore the Lunar Surface> Walk across the precisely recreated Moon, pilot a rover, and explore freely at your own pace. Alone on the lunar surface, you receive a single mission. In addition to observation data, slopes of craters and other features are synthesized based on scientific studies and added to the terrain data. Playtime: 15–30 minutes

rows.name: 12, Memory Lane
rows.short_description: Explore the shifting manor of the enigmatic Henri Villemaine and uncover the truth behind his family’s sudden disappearance. Bend reality to recreate the scenes from his diary and expose long-buried secrets. What if your role in this case went beyond that of a simple investigator?
rows.description_html: 12 Memory Lane is a first-person narrative mystery game. Step inside the manor of the elusive Henry Villemaine and piece together the slices of life leading up to the sudden disappearance of his family. EXPLORE AN EVER-SHIFTING MANSION Henry Villemaine’s mansion is constantly shifting : faces change in photographs, furniture moves when you’re not looking... Use post-it notes to mark objects and keep them fixed in place as you explore. RECREATE SCENES FROM A FRAGMENTED JOURNAL Henry’s personal journal is your only trustworthy guide. Through its pages, relive intimate moments of family life and interpret his memories to restore each room, deducing the correct placement of furniture and objects. UNCOVER UNSPOKEN FAMILY SECRETS Every room holds the silent truth of a member of the Villemaine family. Set the mansion right to reveal long-buried secrets… and uncover whether your role in this mystery is more than that of a simple investigator.

Help Pancake on his quest to stop the megalomaniacal Dr. Squid from spreading his ruthless influence! Three challenging and action-packed levels to explore! Can you guide Pancake through the perils before him? Colorful and vibrant visuals inspired by classic platformers! A cartoony cast of bad guys - beware of Dr. Squid and his army of minions! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Green Wave
rows.short_description: Restore order to chaos in Green Wave, a not so serious traffic management game. Time your traffic lights perfectly to keep the city moving or watch it descend into bumper-to-bumper madness.
rows.description_html: The traffic control system in Green Wave has broken down!  Every light is stuck on red. That’s where you come in. Take control of the lights and switch them to green at just the right moment to keep the cars moving. But be careful: the lights will turn red again on their own, and drivers obey them without question. Time your actions perfectly to avoid pileups and restore order to the chaos! Play through 15 handcrafted levels and bring every intersection back under control. Earn up to three stars per level for exceptional performance and smooth traffic flow. About the development Green Wave is my first completed solo project and a major step in my journey as an indie developer. I created it entirely in my free time alongside a full-time job, so while the scope is small and there may be a few rough edges, every part of it is built with care and enthusiasm. There are currently no plans for new content, but I’m already working on my next project, applying everything I’ve learned from Green Wave . If you’d like to follow my progress or learn more about the development process, check out my social media channels.

rows.name: Sudoku Dreams
rows.short_description: Easy on the eyes and easy to play, customizable themes and hints.
rows.description_html: Sudoku Dreams is a no-frills, no-nonsense experience that’s easy on the eyes and easy to play. It won’t hold your hand because you already know how to play. Despite the name, the easy puzzles will require you to be awake, and the harder ones will haunt you in your sleep.  Sweet Dreams! Features: Four Difficulty Levels Clean and Simple Interface New Puzzles Every Day Customizable Themes and Colors Hints and Records Available

rows.name: Kill the Demon Lord
rows.short_description: Instead of waiting at the end of your adventure, the Demon Lord decided to fight you right at the very beginning. Not very sporting of her... Pretty sure she broke a few rules. She can’t keep this up forever. Kill the anomaly.
rows.description_html: Explore a vast, living world teeming with vibrant towns, ancient ruins, and untold mysteries waiting beyond every horizon. Slay evil dragons and monsters, conquer the forces of darkness threatening to consume the world. Gather legendary weapons, master forbidden magics, and uncover the long-lost secrets of your bloodline. Experience an epic tale of courage, friendship, betrayal, and destiny written in the fires of battle. Kill the Demon Lord The difficulty scaling systems are not functioning. While you’re at level 1 and unarmed, the Demon Lord has every ability and bullet-hell pattern you were only meant to face at the very end of your adventure. Breaches in the game’s core systems have been detected. She may have gained admin access and privileges. Contingency protocols will kick in soon. Ones that can override even her. You can always respawn, she cannot. You just need to kill her once.

rows.name: Fracta Regna
rows.short_description: Fracta Regna is a short tactical-strategy experience where you must conquer territories by fight enemy points of interest.
rows.description_html: Begin your journey with your own territory and fight against the three other kings! Conquer their strongholds to obtain their lands. You must defeat the enemy army in a tactical fight to conquer its stronghold. Take advantage of your positions, your units and turn the situation to your advantage! Each battle map is generated procedurally, take care of the terrain before deploying your troops. You can add your own maps for the conquest by importing a PNG file too!

rows.name: Biltur Simulator
rows.short_description: Biltur is an Early Access driving simulation focused on authentic traffic and realistic car physics, providing essential, zero-pressure training for new and experienced drivers to master road rules and control.
rows.description_html: Biltur: Realistic Driving Simulator (Early Access) Get Behind the Wheel. Gain Real-World Confidence. Start Your Journey. Tired of dry, boring driving lessons? Biltur is the realistic driving simulator built to prepare you for the road, without the pressure of real-world traffic. Whether you're a curious beginner (Ages 10+) learning the basics of car control, a teen prepping for your first lessons, or an adult looking to safely brush up on road rules, Biltur is your ultimate practice partner. For the New Learner (Ages 10+ & Teens) Realism Meets Fun: Experience car physics and handling that strives for realism. Feel the force feedback that imitates the tires gripping the asphalt and the momentum that shifts in every turn. We aim to be one of the most realistic car rides you can take from your desk. Master the Controls: Practice the fundamentals at your own pace. Perfect steering precision, gentle braking, and smooth acceleration before you ever sit in a real driver's seat. The Full Traffic Challenge: Our dynamic AI traffic system replicates real-world behaviors; from careful commuters to aggressive drivers, unexpected pedestrians, or even moose! Learn to anticipate, react, and make safe decisions in dense, realistic city and rural environments. Conquer Tricky Maneuvers: Perfect three-point turns, parking with a backup camera, and navigating roundabouts in a risk-free environment. Retry complex scenarios until they become second nature. For Parents & The Focused Adult Zero-Risk Training: Provide your future driver with a safe, controlled environment to make mistakes and learn from them. There's no damage, no real-world cost, and no risk to property or people. Real-World Traffic Simulation: Our focus is on the reality of driving. Practice merging onto highways, handling rush-hour congestion, and following road signs and signals with professional-grade accuracy. Built for Real Driving: Unlike arcade racers, Biltur uses a precision-tuned physics engine to focus on the weight, feel, and response of an everyday vehicle, giving you true-road   muscle memory. Comprehensive Environments: Drive through cities, quiet suburbs, and challenging rural roads, experiencing variable weather (rain, snow) and day/night cycles to ensure practice under all conditions. Early Access Disclaimer Biltur is currently in Early Access . This means the core driving experience, physics, and traffic systems have been prioritized first, while some content (like specific weather conditions or detailed situations and lessons) is still in development. Currently Included: Daylight driving with fair weather. One map with a small city area, a highway, and rural area. Varied speed limits. Traffic signs used on real roads. Future Plans: We plan to introduce more complex weather systems ( Rain, Snow ), more distinct environments, and expanded, structured situations based on community feedback. Your feedback directly shapes our roadmap, helping us prioritize and deliver the most impactful features for the final release! Key Features: Realistic Physics Full Support for Steering Wheels, Pedals,  Handles, and Shifters Dynamic AI Traffic and Pedestrian Systems City & Rural Environments Biltur: Stop just thinking about driving. Start practicing.

rows.name: Megastore Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Expand from a small shop to a two-floor giant with Bakery, Clothing, Electronics, and more. Bake your own dough, hire staff, serve customers, and use forklifts and pallet jacks to keep the store running smoothly.
rows.description_html: BUILD YOUR MEGASTORE Start with $400 ; choose a department from clothing, toys, bakery, sports, grocery, music , buy your first shelves and products, open for business, and grow. KEEP EVERY SHELF STOCKED Monitor all departments, refill shortages fast, and don’t miss sales. DEPARTMENT-SPECIFIC FEATURES Each department comes with its own mechanics. In the bakery, order dough, purchase an oven, and bake your products. STOCK MANAGEMENT Track shelves in real time, top up any missing items, and unload trucks quickly with a hand truck. GROW & EXPAND Expand your megastore in any direction by purchasing new sections. OPEN THE SECOND FLOOR Open the upper floor to offer more space to your customers. Place departments wherever you like and make sure everything stays accessible. MANAGE YOUR TEAM Hire cashiers, stockers, bakers, and more; manage shifts and performance. SERVICE ROOM & WAREHOUSE A massive warehouse with 4 truck loading bays and access to both floors. Buy warehouse equipment like a pallet robot, forklift, and pallet jack. Manage the entire operation with stock control panels and warehouse displays. Keep items like computers and cleaning supplies in the service room to keep your store organized! AND MUCH MORE Attract more customers to your megastore with ads and product promotions . Bring your store to life with talking, reactive NPCs . Boost satisfaction with a returns desk . Buy recycling bins and turn empty boxes into cash . Decorate your megastore the way you like with department-specific decorations and furniture : fitting rooms, various wall and floor customizations, a bakery tray rack , and much more. ( Formerly known as Urban Supermarket Simulator )

rows.name: Low Poly Mouse Game
rows.short_description: 2-4 Sneaky and squeaky low-poly mice face off against a lone cat in the battlefield of a human house. Mice use proximity chat to communicate with other players, while the cat hunts their noises. Will the mice perform enough tasks to destroy the house, or will the cat defeat enough mice to save it?
rows.description_html: 2-4 Sneaky and squeaky low-poly mice face off against a lone cat in the battlefield of a human house. Mice use proximity chat to communicate with other players, while the cat hunts their noises. Will the mice perform enough tasks to destroy the house, or will the cat defeat enough mice to save it? Faction of Chaos - The Mice Win condition: Complete enough standard tasks, then complete both final tasks Perform tasks that ruin the household just for the love of the game Eat cheese to get a temporary speed boost Jump up small obstacles and utilize mouse tunnels to navigate the environment Communicate or spout nonsense with other mice utilizing proximity chat. Sole Defender of The House - The Cat Win condition: Bring down the lives of the mouse team to 0 Attack mice by pouncing or pawing them Utilize your superior movement with faster speed, a bigger jump, and a pounce. Track mice by audio cues and their trails. Sleep to revitalize, as energy drops throughout the game. Energy determines whether the cat moves fast or slow. In a house that boasts a lot of verticality and tricks, will the little rascals come on top, or will the cat prevail? This game was made as a Senior Capstone project for RPI's Games and Simulation Arts and Sciences program.
