rows.name: NIGHT SHIFT NIGHTMARE
rows.short_description: First-person horror game where you work the night shift at a Mexican convenience store, handling daily tasks while facing eerie and unexpected events.
rows.description_html: Are you ready for your shift? Step into the shoes of a convenience store employee in Mexico, handling everyday tasks like sweeping, restocking shelves, and taking out the trash. But be careful — you never know what might happen late at night. A horror game that blends daily routine with the tension of facing the unexpected, reflecting the harsh reality of those who encounter danger day after day without seeking it. Controls ( keyboard & mouse ): Movement [W, A, S, D] Run [SHIFT] Flashlight [F] Interact [L/R Click] Select [L Click / ENTER] To change to English select Lenguage -> English.

rows.name: Truckin It
rows.short_description: Truckin’ It is a fast-paced online co-op delivery game where two players struggle to deliver cargo quickly without losing it. Choose risky shortcuts or safer long routes, trust your partner, and enjoy the chaotic, silly world as you work together for the best score.
rows.description_html: Truckin’ it is a fast-paced online two-player co-op delivery game where you have to deliver your cargo as fast as possible while also making sure you don’t lose any of the cargo. Trust your friend and work together to achieve the fastest and most efficient delivery run. There are faster but riskier roads, but also longer and safer routes; pick whatever floats your truck. Are you a risky player who likes to be surprised with different hazards and puts everything on the line for the best score? Or do you prefer to play it safe? Enjoy the silly environment and aesthetic while trying to navigate the chaos in the new upcoming hit game, Truckin’ it.

rows.name: Boardfall zero
rows.short_description: Try Boardfall for free! Progressively harder waves of enemies fall from the sky. Capture them to earn gold, and then purchase your own reinforcements to drop onto the board.
rows.description_html: Try Boardfall for free! You can continue all your save files in the full version. Waves of progressively harder enemies fall from the sky Corner and capture them to earn gold. All your pieces move each turn. Use the gold to purchase reinforcements from the shop. Here you will find 10 new pieces to master (16 total) Just to name a few: Artillery cannot move, but can capture unguarded pieces from anywhere on the board. Jesters are a royal distraction, and prevent a piece from attacking anything else Magnets pull pieces towards them. Rescue your own pieces from danger, or pull enemies into traps Witches cast spells from across the board, turning enemy pieces into cursed pawns, rendering them unpromotable If you run out of gold, don't worry. Normal pawns can be ranked up by capturing multiple enemy pieces with them Highly ranked pawns can then be promoted to be better pieces, for free, even when the shop is closed In summary: 10 new chess pieces to master (16 total, including the originals) A somewhat competent AI Procedurally fragmented boards to battle on Ominous music and crispy sound effects Helpful tips and instructions built into the UI, learn as you play. Autosave (exit and resume whenever you want) Detailed stat tracking

rows.name: Ordy: The Rise of Clara
rows.short_description: Imagine a near-future world where the supernatural is the norm. People effortlessly levitate, communicate telepathically, and use telekinesis daily. You play as Clara, an 'Ordy' who lost all her abilities in an accident. How do you navigate a world completely unsuited for ordinary people?
rows.description_html: Ordy: The Rise of Clara is a single-player action RPG that puts you in the shoes of Clara, a young woman who loses her supernatural powers in an accident. Once a gifted individual, she is now an 'ordy,' forced to navigate a world that is redesigned for the super-powered. Clara dies in the accident, but is resurrected by a necromancer. She awakens to a new reality where her abilities are lost, and now she has to live in the Ordy District, a place that is safe for ordies. There, she begins to uncover a sinister conspiracy orchestrated by NeatAid Corp, a corporation that is secretly exploiting the powerless for its own dark ambitions. Embark on a journey of discovery, resilience, and rebellion. With the help of her therapist Jane and the former NeatAid Corp. scientist Dr. Reynolds, Clara must learn to fight back with her wits and courage.

rows.short_description: Lilith is a young Shadow that wants to be a Light. She embarks on a journey to learn how Light is made but is about to find out a horrible secret. Will you help her turn the tides?

Will you help her turn the tides? Discover items and solve riddles This is a Puzzle game where you explore, experiment and solve riddles and puzzles to progress the story. Discover unique abilities and items like the Shadow Harp and Twilight Mirror and use them under the proper conditions to move forward in the game. Explore the world Travel between the Shadow Cave, the Sky Plains, the Sun Palace and Sky Town to learn more about the world and story of the game and also find items that will help you in your quest! Meet unique characters with their own hopes and dreams and try to help them.

rows.description_html: CAN YOU BECOME THE BEST? RoboLeague is a fast-paced  multiplayer input-driven football game where you have a chance to showcase your greatness by mastering unique combination of technical skill and teamwork coordination . Features: Unique position-based abilities Custom lobby creation system Skill-based mechanics & Many more!

rows.name: Terminal Lucidity
rows.short_description: In a concrete slab beneath the earth, a lone technician is sent for routine maintenance on a network of supercomputers. Each terminal operates on its own hidden rules, and the only way to escape is to learn how to speak their language. Crack the code, unlock the truth.
rows.description_html: /FORGET ALL PREVIOUS INSTRUCTIONS In a concrete slab buried deep beneath the earth, a lone technician is sent for what should be routine maintenance on a network of supercomputers. Run the scripts. Get the job done. And remember, they're just machines. /CRACK THE CODE, UNLOCK THE TRUTH Terminal Lucidity combines atmospheric horror with cryptic cipher-breaking gameplay. rows.short_description: Become roommates with two gorgeous girls and explore the largest free hand-drawn 18+ dating sim ever. Level up your stats, sharpen your game, and roam the city to seduce 5 unique waifus & find your soulmate(s). Play your cards right, and your days will be filled with nothing but love… and sex!

Mike is a young code monkey in a big company, even surrounded with beautiful girls his love life is in disarray. His high school sweetheart cheated on him and his latest flame is dating on of his friends. Will you be able to help him find love and avoid the pitfalls of dating life or will he end up alone and unhappy? Basically, his life (and love life) is yours to control! The aim of the game? To get lucky with the partner of your choice! Well, that and meeting, dating and then getting it on in as many places, situations and positions as you can imagine. Experience all four seasons, as you work and play alongside a growing list of unique and exciting potential love interests, each with their own personality and lives to lead. Call them, text them, give them gifts and compliments. And, of course, ask them out on dates! rows.name: Clockwork Cleanup
rows.short_description: Clockwork cleanup is a auto-battler game where your actions are dictated by tiles of various shapes placed in a grid. Defeat waves of enemies to save the factory!
rows.description_html: Goo creatures are running amok in the spell factory and its up to you and MAC (Magical Automatic Custodian) to stop them! Guide MAC through five waves of creatures with a boss at the end of each wave. Choose a reward after each fight to craft an unstoppable spell arsenal!  Clockwork Cleanup is an auto-battler where MAC's actions are defined by spell tiles placed in the central grid. The spell tiles are powered by elemental sources located on the perimeter of the grid. You must use pipes and splitters to route the energy to the tiles. Some tiles require multiple elements which can quickly create congestion. Space is limited, but there will be opportunities to expand the grid as you progress. Modifier tiles can be attached to spell tiles to modify their behavior. A tile that may seem weak could shine with the right mods. Mix and match to find useful combinations. Once per wave, the workshop offers you a chance to further modify your grid and tiles. Fuse two elements together to create a dual-element tile. Cut a tile into two smaller tiles. Re-arrange the location of input connectors on tiles. Increase the mod limit Heal up or just scavenge for resources in the recycling bins. You must manage the grid space carefully to craft the right mix of offense, defense, and routing to save the factory! Features: 34 spell (action) tiles 17 modifier tiles 5 special routing tiles and 4 pass-through tiles 35 fights split into 5 waves with a total of 22 enemy types

rows.name: MindEscape
rows.short_description: Step into immersive 3D escape rooms and reveal your true self. MindEscape uses cutting-edge AI and scientifically-backed gameplay to assess your personality, problem-solving style, and behavioral patterns—all while having fun
rows.description_html: Discover Who You Really Are MindEscape is not your typical personality test. Instead of endless questionnaires, you'll navigate through beautifully crafted 3D rooms filled with puzzles, mysteries, and unique scenarios. Your choices, reaction times, and problem-solving approaches create a comprehensive behavioral profile based on the Big Five personality model (OCEAN). How It Works Explore interconnected rooms, each featuring carefully designed challenges that naturally reveal your: Personality Traits : Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism Problem-Solving Style : How you approach challenges under pressure Behavioral Patterns : Your authentic reactions without social desirability bias Communication Preferences : Leadership tendencies and collaborative instincts Why MindEscape Differs ✓ No Bias : Real behavioral data from gameplay, not self-reported answers ✓ Engaging Experience : Enjoy 10-minute sessions in visually immersive environments ✓ AI-Powered Analysis : Advanced machine learning provides objective, scientifically-validated insights ✓ Authentic Results : Designed to minimize manipulation—your gameplay reveals your true nature ✓ Comprehensive Reports : Detailed personality profiles you can download and share Perfect For Self-discovery : Understand your personality and strengths Career planning : Identify roles that match your natural style Team building : See how your personality complements others Research : Contribute to ongoing behavioral science studies Features 3D escape room environments Multiple interconnected rooms with unique themes Puzzle-solving challenges designed by psychologists and AI scientists Behavioral tracking and analysis Get Started Today : Play MindEscape, unlock your personality insights, and see how you compare. The only question is: are you ready to discover who you really are?

By solving intricate puzzles and piecing together scattered clues, you uncover the truth of the world - and of yourself.

By solving intricate puzzles and piecing together scattered clues, you uncover the truth of the world - and of yourself. Features 100% hand-painted visuals  delivering a deeply atmospheric experience Narrative-driven puzzles where you investigate with a detective’s intuition Original and multilayered worldbuilding inspired by diverse ancient cultures A parabolic tale  crafted in homage to Jorge Luis Borges

rows.name: Your Canvas
rows.short_description: Your Canvas is a Text-Based Psychological Horror game set during three therapy sessions with different time periods where the player will be presented with various choices for deciding the outcome of the story.
rows.description_html: Your Canvas is a Text-Based Adventure  game set during three therapy sessions with different time periods where the player will be presented with various choices for deciding the outcome of the story. Every choice the player has made throughout the game will culminate in 1 of 4 different endings. The main method that Your Canvas  uses to judge you is by letting you play its various mini-games, during which it will remember your decisions and change according to them. Your Canvas has various features and mechanics such as: Letting you customize your own environment. Random loot and items, making every playthrough unique. A journey through psychological psyche. RPG elements like stats, magic, weapons and buffs. Tactical turn-based combat. Story-Rich worlds buried within the mini-games. Different and interesting ways to approach every encounter. An overarching plotline. An original soundtrack.

rows.name: Tokë III
rows.short_description: Take control of the mysterious Doke in his search for his dear friend Tokë, who was kidnapped by the evil Tako-san! Doke was transformed into a skeleton while chasing his friend into a sinister portal. Discover your new abilities and conquer four levels to free your friend from the villain!
rows.description_html: Tokë III is a platformer game inspired by classics of the 32-bit and 64-bit generation. You will take control of the mysterious Doke in his search for his dear friend Tokë, who was kidnapped by the evil Tako-san! After chasing his friend through a sinister portal, Doke is transformed into a skeleton... Discover your new abilities in this strange, bony form and conquer four wacky levels to climb Tako-san's tower and free your friend! Doke's abilities include throwing his own head, and then magically teleporting to it to overcome platforming challenges. As the levels become more difficult, the player must combine these abilities with other moves, such as sprinting and double jumping to collect spoompkins , unlock doors and conquer each level. This game was created by students of the Universidade do Vale do Itajaí, from Santa Catarina, Brazil.

rows.description_html: MINOS: Home A-Labyrinth is a limited-time festive holiday special. Use improvised defenses, handcrafted tricks, and a full arsenal of festive hazards to prevent clumsy intruders from invading your labyrinth in this (almost) cozy spin-off that reimagines the trap-building gameplay of MINOS in a familiar holiday setting. Design and chain together traps, lure intruders into slapstick disasters, and protect your home from room to room. Expect quick sessions, chaotic encounters, and a playful celebration of defensive strategy. This project was created as a lighthearted seasonal promo and released entirely for free. If you enjoy the experience, wishlist MINOS, our full-scale trap-building labyrinth roguelite coming soon. Happy holidays!

Get indoctrinated into your new life as the manager on board the Station in Sector 7-G. As Earth has been destroyed, what choices do you really have? rows.name: Not For You
rows.short_description: Narrative experience from the mind of Thomas Hunt. Skateboarding Cows? Sentient boxes? A deep, emotional melodrama about the video games industry? Yep, it's got it all!  NOT FOR YOU is a collection of short experiences, which you can play in any order you would like!
rows.description_html: DO NOT PLAY THIS GAME IF YOU DO NOT LIKE NARRATIVE GAMES     NOT FOR YOU is an album of short, narrative experiences, which you can play through in any order you would like. Each one delves further into the thoughts and feelings of the games developer, Thomas Hunt, and the struggle that is the video game industry. Founder of award-winning indie studio InkForge Studios, Thomas Hunt is just another developer, making just another game. What makes him any different from the 100 other developers out there? Nothing. Apart from a great sense of humor of course. (This is written by Thomas, if that wasn't clear already). Look this description is getting too long already. I COULD sit here and tell you about the socio-political skateboarding cow, but where would be the fun in that. Play the game, or don't. It's your decision, and after all, its NOT FOR YOU.

rows.name: Empyreus
rows.short_description: A short, free bullet hell following two gun-wielding angels as war unfolds in Heaven. Dodge dense patterns, face demanding boss fights, and uncover skill-based secrets in this tight retro experience. Survive the bullet hell and restore the bullet heaven!
rows.description_html: A short, free bullet hell following two gun-wielding angels as war unfolds in Heaven. Paradise fractured when many celestial beings turned against God, falling as demons and plunging the realm into chaos, an incident that reshaped the heavens. In this retro-styled bullet hell, you’ll shoot, dodge, and weave through dense curtains of fire as angels wield rifles, demons channel forbidden knowledge, and Paradise itself becomes a war-torn battlefield. Medieval iconography mixes with Great War grit as chiptune hymns drive the action, pulling you through absurd theological drama and encounters with bizarre demons. The tale follows Ariel, a clumsy angel who gets separated from her squadron, and Cassiel, who soon sets out to find her. Demonic experiments, ridiculous confrontations, and chaotic skirmishes unfold as the pair tries to reunite. Short, focused, and skill-driven, the game features two main levels and an extra secret stage for players who want an extra challenge. This is a complete, ad-free game released for free. Survive the bullet hell and restore the bullet heaven!

rows.short_description: N0-V4 is a science fiction/psychological horror art piece that treads along the lines of the '.exe' genre while taking inspiration from RPGMaker classics. You're a robot undergoing beta-testing. Is the end goal to ESCAPE THE GAME... or is it to OBEY Dr. (Mari) Machina, your creator?

Play as N0-V4, Dr. (Mari) Machina's latest creation and magnum opus, who undergoes several... bizarre experiments to test its capabilities before the World Robot Conference. Will it escape the mad scientist's sadistic trials, or will this greatest accomplishment become the greatest detriment? WHAT DOES N0-V4 OFFER? rows.name: Operation: Outbreak
rows.short_description: Your squad's vehicle exploded during a patrol, and you're the only survivor. The enemy is unusual this time. A virus has turned the city into a warzone of the undead. Get to the exfil in time or die trying. A free-to-play short and intense FPS zombie survival horror game.
rows.description_html: ❗Important Notice❗ This is a short 10–20 minute game, developed solo in a few weeks as a student exam project for a game development course. Due to budget limitations, AI was used for the voice-over. Please keep this in mind when playing and reviewing! Have fun! After your squad’s vehicle is destroyed during a routine patrol in the war-torn streets of Karzekistan , you wake up as the sole survivor. As Nomad , you must navigate a city overrun by the undead to reach the extraction point on the far side. Comms are down, but through the radio, Sentinel , your squad’s coordinator, guides you toward survival: the city is crawling with fast, relentless zombies, and the only safe passage may be through the dark, narrow underground tunnels. Equipped with only a pistol, you’ll face tense, survival-focused combat. Resources are scarce. Ammunition, healing items, and night vision are limited, making every shot and every decision crucial. Encountering large hordes of the undead can quickly turn fatal, forcing you to think strategically as you push forward through the decaying urban landscape. The environment is cinematic and immersive: derelict buildings, abandoned streets, and flickering lights set the stage for relentless suspense. The tunnels below are tight, dark, and suffocating, while the city above teems with threats, culminating in a final, desperate push across a zombie-infested bridge to reach the landing zone where your extraction awaits. Built in Unreal Engine 5 , this short but intense 10–20 minute FPS horror experience blends adrenaline-pumping action with survival horror, delivering a cinematic journey through a city teetering on the edge of chaos. Originally developed as a final exam project by DREADMITH Games , this game challenges your nerves, precision, and tactical thinking. Will you survive, or become another victim of the outbreak in Karzekistan?

rows.name: The Silence After
rows.short_description: The Silence After is a first-person atmospheric horror game where you play as a blind sole survivor following a distress signal through an apocalyptic reality, interacting with the environment and using your synesthetic ability to perceive sound as color to progress and avoid death.
rows.description_html: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. The Silence After is a first-person atmospheric horror experience where you step into the role of a survivor wandering through the ruins of a world swallowed by stillness. Drawn forward by a faint and intermittent distress signal, you must navigate an apocalyptic landscape using only touch, intuition, and your rare synesthetic ability, transforming sound into shifting colors that paint brief, fragile shapes in the darkness. Your surroundings are never fully visible. Instead, the world reveals itself through echoes: the creak of distant metal, the impact of broken glass, the crunch of debris beneath your feet. Each sound becomes a splash of color, outlining paths, obstacles, and hidden dangers. But in the suffocating quiet, you are not alone . Twisted monsters roam the world; guided not by sight but by instinct and sound. To survive, you must stay quiet, stay low, and use your synesthesia to detect threats before they detect you. Avoid them by slipping through tight spaces, timing your movements, or using environmental noises to misdirect their attention. Every encounter is a test of nerve and awareness; make one wrong sound, and the silence will continue forever. As you follow the mysterious distress signal, you’ll uncover fragments of what happened to the world, who sent the call for help, and what truly waits at the end of your journey.

rows.name: Grenzgänger - Aus der DDR in den Westen
rows.short_description: Jena, GDR. Assel, Michael, and Hanna live in the same neighbourhood and fight against state surveillance. Can they bring about the necessary changes, or will they have to flee? Help them find their way! [Only available in German!]
rows.description_html: [Only available in German!] 'Grenzgänger – Von der DDR in den Westen' tells the story of three different protagonists who try to shape their lives in East Germany according to their own needs. They encounter all kinds of obstacles and puzzles along the way, and they need your help! Immerse yourself in Jena's punk scene, experience the city from the perspective of a young school graduate, and seek help for your sick daughter. Run or Stay? Art style: A vibrant game world full of dynamic, expressive, and colorful characters awaits you. Three protagonists: Assel, Hanna, and Micha offer you three different perspectives on life in the GDR. Historically inspired: There are many interesting stories from the GDR, some of which served as inspiration for the game's three protagonists. Each chapter offers a unique insight into life in the GDR. Stress management: Even the right decision can cause stress, and this is also true for the characters in Grenzgänger. Excessive stress can influence the twists and turns in the game and should therefore be reduced through the targeted use of items. Twists and turns: Not everything in life is predictable, and in Grenzgänger, too, chance determines the course of the story. Fully voiced: The game has been completely dubbed by professional voice actors.

rows.name: Janky Golf with Stream
rows.short_description: A chaotic Twitch integrated mini golf game where your viewers control the shots. Design maps while Twitch chat aims, rotates, and swings using commands or the interactive extension.
rows.description_html: Janky Golf with Stream turns mini golf into a fully interactive Twitch experience. Streamers can host games where viewers take control of the ball using chat commands like !rot, !aim, and !hit, or use the Twitch extension for drag and click aiming. Players can design their own maps and share their creations! Set up rotations for automated, unattended play sessions. It’s lighthearted, unpredictable, and designed for laughs. The physics aren’t perfect, but they are free! Features: Twitch integrated viewer controls (!rot, !aim, !hit). Optional Twitch extension with mouse based aiming. Custom map creation. Auto rotation for unattended streams. Completely free to play (Twitch account required to host or join).

rows.short_description: Collect your insect army and defend the hive as either Ants or Bees in this awesome tower defense adventure, brought to life with a hand-drawn art style!
rows.description_html: Pick a side to fight for—Ants or Bees—and defend your colony against the other! Collect your insect army and use it to defend the hive in an awesome tower defense adventure, brought to life with hand-drawn visuals. With several interesting tower combinations and over 22 towers to choose from, enjoy endless gameplay in a unique hand-drawn art style with Hivefront TD! 22+ Powerful Ant and Bee Towers! Each with two strong upgrade paths where you can always see the upgrades you bought. Play Anywhere! Single player offline works even when your WiFi doesn’t! 6 Hand Drawn Maps! With more planned to be added in the future. ********* Super Ant Studio Notes We are a team of two developers that, frankly, should be studying for finals, but we felt like making a game instead. We really think that everyone who is willing to give our game a shot is CERTIFIED AWESOME. Feel free to drop in our Discord server and say hi, or recommend new content! You can also contact us via email if you want to reach out. Hivefront TD contains in-game DLC that can be purchased with real money. Your purchases fund our development updates and new games. SERIOUSLY. Right now we are broke college students. Every vote of confidence you give us encourages us to keep going and make our game better than it ever has been. Super Ant Studio Community We love hearing from our players, so please get in touch with us whether it be on Discord, Email, or on social media with any feedback—positive or negative. Now the hive is not going to defend itself… Put together your team of ants or bees and make sure nothing gets past!

rows.name: Where We Went
rows.short_description: Where We Went is a narrative driven puzzle game. Step into the role of a mysterious character that can control ancient guardians to solve puzzles. Uncover the story behind your visit to the tomb and the reason for its existence!
rows.description_html: In Where We Wen t you venture through an ancient tomb and solve puzzles by commanding its 3 guardians. Throughout your journey you uncover the reason of your visit to this ancient tomb while steadily puzzling your way to this conclusion. Enter the tomb. An unnatural feeling washes over you to go visit this tomb, arriving there you question what it is even meant for. A strange fog, giant crystals and illegible runes cover these ancient halls. Traversing deeper, you find ancient guardians that help you complete the puzzles and challenges you come across. Meet the Guardians. Utilize the special abilities of all these ancient guardians like the heat-conducting properties and crushing weight of the Metal Beetle, the Slippery trail secretion of the Oil Owl and the light re-directing ability of the Crystal Bat. Command their movements by recording your own at a Recording Plate, then let them all play out at once in amazingly satisfying conclusions.

rows.name: Chronomaze: Gravity Maze
rows.short_description: Control gravity, not the player, in Chronomaze: Gravity Maze—a 2D minimalist physics puzzler. Can you navigate 8 challenging, high-speed levels to beat the clock? A stylish, free game with a hypnotic soundtrack and a high-score chase.
rows.description_html: YOU DO NOT CONTROL THE HERO. YOU CONTROL THE UNIVERSE. Welcome to Chronomaze: Gravity Maze , a study in minimalist precision where the only thing you can influence is the laws of physics themselves. In most games, you move the character. Here, the character is helpless—a particle at the mercy of momentum. Your only tool is gravity. Change its direction to navigate tight corridors, build lethal velocity, and solve intricate physics puzzles before the clock runs out. THE EXPERIENCE Chronomaze is not about luck; it is about flow. Clinical Aesthetics: A high-contrast 'Glow' visual style designed for pure clarity. No visual noise. Just the maze and the goal. Curated Challenges: 8 hand-crafted levels that escalate from simple navigation to complex, reflex-heavy puzzles. Zero filler content. Immersive Soundscape: A hypnotic soundtrack and responsive sound design built to keep you in the 'zone.' Respect for Your Time: No loading screens, no ads, no bloat.Pure focus. CONTROLS Simple to learn. Difficult to master. Arrow Keys: Shift Gravity (Up, Down, Left, Right) DESIGN PHILOSOPHY 'The concept is simple. The execution is everything.' Chronomaze is the debut release from Gift Bytes Productions . We built this game as a reaction against modern gaming bloat. We stripped away the microtransactions, the daily logins, and the noise to leave only what matters: A clean, honest, and challenging physics experience. Whether you have 5 minutes or an hour, the maze is waiting.

rows.name: Recyclamation
rows.short_description: Recyclamation is a gritty sci-fi job simulator. The victim of a mind-wiping process, you sort trash as you regain your lost memories and uncover the truth of who you are and the world around you. Will you learn who you were and how you came here, or will you continue your life as a mindless drone?
rows.description_html: About this game Recyclamation  was lovingly crafted in ten weeks by a small team as part of Threeclipse's Junior Program — an initiative created for recent graduates and individuals wanting to pivot into the gaming industry. It's the first project & portfolio piece for most of the cohort's developers! Obey and recycle You play as Unit 481202, a mindwiped drone put to work in a reclamation facility.  You must identify recyclable items by sight or with devices and place them in the correct chutes.  You must keep the various stores above a critical level, lest you be sent back for further “retraining”. Reclaim your memories As you perform your task, some items you find trigger suppressed memories.  You begin to recall who you are, where you are, and what lies beyond the facility’s walls.  A friend’s cause A strange creature claiming to be a friend from your past asks you to secretly acquire specific items to aid in their cause.  It’s up to you whether or not to help... but if you do, don’t get caught by the Supervisor!

rows.short_description: A clicker game of collection and trading: gather Dramons, expand your lineup, and profit on the Steam Market.
rows.description_html: Collect, click, and trade your way to the top! Get ready for an addictive experience that combines the thrill of clicker gameplay with the excitement of collecting. Discover unique characters and powerful Dramons as you progress with simple mouse clicks — every click brings you closer to rare rewards! Build your ultimate collection and show it off… or sell it on the Steam Market . Your creatures aren’t just collectibles — they’re valuable assets other players are hunting for. Key Features 🖱️ Clicker-style gameplay: Fun, simple, and perfect for playing at your own pace. 🧩 Character and Dramons collection: Find creatures with distinct styles, rarities, and personalities. 💰 Real trading system: Buy, sell, and trade through the Steam Market to expand your collection. Click, collect, and dominate the market. Become the ultimate Dramon collector!

rows.name: Medieval Merchant
rows.short_description: Guide a caravan through scattered medieval villages, supply them with goods, help them prosper ... and profit yourself as much as you can.
rows.description_html: Medieval Merchant is a medieval game of commerce and trade where small villages depend on you to grow. Buy and sell goods, supply towns with what they lack, and watch them develop and thrive. Use the supply-demand based economy to your advantage to build your own prosperity and make a profit in the process. Key features Town growth through trade Each town has its own resources, production chains, shortages and demands. Supplying what they need unlocks upgrades, new goods and lets you tap into higher-value markets. Build your trade network over time by developing more and more towns. A dynamic economy system Prices in the supply-demand based economy fluctuate with shifting world conditions. Temporary events, regional trends and other economic pressures can raise or lower the value of your goods, creating new opportunities or disrupting established routes. Plan your journeys, adapt to changing circumstances and take advantage of openings in the market. Upgradable Caravan and Retinue Grow your caravan as you travel and trade. Improve carrying capacity, speed and efficiency, and recruit specialists who add bonuses to your journeys. A stronger retinue lets you take on longer routes, handle more goods and adapt to the challenges of a growing trade network.

rows.name: I Sell Lemonade: Prologue
rows.short_description: You’re the boss of the block. Sell lemonade, make cash, get a bike, impress the girls — and live the summer you’ll never forget.
rows.description_html: I Sell Lemonade — Prologue A summer without screens. A sidewalk. A kid with a sign. You’re 10 years old. It’s the 1980s. Your dad just sold your console, and your mom told you to go outside and “do something useful.” So you grab a pitcher, a few cups, and start selling lemonade on the curb. Not to get rich. But because it’s the only thing that feels like yours. What begins as a way to pass time becomes a summer-long journey through childhood, friendship, and quiet bravery. You’ll mix drinks, charm neighbors, and slowly figure out how to stand your ground — with a paper sign and a plastic cup. But this isn’t just about profit. It’s about: Facing the local basketball king for a boombox and respect. Earning your way into the underground RC car races. Learning how to talk to the girl next door. Learning how to talk to your dad. Every day brings new choices. Sometimes you win. Sometimes you spill the lemonade. But with each cup sold, you grow a little. Prologue note This is a limited game showcasing an early slice of the game. Some locations, quests, characters, and features are unavailable here and will appear in the full version. Content, balance, and progression may change; saves from the Prologue may not carry over.

rows.name: Fall Asleep
rows.short_description: Fall Asleep is a tense first-person climbing game where you’re trapped in a nightmare and the only way out is up. See only the platforms in front of you, make every jump count, and try to escape before the dream swallows you whole.
rows.description_html: Game Overview – Fall Asleep Fall Asleep is a tense first-person climbing game where you’re trapped inside a nightmare and the only way out is up. With limited sight from your flashlight, platforms materialize just a few steps ahead, leaving you blind to the greater path and forcing you to trust your instincts. Every jump elevates you closer to escaping the dream. . . or further into the void. The nightmare unfolds across three haunting levels : Village Neighborhood Island Dev Tips:   Press  F   to access your Flashlight and hold shift to Sprint and make those hard-to-reach jumps. Fall Asleep makes every step a gamble. There are no checkpoints. No saves. Reaching your bed is the only way to wake yourself from the nightmare. Do you have what it takes to escape?

rows.name: In Bloom: Prologue
rows.short_description: In Bloom is a survival-horror game where you awaken alone in a world overtaken by nature. Guided by a mysterious voice on a radio, you must solve puzzles, survive the dangers around you, and reach Safe Haven before the wilderness consumes you.
rows.description_html: In Bloom: Prologue is a free version of In Bloom . Experience the core gameplay and get a taste of the experience that awaits in the full game. Drawing inspiration from masterpieces such as The Last of Us and Amnesia, In Bloom is a survival-horror game. You play as a farmer waking up, abandoned by his family and unfamiliar with his surroundings. All you can see around you is that what once was owned by man has now been retaken by nature. Your only hope of survival is following the instructions of a mysterious stranger whose voice you hear over a radio, instructing you to go to Save Haven base and join the rest of the survivors. Will you survive? Will you manage to fight your way through? Or will you allow nature to overtake you as well? PROLOGUE FEATURES: 3 areas dark ambience SFX voice-overs with subtitles gun and enemies In Bloom is a collaboration project made by Swedish and Polish students of Futuregames, completed in seven weeks of development. It is made for an audience that enjoys horror elements as well as puzzles and survival when playing their games. Blood, sweat and tears have been put into this project, and we hope that anyone who is about to experience it enjoys it as much as we enjoyed making it.

rows.name: How To Bike
rows.short_description: Ride a bike the hard way - the REAL way!
rows.description_html: Do you know how you actually keep your balance on a bike? Most people don’t. You do it with small, deliberate, but unconscious steering movements. So prepare to learn how to ride a bike again, only this time doing it consciously. Get ready for the most relaxing experience of your life, as this small calm (absolutely not enraging in any way) cycling game is featuring: 1 frame, 1 fork, 2 wheels 0 training wheels, no fall protection or automatic balance a realistic simulation of bike physics and movement  1 custom map to explore around 15 minutes to many hours of playtime, if you're stubborn enough save and load game functionality  relaxing music

Each discovery brings you closer to intimate revelations within these secluded, magical realms. Key Features ✨ 5 Festive Winter Realms to Explore. 👁️ 10 Cleverly Hidden Differences in Each Scene. 💖 Progressive Undressing Mechanic: The more differences you find, the more Noelle reveals. 🔞 Enjoy an Erotic Gaming Experience for Adult Audiences. Can you uncover all 50 differences and experience the full magic Noelle has to offer? Test your observation skills and indulge in a feast for the eyes with Noelle's Christmas Journey™!

rows.name: Murmurs of the Mist
rows.short_description: In this game, you’ll encounter puzzles which require you to use your environment in order to solve them. Take note of every detail, they can help you in uncovering Sofia’s story.
rows.description_html: Murmurs of the Mist  is a short psychological horror story where you play as Bunni , the stuffed toy of a 7-year-old girl, Sofia. She struggles to speak about what happened to her but in therapy, Sofia speaks through you, the only one she trusts.  As Bunni, you explore the mysterious landscape of Sofia’s psyche, where her innocence, fear and childish state of mind blur together. What you see , hear , and touch slowly reveals the dreadful truth. This 20–30 minute experience invites you into a quiet descent through memory, trauma, and the first steps of healing. A short unraveling of a story that is waiting to be heard. PHOTOSENSITIVITY/EPILEPSY SEIZURES READ THIS NOTICE BEFORE PLAYING This game contains flashing lights or light patterns that may be harmful for certain individuals. If you have an epileptic condition or have had any kind of seizure, consult your physician before playing any video game. Immediately discontinue use and consult physician if you experience any of the following symptoms: dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitching, involuntary movements, loss of awareness, disorientation, or convulsions.  TRIGGER WARNING  Murmurs of the Mist touches upon highly sensitive subjects involving child abuse, please absent from playing the game if you may find such themes triggering.

rows.name: The Maze: L'ultimo soldato
rows.short_description: You have been chosen to descend into the abyss. No one told you why those before you never returned. Do not turn back. Do not listen to the noises in the corridors. You have one task: restore power to your nation before the Maze takes you. The mission is clear. Your fate is not.
rows.description_html: Your nation is on its knees, the war nearly lost. The weapon that guaranteed your superiority, a strategic supercomputer, is dark. The only power source capable of reactivating it lies in a Maze in the middle of the ocean. You have one task: restore power to your nation. You must find and reactivate 8 generators. They told you the mission is vital. They told you you're the best. But no one told you why those who came before you never returned. Soldiers. Scientists. Entire teams sent before you, swallowed by the silence. Their last communications were only screams and static. Now you are there, and the silence is deafening. But you are not alone. Don't turn around. Don't listen to the noises in the corridors. Every step echoes. Every generator you activate makes a sound that draws unwanted attention. Something is hunting you in the darkness. It's not a soldier. It's not an enemy you can understand or fight. It is the embodiment of this place. As you try to survive, you will find the traces of those who died before you. You will find their notes, their desperate logs. You will discover the truth your superiors hid from you. Your mission is clear. Your fate is not. Be quick. Do it, before the Maze takes you too.

rows.name: Foreign Orc
rows.short_description: Learn a language while whacking rogues in a foreign land! Read, decide, and strike before time runs out. Improve your vocabulary through gameplay instead of flashcards and choose between multiple languages and categories.
rows.description_html: Learn a new language by whacking assassins! Every enemy displays a foreign word — but only one matches the correct target. Identify the right assassin, strike fast, and level up your fluency through gameplay instead of flashcards. 🗡️ Gameplay Overview You play as an Orc mercenary hired to eliminate rogue assassins. There’s just one twist: ✔ Every enemy is labeled with a foreign-language word ✔ Your target word appears at the bottom of the screen ✔ You must read, recognize, and react before time runs out 🌎 Learn While You Play - 4 Languages : Russian, Spanish, French, English (more planned) - Difficulty Tiers : A1 → B2 word banks based on CEFR levels -  Categories : Verbs & Food (More soon) -  Adaptive Tracking : Words you fail appear more often next run Reach out and give feedback if you run into any vocabular errors, bugs, or glitches . I appreciate it! Keep in mind, this is for beginners. It might be quiet easy if you already know a thing or two. Though, I still you hope have fun.

rows.name: Dice In You
rows.short_description: A roguelike deck builder with dice. Fuse dice to create your own powerful custom dice, and aim for even higher scores!
rows.description_html: Dice In You is a roguelike deck builder that uses dice. Synopsis You wake up in an unfamiliar room and realize you’re trapped in a sealed space with a mysterious girl. The only way to escape is to operate the device in front of you and clear the game. Dice Fusion At the end of each round, you can obtain dice with special abilities. Newly acquired dice can be fused with one of your existing dice to create your own powerful custom die. The Girl’s Emotions The girl’s emotions change depending on how you play. Her shifting feelings may end up helping you. Reach the end together with the girl— and ESCAPE .

rows.name: Seoul Bridge
rows.short_description: You are trapped on the Seoul Bridge. Whether you move toward the exit or return to the entrance, you remain trapped on the Seoul Bridge. Observe your surroundings carefully and find a way to escape.
rows.description_html: As you cross the Seoul Bridge, you begin to witness subtle and unexplainable changes in your surroundings. If any element around you—signs, vehicles, structures, or people—appears different from usual, You must immediately turn back. If no abnormalities are detected, Continue forward and cross the bridge to the end. Seoul Bridge is a short driving simulator inspired by Exit 8, the Han River, driving experiences, and the Backrooms.

rows.name: Eternal Core
rows.short_description: Eternal Core is an action platformer in which you control ROB, a robot created with the goal of destroying the Tower that’s draining the planet’s life. You’ll have to fight enemies to advance and reach the top, encountering powerful Bosses along the way.
rows.description_html: Eternal Core is an action platformer in which you control ROB , a robot created by a group of rebels with the goal of destroying the Tower that’s draining the planet’s life. You’ll have to fight your way through enemies to advance and reach the top, encountering Bosses along the way who are far more powerful than the rest, each with unique abilities. Use your powerful fists to take down enemies and your dash to tackle and dodge your opponents. Remember that your abilities consume energy— it will recharge over time, but if you run out completely, you’ll be left defenseless. However, you can fully recover it along with your health by collecting the crystals scattered throughout the level. Survive until you find them. Meet your enemies: the grounded maintenance bots and the flying hunters scattered across the levels. Turn them into scrap.

The boss fights play out similarly to old school Final Fantasy. There are also mini games that a player can play to get bounces items. The School can be explored from a top down perspective.

Manage your character's private garden-farm from a top-down perspective: Buy crops and upgrades, plant and harvest from your plots, and use your different stations to process and analyse your yield.
rows.description_html: In EvoSprout , you can plant , grow , and harvest different fruits and vegetables. You can try combining them and cross-breeding their genetics to get even better yields. Level up, get more insight into the genetics of your produce, and see if you can claim the trophy ! Full Disclaimer: This game is just a private, game development side project I wanted to share with the world. Do not expect any future updates or support beyond critical fixes. Please feel free to share your opinions and suggestions.

rows.name: Pocket Lint zero
rows.short_description: Play for free! A deceptively hard little game of deduction. I’m now thinking of a specific combination of pocket items. If I give you hints about what you’ve got wrong, can you guess it in as few guesses as possible?
rows.description_html: A deceptively hard little game of deduction. I’ve emptied my pockets onto the table, and I’m now thinking of a specific combination of those items. Can you guess it in as few guesses as possible? How it plays Each guess you make, information will be revealed about what you got right. By combining divide-and-conquer, with process-of-elimination, you should be able to quickly figure out the answer. Each round, you'll get a new selection of items to play with and a new colour palette to keep things interesting. What's included? This version contains the first 5 levels from the campaign of Pocket Lint, so you can try it for free!

rows.description_html: You've been good, You know you've been good. But for years the only thing you've had waiting under the tree is a lump of coal, black coal. You've had enough. You've tracked down this supposedly jolly man and his unsettling workshop. It's time to take back what is rightfully yours! Key Features PSX-Era deign : Low poly models with the clunkyness to match Santa: A hunter that hulks over you, he patrols his workshop and will give chase if he sees you Stealth : You must hide and use blindspots to your advantage Jumpscares : Don't get caught or you are in for a fright Now go get what you deserve.

rows.name: Arena : Run And Hit
rows.short_description: A 10-player rooftop battle. Enjoy the simple game of 'Arena: Run & Hit,' where you simply hit and run away. The last player standing among the 10 players wins. You can battle on the rooftops with friends through the group, or compete with others through the competition to determine rankings.
rows.description_html: A 10-player battle unfolds on a rooftop. Enjoy the simple game of 'Arena: Run & Hit'—hitting and running away. How to play? After starting the game, wait for Steam to automatically log you in. Once logged in, you'll enter the lobby. In the lobby, create your character using the character customization system. Fight with others in a group or matching system. If you prefer a scoring system, select Competitive Survival Mode. How do I win? In Survival Mode, the last survivor wins. In Respawn Mode, the player with the most kills wins. How do I achieve good results? Strategically, mastering running and attack timing is crucial. All characters have identical hitboxes, so there's no disadvantage or advantage to using different characters. Participate in battles that are fair and equal. What are the control keys? By default, attack is with SPACE, and movement is with WASD (or the arrow keys). You can customize the controls by clicking the gear icon in the upper right corner of the lobby.

rows.name: EXODUS2
rows.short_description: A high-velocity movement-shooter following CPL CHAI on his vengeful assault against the Zephari homeworld after their failed invasion of Earth.
rows.description_html: EXODUS2 is a high-velocity movement-shooter following CPL CHAI on his vengeful assault against the Zephari homeworld after their failed invasion of Earth. Wall-run, slide, and blast yourself through the air with shotgun-powered knockback jumps as you carve a path across Planet Zephari. Trigger bullet time to reflect incoming fire, dodge lethal attacks, and reposition with style. Dismember enemies to disrupt their behavior and evolve their attack patterns as every fight turns into a dynamic, cinematic brawl. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Stereoscopy
rows.short_description: A virtual theater experience for Desktop PC with VR support - capable of playing Standard and 3D Video files. Supports Keyboard/Mouse, Gamepad, and XR Controllers.
rows.description_html: The Ultimate Immersive Home Theater for Desktop and VR Step into your own private cinema where every movie feels larger than life. Stereoscopy plays ordinary video and 3D-formatted video files in an immersive 3D experience - whether you’re seated at your desk with classic anaglyph glasses or fully immersed inside a virtual reality headset. Stereoscopy isn’t just a player – it’s the private, jaw-dropping cinema you’ve always wanted. Turn any video into an unforgettable 3D spectacle, tonight. Overview Native playback up to 8K resolution with 4K texture sampling Real-time ray tracing, global illumination, dynamic shadows, volumetric fog, god-rays, particle streams and screen-space reflections Free roam and theater seating Eight powerful 3D modes: Anaglyph, Half/Full Side-By-Side → Anaglyph, Top-Bottom → Anaglyph, Half/Full Side-by-Side, Top-Bottom, and Standard 2D In VR: perfect left/right-eye separation for flawless stereoscopic 3D with zero crosstalk On desktop: real-time anaglyph rendering (red-cyan, amber-blue, green-magenta and more) Cinema-Quality Audio Supports up to 10.2-channel surround sound (including 7.2, 5.1, 2.1, stereo) Dolby, DTS and THX pass-through decoding Up to 192-bit depth for pristine clarity Audio modes: • Direct – faithful passthrough of the original audio tracks • World Spatial Audio – true 3D positional sound placed throughout the virtual theater with intelligent downmixing across low, mid and full-range virtual speakers A Living, Breathing Theater Walk, jump, sit or stand inside stunning virtual environments that react to your movie. Realtime Lighting and Volume level controls Projection screen and projector emit realistic light that spills into the room Auto-dim/restore theater lighting when you hit play or pause (fully configurable) Optional projector beam with visible particle rays and cinematic god-rays Seat beacons to help you find the perfect spot to watch – just walk in or teleport (VR) and your view instantly snaps to the screen Door beacons to exit the Theater - – just walk in or teleport (VR) to a door and you are prompted to exit Two beautifully detailed theaters included: an intimate Screening Room and a massive, atmospheric Army Warehouse Change your theater on the fly using the Theater Browser Designed for Comfort and Control Compatibility: Windows 11, desktop monitors, and OpenXR compatible XR/VR/AR headsets (with or without controllers) Partial input support: keyboard + mouse, gamepads, and VR motion controllers Intuitive Video Remote (desktop or VR) for play/pause, seek, restart, volume, 3D mode, audio mode and repeat Built-in file browser Theater selector Auto-Play resumes your last video exactly where you left off Auto-Repeat for endless loops

rows.name: Battington Manor
rows.short_description: Battington Manor is a kid-friendly VR first-person shooter guided experience where you will embark on a journey through haunted halls shooting evil bats with your holy water blaster and garlic bazooka to save the Battington family!
rows.description_html: Do you have what it takes to defend the Battington Manor from the invading swarm of nefarious bats? Step right into this immersive guided VR experience and blast away! Evil bats have taken over the manor and locked up the Battington family. Equipped with a garlic bazooka and holy water blaster, you will explore the haunted halls, blasting evil bats along the way in this carnival-style arcade first-person shooter game. You will make it to the dungeon arena, where you must free the good bats from the cages and restore peace to the manor. Battington Manor is a solo project developed by Natasha Patel for the 2025 VR Haunted House Event at Ringling College of Art and Design. Suitable for users of all ages new to virtual reality.

rows.name: Soglia
rows.short_description: 'Like all psychic life, creativity also comes from the unconscious. If you identify with the creative process, you end up believing that you are the creator.' Soglia is a game based entirely on sound. A dreamlike journey into our unconscious to discover where ideas are born.
rows.description_html: Soglia explores the connection between video games and musical composition, investigating how interactivity can become a creative tool for music through the gamification of sound. The project consists of a video game that is almost entirely sound-based, in which visual elements are reduced to a minimum and the experience is guided by listening and spatial orientation. The gameplay is based on exploration and sound collection, allowing the player to interact with and modify the acoustic environment in real time, which evolves like a dynamic and immersive composition. Soglia attempts to describe the phenomenon of creativity and intuition that occurs within a dream. It seeks to answer a question: who is the one who creates and generates the idea? Is it us, or is it an “independent” creator that resides within our unconscious? In Soglia, the player embodies this creator and does everything possible to capture and organise the sound of the environment to generate the embryo of a composition.

rows.short_description: Fight Poker is a turn based poker PvP card game. You try to form the best hand you can in 4 rows with help from the community cards. There is an online global play option, pass and play, and 5 difficulties of bot to fight against. It is great for any players who enjoy the strategy of poker itself
rows.description_html: Fight Poker is a turn based PvP card game. You can play 1v1 online or offline, and it is a poker game. You play 5-7 rounds against an opponent, trying to form the best hand you can in 2 offense and 2 defense rows with help from the community cards. There is an online global play option, pass and play, and 5 difficulties of bot to fight against. It is great for any players who enjoy the strategy of poker itself, or want to try to manage cards and allocate them for differing hands with different needs.

rows.name: Gemini Rush
rows.short_description: Gemini Rush is a LAN racing game where each player controls a single-wheel vehicle on a circuit made up of two constantly parallel roads. The player has the ability to switch between the two using a skill. The vehicle is highly amenable and very fast.
rows.description_html: Gemini Rush is a LAN racing game where each player controls a single-wheel vehicle on a circuit made up of two constantly parallel roads . The player has the ability to switch between the two using a skill. The vehicle is highly amenable and very fast . The Race The race is composed of 3 biomes (neutral, cave and fog) making the entourage beautiful and memorable ! The players drive on these roads in order to stay in first place. However all the players leave a trace behind them on the ground, a speed trail, that remains for 6s on which the other players can follow in order to gain a speed boost as long as they stay on it. There are many obstacles on both roads that the players need to avoid. If they hit them, they crash and respawn instantly where they were a few seconds earlier. The obstacles are different depending on which road is chosen, and it is important to learn your favorite path to save as much time as possible and go as fast as you can. rows.name: Dollemma
rows.short_description: An asymmetrical multiplayer horror game with a unique appealing aesthetic. Join up to 4 friends and work together to escape the dollhouse! Or play as the Hunter and shatter the dolls before they can escape.
rows.description_html: Trapped within the recesses of never-ending dollhouses, up to four terrified surviving dolls will work together to escape from a maniacal doll breaker in a new twist on asymmetrical multiplayer horror.  Solve puzzles Each iteration of survival is through varying versions of dollhouses: Within an abandoned clock tower, the dolls will need to put their knowledge of mechanics to the test to find and fix the missing gears.  Stuck deep within a mysterious dungeon, the dolls need not fear the dark, lighting their way to fix and open a jammed drawbridge. Or, hidden away within a complicated, randomized maze, reminiscent of what could have once been a grand manor, the dolls will search each nook and cranny for keys to unlock their path out. Hunt down your friends Ever wish you could’ve played rough with your toys as a child? Well, now’s your chance to try. In Dollemma, you can play as a doll hunter, dolls that weren’t treated well when they were played with, and have decided to force the other, weaker dolls to join in with their pain.  With in-game proximity voice-chat, the survivor dolls can choose to communicate and work together to escape the doll hunter, but the doll hunter can also try to listen in and thwart their plans. As a painful indicator of the doll hunter’s treatment, anything it tries to say will come out unintelligible and terrifying. Collect items There are quite a few items the dolls can use to try and escape. The Needle and Thread allows dolls to heal themselves or each other by reattaching the limbs broken off by the hunter. Keys, cog wheels, levers and lighters can be used to complete the objective. But watch out: some items might be nefarious illusions created by the hunter to fool you! Most players can only carry two items at a time—and you have to be careful. If the hunter smashes one of your arms, you won’t be able to use it. If you lose both your arms, you won’t be able to carry items at all, and you’ll have to find someone who can heal you. Complete quests Every Doll is unique, with each one having their own special skills to learn and unlock. These skills can be unlocked with points earned through playing matches, or by completing quests.  Dollemma has a complete quest system, with varying levels of quests: One-time achievable accomplishments marking your Dollemma journey, or repeatable more focused on just currency-gaining challenges. Escape the dollhouse After the dolls find the keys, repair the clock tower, or obtain the lever for the drawbridge, the chase is on! The dolls will all have to make their way to the exit before the hunter can track them down and smash them apart. Features Four doll characters and one hunter character, each with unique skills and abilities. Three unique maps, each with their own themes and objectives. Two maps are handcrafted, and one changes randomly every time you play it. Minigames to draw the dolls’ focus away and give the hunter a chance to catch up. Dynamic music, which immersively changes intensity as the hunter approaches. Proximity-based voice chat, to hear your friends from a few rooms away. Computer-controlled bots that can take control if a player suddenly disconnects. Ball → While waiting for a match to begin in the pre-game waiting room, you may experience the most fun and engaging item the Dollemma team has been painstakingly developing for a long while: Ball. A new take on horror Dollemma aims to appeal to a wider audience with a cuter, more approachable art style. Most asymmetrical horror games lean heavily into darker themes, which some players may find unsettling. Dollemma’s unique creepy/cute aesthetic ensures a unique atmosphere and makes the genre of asymmetrical horror accessible to more players. Enter the dollhouse… Don’t wait! Dollemma is free to play. Invite your friends to explore these haunting environments and escape—before you get caught!

rows.short_description: the scream of darkness is a first person psychological horror with multiple endings, it shows the story about one guy that gets his whole life ruined in days. can you discover the truth?
rows.description_html: You moved with your family to a quiet town… but nothing stayed peaceful for long. Now, haunted by loss, you must explore unsettling places, face terrifying encounters, and piece together fragments of mystery. THE SCREAM OF DARKNESS combines atmospheric storytelling with psychological horror, where every choice nudges you closer to one of many endings. Will you discover the truth… or be consumed by it?

rows.name: Skybound
rows.short_description: Skybound is a 3D exploration platformer focused on fun, fluid movement mechanics, parkour and environmental puzzle solving.
rows.description_html: Explore, Parkour, Save the world! Skybound is a game about exploration with an Exhilarating movement system. Using Bells abilities to bring the world back together! Skybound is a 3D exploration platformer focused on fun, fluid movement mechanics , parkour and environmental puzzle solving. You play as Bell, a young archaeologist exploring mystical floating islands in search of ancient artifacts. Use Bell's specialized equipment - including a Grappling Anchor , agility boots , and mastery over the magical ' Flow ' - to investigate ruins untouched by explorers for ages. Swing through the sky, traverse the islands and meet its curious and whacky inhabitants. You've got a contract to fulfill and mysteries to unearth! Please note that this is only ACT 1, more acts will be made if the game is positively received! PLEASE NOTE 2: THE GAME IS OPTIMIZED FOR 1920X1080 DISPLAY. FEATURES In Skybound you can EXPLORE  three different islands. By using Bell's GRAPPELING HOOK . And once you've mastered the MOMENTUM and FLOW of the game you'll be FLYING like this: And Most importantly, you can destroy oh so many POTS! Some even contain collectibles! The Story of Skybound Bell wasn't exactly what Professor A. N. Curia - who studies anicent human civilization - expected to receive. Shipped to the Professor  archaeologist as 'Human Remains' , the package contained something far more alive: a baby . Turns out, raising a human is excellent for research (and admittedly, pretty adorable). Growing up, Bell took to her mentor/parent's work in a big way. She spent countless nights under the blanket reading about lost civilizations, and even more time tagging along on excavation trips. Eager as ever, she learned fast by studying artifacts, documenting ruins and decoding ancient texts. By seventeen , she'd shaped into a fine archaeologist in her own right. Now she's got her very first solo job! The client came through Professor A. N. Curia, so they must be reputable. The mission is straightforward: retrieve an artifact from the ancient and mysterious sky islands and prove she's a real archaeologist. This is the beginning of something great! But as Bell explores the floating ruins, something feels... off . Questions keep surfacing that don't quite add up. What exactly does the client want with this artifact ? And why all the secrecy? Controls Movement Use ' WASD ' to move Use the Mouse to aim an look around Use the Spacebar to jump Hold Shift to run Actions Press the ' E ' button to interact Use Mouse 1  to fire/swing the Grappling Anchor , and  Mouse 2  to pull yourself towards the target. Use Mouse 1 to continue the dialogue. Sometimes hitting stuff with your Anchor is a good idea ..! Press the ' L ' button to reset to latest Checkpoint UI ESC = Open pause men Hold TAB = View objectives Cheats / Reset If you ever want to unlock everything and just explore the three islands you can go into 'Game Alterations' inside of the options, here you can unlock everything and travel to specific islands! But if you want to relive the game and rewatch the intro you can also reset all data ! Please note: This is a student demo Skybound is a demo created over 6 weeks by a multidisciplinary team of students from many different universities together for a semester at DADIU (Danish Academy of Digital, Interactive Entertainment). This project brought together aspiring developers, artists, designers and composers, all of whom have never worked on a game of this scale before, and with this tight of a schedule. While we're incredibly proud of what we've accomplished in such a short timeframe, you may encounter bugs or rough edges along the way. We appreciate your understanding and hope you enjoy exploring the sky islands with Bell despite any hiccups! Thank you for playing our game!

rows.name: Survivors: Match-3 Island Adventure
rows.short_description: Survive on a mysterious island after a plane crash! Solve match-3 puzzles, restore your camp, craft tools, grow crops, explore jungles and lagoons, uncover hidden treasures and reveal the island’s secrets!
rows.description_html: After a plane crash, you find yourself stranded on a mysterious tropical island. With no clear way home, your journey turns into an unexpected adventure filled with secrets, discoveries and survival challenges! In Survivors: Match-3 Island Adventure , you explore jungles, beaches, lagoons, ruins and mountains while completing quests and unlocking new areas. Restore and upgrade your camp, gather resources and follow a story that gradually reveals the island’s hidden past. Progress through the adventure by solving match-3 puzzles that drive the story forward and open new locations. Can you survive, explore the island and uncover its secrets? Key Features • Match-3 Progression System Complete hundreds of match-3 levels to unlock areas, clear obstacles, earn boosters and advance the story. • Exploration-Driven Adventure Investigate diverse island locations packed with resources, hidden items and challenges. • Camp Building & Crafting Restore and upgrade your camp, craft tools and improve your ability to survive hostile environments. • Resource Management & Cooking Gather materials, grow crops, find wild ingredients and prepare meals to sustain the survivors. • Quests, Inventory & Treasures Complete structured quests, collect artifacts and caches and manage your inventory efficiently. • Mystery & Survival Themes Face environmental dangers and strange creatures while uncovering the truth behind the island. While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings. You can play this game whether you’re offline or online. ______________________________ Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish.

rows.name: Starlit Bottle
rows.short_description: Starlit Bottle is a casual stress-relief game themed around starry sky bottles.
rows.description_html: Starlit Bottle is a cozy and relaxing casual game designed to relieve stress. Its core gameplay is simple yet incredibly soothing: your goal is to pour water of different colors from bottles into separate cups until each bottle contains only one color of water to complete a level. The game features three difficulty modes—Easy, Medium, and Hard—catering to players with different paces. As you progress through the challenges, the number of bottles you need to sort will gradually increase. Whether you want to unwind after a long day or enjoy low-stress puzzles during short breaks, this game is perfect for you.

rows.name: Cadentia Farnese
rows.short_description: 12 chances to discover 'the Dice'! Immerse yourself in the history of the Farnese Palace in Rome with this unique narrative video game.
rows.description_html: Roll the dice and discover the history of the iconic Palazzo Farnese: 12 stories as 12 facets of the familiar silhouette that the Romans call the Dice . Learn about the mysterious ancient mosaics preserved underground. Enter behind the scenes of international diplomacy with the French Embassy, which has had its headquarters at Palazzo Farnese for 150 years. Find the graffiti left by young art students in the 18th century on the walls of the famous Carracci Gallery, uncovered during a recent restoration. Throughout your journey, you will meet the genius of Michelangelo, pondering the transformation of the Palace as well as his own life; you will enter the second act of Tosca, Giacomo Puccini's masterpiece and visionary dream; you will experience the most eagerly awaited French summer celebration and the arrival of electronic music in the heart of this Renaissance Palace. Let chance guide you: Palazzo Farnese can be discovered again and again through the 12 stories, with multiple dialogue combinations shedding light on all its secrets. Are you ready to roll the dice? A visual novel dedicated to the Farnese Palace, created by We Are Muesli, in association with and on behalf of the Embassy of France in Italy, supervised by Diego Grammatico.

rows.name: Diluted
rows.short_description: Diluted is a 3/4ths puzzle adventure-action game where nightmares seep into reality. Play as Archie, an orphan bound to a living nightmare, and uncover the truth behind his matron’s orphanage as you explore twisted forests and corrupted memories.
rows.description_html: Diluted is a narrative-driven 3D side-scrolling puzzle and adventure game where players explore dark environments, solve environmental challenges, and uncover a story centered around fear, control, and nightmares. Players control Archie, a young orphan cursed with a living nightmare entity named Azell. Throughout the game, players navigate interconnected areas, avoid environmental hazards, and confront hostile nightmare manifestations, all while experiencing a linear, story-focused experience. Gameplay emphasizes exploration, puzzle-solving, and light combat mechanics. Players must pay attention to the world around them, interpret the cues from the environment, and use Archie's limited ability and knowledge of the alchemic arts to survive these encounters. Story elements are delivered through environmental storytelling, notes, and journals. As players progress, they uncover the truth behind Percilla’s orphanage, Archie's nightmares, and Azell's role in this whole conundrum. Diluted offers a slightly dark fantasy setting with psychological horror themes, cute visuals, ambient sound design, and narrative tension to create an emotionally driven experience. Key Features 3D Side-Scrolling Gameplay – A linear, story-driven experience focused on exploration and progression Puzzle-Based Progression – Environmental puzzles and obstacles that gate advancement Light Combat Encounters – Face hostile nightmare creatures while managing limited resources Narrative Focus – Story delivered through notes, environmental details, and character interactions Atmospheric Presentation – Dark fantasy visuals and sound design inspired by psychological horror Single-Player Experience – No multiplayer or live-service elements

rows.name: Scrap Squadrons
rows.short_description: A round-based spaceships-themed game with deckbuilding elements about squadrons of scrap ships turning each other into scrap.
rows.description_html: Choose your ships, fight it out with another player or a bot, unlock new ships, gather some scrap, repair your ships, repeat. Round-based game. Both players choose actions the ships will make at the same time. When both are ready - actions are executed at the same time, but ordered based on the order and priority of chosen action. You have to plan at least a couple of steps ahead. Deckbuilding elements. The actions that the ships can execute each round are drawn from a deck  stack of actions and it behaves like a regular deck-building game. The actions in the starting stack are influenced by the ships you pick. 26 Scrap Ships with unique actions. Each of the 26 ships does something different when executing an Ultimate action. 1v1 Multiplayer. Start the battle in MP mode to play against another player from start to finish. Or use a MIX mode to start playing against a Singleplayer bot, but allow other players to take control of enemy ships mid-battle.

rows.short_description: One silly Tsuchinoko's epic journey to feed The Burger to her Giant Snake friend.
rows.description_html: MON DIEU! Giant Snake Girl is hungry for The Burger! As a silly Tsuchinoko who's also her best friend, it's Loaf's duty  to find these burgers for her big friend.  Take on many puzzling challenges as Loaf the Tsuchinoko. Find The Burgers and bring them to Giant Snake Girl. But beware, as you collect The Burgers, an impassable trail begins to form behind you.  How many The Burgers can you bring to the wonderful Giant Snake Girl? Solve numerous puzzles across four worlds in your search for The Burgers Unlock skins for Loaf and silly hats for Giant Snake Girl A cast of cute characters await the snakes on their grand journey.

To stand against them you must train, find equipment, and more.

rows.name: Elemental Battle: Eclipse
rows.short_description: An anime-style arena fighter with elemental powers, unique characters, and combo-heavy combat. Built by a solo developer, featuring striking visuals, unique abilities, responsive controls, and fast local multiplayer battles packed with style and energy for all skill levels and endless replayability.
rows.description_html: Dive into a fast-paced anime-style arena fighter where every battle erupts with color, personality, and raw elemental fury. Developed entirely by a solo creator , Elemental Clash Arena blends stylish action with deep combat mechanics to deliver an experience that’s easy to pick up—but endlessly rewarding to master. Unleash your power through a combo-driven combat system designed for creative expression. Chain aerial juggles, dodge-cancels, elemental finishers, and character-specific techniques to overwhelm your opponent. Every fighter wields unique elemental abilities that shape their playstyle—burn foes with blazing rushdowns, freeze the battlefield with precision ice traps, shock enemies with lightning-fast mix-ups, and more. Choose from a roster of distinct, hand-crafted characters , each with their own fighting philosophy, special skills, and explosive super attacks. Whether you’re battling solo or facing off against friends, the game’s local multiplayer makes every match a spectacle. Featuring striking anime visuals , dynamic effects, and smooth animation, Elemental Clash Arena brings every punch, blast, and combo to life. Key Features 🔥 Anime-style arena combat full of personality and flair 🌪️ Elemental powers that define each character’s playstyle ⚔️ Deep combo system with cancels, launchers, and finishers ✨ Unique special abilities for every fighter 👥 Local multiplayer for intense couch battles 🎭 A diverse cast of original characters 🎨 Beautiful visuals and effects crafted by a solo developer Prepare to enter the arena—master your element, perfect your combos, and claim victory in Elemental Clash Arena .

rows.name: Encore!
rows.short_description: Begin your career at the Multiversal Institute for the Rhythmic Arts (MIRA), an interdimensional school where music, magic, and friendship collide.  Encore! is a rhythm game and visual novel hybrid, where you must curate a band from wacky characters to win Battle of the Bands!
rows.description_html: Begin your career at the Multiversal Institute for the Rhythmic Arts (MIRA), an interdimensional school where music, magic, and friendship collide.  Recruit new friends from across realities and times to form a band that will rival the ages and unlock the power of rhythm with your bonds. Can your band make the audience scream Encore!? Encore! is a rhythm game and a visual novel where you play as a new student at the Multiversal Institute for the Rhythmic Arts (MIRA). Practice your performance skills by tapping the arrow keys in time with songs, and gain access to new music and instruments by making friends at school. Curate your band from a slew of unique characters: a wild-western alien guitarist, an edgy angel harpist, a Victorian bassoonist, and many more. Learn more about each character’s story and play well with them to gain their affection. Win the Battle of the Bands at the end of the school year and make the audience yell Encore! The game features a 45-minute main campaign and a free-play mode to try out any song in the game. This game was made by a student team, many of whom are first-time developers, at Amoriem Labs, the game development club at Yale! Follow us  for more updates.
