rows.short_description: A block boomin, cannon blastin, heart grabbin combo! play games such as: Anncceleration: Collect hearts while you race against the clock in multiple levels! Athena's higher wire: Dodge cannons and collect stars for a high score! Boomin blocks: Line up combos in a puzzle shooter!
rows.description_html: Samburger's oddballs is a 3-game collection of my best games from 2025. (listed in order of release) Athena's higher wire: An arcade platformer with high difficulty and multiple modes including: Classic mode: collect stars to advance levels with increasing difficulty. Level select mode: play thorough a single level until you fail. Hailstorm mode (a subsection of level selects mode): dodge unrelenting cannonfire for as long as you can! Anncceleration: Collect hearts under a strict time limit by platforming through five open levels with slippery controls! Blastin blocks: Line up combos based on the color of your arrow and shoot bombs for a high score in both classic and infinite modes!

rows.name: Little Smiles Daycare
rows.short_description: A short psychological horror experience set inside an abandoned daycare. Explore, uncover hidden notes, solve eerie mysteries, and discover what happened to Little Smiles Daycare, before something finds you first.
rows.description_html: A peaceful daycare once filled with laughter and children… now left abandoned, silent, and hiding something twisted. You play as a lone investigator exploring the ruins of Little Smiles Daycare. Uncover hidden clues, recorded memories, mysterious artifacts, and a truth that was never meant to be found. But you’re not alone. Something else is watching. And smiling. Explore. Listen. Investigate. Will you uncover what happened here? Or will Mr. Smiles find you first? Features Fully voice-acted cutscenes Psychological horror and secret lore Hidden clues, endings, and twists to discover 10-15 minutes of gameplay per run Multiple outcomes, choose carefully 🗝️ Voice Talent Ms. Harper – Hannah Willhouse Instagram: @HannahWacting YouTube: HannahWillhouseVA Mr. Smiles – Kobe Van Bogaert Twitter: @KobeVB_VA 🧩 Gameplay Explore at your own pace, solve environmental puzzles, follow the clues, and reveal the daycare’s darkest moments. Every step draws you closer to the truth, and to something watching from just beyond the halls…

rows.name: KUMASAMA
rows.short_description: A large brown shadow lurks in the abandoned factory; the night hides her form.Something terrifyingly massive is concealed within this town.I think of her, and of the days I can never go back to.“KUMASAMA” is a horror adventure set in the present day.
rows.description_html: “KUMASAMA” is a horror adventure set in the present day. ◆Story Recently, bear attacks have been occurring all over the country. I saw something about it on the news, but I was sure it had nothing to do with life in my town. …Or so I thought. Someone spotted a large brown silhouette lurking in the darkness, at night, in an abandoned factory. There’s no doubt that something terrifying and enormous is hiding in this town. …and eventually, I came to understand that the “something” was her. I think of her—and of the days I can never return to. ◆Gameplay Features A walking simulator where events unfold as you explore. Inspect objects to progress the story. No quest markers or time limits—play at your own pace. “She” is timid, but her claws are sharp. Playtime: 10–40 minutes ◆Guidelines for Video Streaming Both individuals and organizations may stream the game without prior permission.

rows.name: Putrid Snow 2: House of Yule
rows.short_description: Trapped alone in a mansion with relentless holiday monsters, you must scavenge for presents to find weapons and traps. Outsmart the AI, manage your inventory, and turn the holiday hunter into the hunted. Free to play!
rows.description_html: You woke up late this Christmas day to find all of your family members suddenly gone. But that's not the only surprise... Christmas presents are scattered everywhere! What a pleasant surprise. But wait, what are those items inside? A crowbar ? Machine oil ? A glue gun ? Banana peels ? Well... while those might sound like awful presents, they sure can come in handy to prepare for the Christmas Siege party that's about to unveil. Explore the Family Mansion: From the cozy Living Room and long, eerie corridors to the dark basement, dusty attic, and small  hedge labyrinth in the backyard ! Survive the Holidays: Manage your 6-slot inventory and take care of your Christmas Mood . Find sweets and food to keep your energy up! Fight Back: Use household items as weapons and traps . Stun your foes, inflict damage, and slow them down with injuries to make them less agile. Atmospheric Horror: Experience an eerie retro-style atmosphere and immersive sound design. The house is well-lit, but you'll never know what's hiding behind a corner. Short & Replayable: A tight, intense experience (30-60 mins) with three difficulty settings - for those wishing to relax and enjoy the holidays as well as those who wish to experience the true survival horror. Dynamic AI: Face off against an intelligent (but comedically stupid) AI that will pursue you relentlessly. He gives you just enough room to breathe, but never lets you feel safe. You are the only one who can protect the house now. So get to it! Plays great on Steam Deck! In our testing, the game runs smoothly with a stable framerate and offers approximately 4 hours of battery life on a full charge!

rows.name: Denpa Nightmares
rows.short_description: No matter how long you’re gone, there will always be a girl waiting for you in the same place. This is a story about forgetting, and about waiting. After countless restarts and countless memories lost… how long will you stay with her this time?
rows.description_html: This is simply a visual novel game about reminiscing the past. You and the girl named “ Dirtie ” stay together in this forgotten world. There are no goals to reach, nothing you must accomplish. You simply keep each other company, chatting idly about the old days — and that’s all there is. Gameplay Click on the screen to advance the story. Choose the options you want. Think about what Dirtie says. Sometimes, Dirtie may say things that break the fourth wall, but you don’t need to worry about it. Streaming of this game is welcome (whether monetized or not).

rows.name: Ktrl Smash
rows.short_description: Krlt Smash is a fast-paced multiplayer arena game where anything can become a weapon. Pick your fighter, grab bats, baseballs, or even chairs, collect stat boosts, and fight to get the most kills before time runs out. Stay alert, keep moving, and defeat as many players as you can.
rows.description_html: Ktrl Smash is a chaotic and fast-paced multiplayer arena brawler where every second counts. Jump into a bright 3D arena, choose your fighter, and battle players from around the world in short, intense matches. Your goal is simple: get the most kills before the timer hits zero. The arena is packed with weapons and stat boosts, turning every match into a wild scramble. Pick up anything you can find, swing a baseball bat , throw a baseball , or smash someone with a chair . Each weapon changes how you fight, letting you surprise opponents or rush straight into the action. Scattered around the map are useful pickups like Speed Boost , Damage Boost , and Health Boost . Grabbing them at the right moment can help you survive longer, strike faster, or turn a losing fight around. With players racing toward the same boosts, every pickup becomes a small battle of its own. Matches are quick, lively, and unpredictable. One moment you are chasing someone with a bat, the next, you’re scrambling to grab a boost before someone else does. Simple controls make it easy to jump in, while the fast pace keeps every round exciting and competitive. When the timer runs out, the player with the highest kills claims the win and becomes the ultimate champion.

rows.name: White Memories
rows.short_description: Take the mantle of a postman who refuses to give up his job, even after death. Clinging to your last memory, take off into the world of the forgotten to deliver your letters to the ghosts that are stuck there, allowing them to reach the afterlife. Protect your mail from those who are pursuing you.
rows.description_html: Take the mantle of a postman who refuses to give up his job, even after death, in order to hold on to the only memory he has of his past. Fly away to the world of the forgotten to deliver your letters to the ghosts trapped there and allow them to reach the afterlife, while protecting your mail from those who, consumed by loneliness, pursue you relentlessly. Fly through the streets of Lunhac Use the gravity of the world of the dead to navigate between the buildings of a small French village. Soar into the skies or sink into the depths of the world of the forgotten and navigate while dodging enemies and obstacles alike. Switch between the dark and frightening world of the forgotten and the more poetic and soothing world of Lunhac and its surroundings.  Free troubled souls Explore the world between deliveries and chat with the various inhabitants of the village. Uncover their stories and, if you make the right choices, ease the regrets of those you can help. Master the flight system to enjoy the poetic and soothing landscape of Lunhac and its surroundings. White Memories is a student project carried out by a team of 14 fourth-year students at the Interactive Art & Design 3D school in Montpellier.

rows.name: Motarium
rows.short_description: 🫧 Motarium is a free collection of word games set in a relaxing underwater world. Anagrams, word searches, hangman, SUTOM and more. Dive into a sea of words and challenge your brain in a calm, beautiful environment.
rows.description_html: 🌊 Motarium, the aquarium of words Motarium blends the world of words with the tranquility of the ocean. A peaceful, immersive experience where letters float among fish and bubbles. Each game is a unique journey through language, combining fun, focus and a touch of poetry. From anagrams to SUTOM, from word searches to original ideas, Motarium offers a rich and evolving collection of word games wrapped in an elegant underwater atmosphere. Whether you play for a few minutes or dive deep into challenges, the experience is designed to relax and engage. 🎮 A variety of word games for every type of player Play casually or chase the perfect score with flexible game modes Enjoy a smooth, animated oceanic setting filled with fish, bubbles and motion Discover both classic and original gameplay built around language ⭐ Key features Daily challenge shared with all players Over 35 Steam achievements to unlock Three difficulty levels to suit every skill level Available in both English and French Virtual keyboard included for added comfort Share your results with stylish emoji grids 🧠 Who is it for Word game lovers looking for a fresh experience Casual players seeking quick, satisfying sessions Puzzle fans who enjoy daily challenges Completionists and achievement hunters Anyone who just wants to relax with beautiful visuals and smart gameplay Step into Motarium. The words are waiting for you, just below the surface.

rows.name: Le Petit Raccoon
rows.short_description: Le Petit Raccoon is a stealth cooking game where you must steal food to cook for your hungry guests! Steal food from the grocery store, but don't get caught! Time is of the essence, and your customers are waiting.
rows.description_html: The Game Le Petit Raccoon is a stealth cooking game where you must steal groceries to cook for your hungry guests. Who am I? You play as Rocko the raccoon. You've just moved to the big city of Pettington to open up your dream restaurant! The catch? You forgot to stock up on ingredients! Customers already start pouring into your restaurant, but without any groceries, you'll have to improvise. What do I do? With no groceries initially at your disposal, you have to steal them from the grocery store next door! Steal groceries from the grocery store Evade the geese employees and avoid getting caught! Take orders from your customers Cook  and Serve  food for your guests!

rows.name: Reunion Online
rows.short_description: Reunion Online is an open-world MMORPG with full cross-platform play. Fight monsters, team up with players, earn random loot, and grow your character through crafting and enchanting.
rows.description_html: Reunion Online is a massive multiplayer RPG (MMORPG) where you can fight monsters with your friends in an open world. CROSS-PLATFORM GAMEPLAY: Reunion Online is truly cross-platform gameplay. Whether you prefer to play on PC or on a mobile device, one account allows you to play on all platforms. Functions: √ Player per player (PvP) √ Ally with other players and form a team to defeat strong monsters and gain extra experience √ Hunt lots of different monsters √ Find the best equipment (semi-random loot) √ An ever-evolving open world √ Chat with other players √ Enchanting system (level up your equipment with special Jewels) √ Crafting system How to play: - To move - use ingame joystick or touch the place where you want to go (change in options) - To attack, just choose a target or use attack button - Use the buttons on the right to restore health, mana or use a special skill - Use the buttons on the right to change set - To pick up the loot from the ground, just touch the hand icon or click on loot - Each character level you gain points to distribute in strength, agility, vitality, intelligence or wisdom - Each profession level you gain one point to level up skills

rows.name: Lo-Fi Haiku: Coffee and Chill
rows.short_description: Take a sip of coffee and wake up your inner poet. Let the words flow with the soft waves of Lo-Fi music. Chill, ease your mind and create. Lo-Fi Haiku: Coffee and Chill is a tool which will help you on your journey of becoming the greatest Haiku Master.
rows.description_html: Take a sip of coffee and wake up your inner poet. Take a sip of coffee and wake up your inner poet. Let the words flow with the soft waves of Lo-Fi music. Chill, ease your mind and create. Haiku is a form of poetry, originated in Japan. The basic rules are very simple. It consists of 3 lines. Very, very short and compact! 5 Syllables in the first line, 7 in the second line and finally 5 in the last, third line. And it doesn’t even have to rhyme. Quite nice, right? And how relaxing it’s to create one! Especially with calming notes of Lo-Fi Music, magical animations and steam rising from a cup of coffee. Lo-Fi Haiku: Coffee and Chill is a tool which will help you on your journey of becoming the greatest Haiku Master. Use the words we provide, play around with them, change them, form them into sentences and in no time you will have your own poem. Traditionally Haikus describe nature and its wonders, but YOU can make it about anything! You can write about your cat or grandma. Anything goes as long as you have fun! Lo-Fi Haiku: Coffee and Chill features: Solid selection of words, you can use to create poems Tools to help you count syllables Plenty of good vibes coming from chill and nice Lo-Fi music Stunning, magical animations All the good vibes :)

rows.name: SportsBlitz
rows.short_description: SportsBlitz, a retro themed micro game collection of sports games.
rows.description_html: SportsBlitz is a fast-paced, retro-inspired microgame collection where every second counts. Jump between dozens of bite-sized sports challenges, each lasting only a few frantic moments, as you race to win rounds, avoid elimination, and climb the leaderboard. Every game throws you into a new skill test: fencing duels, top-down dodging, quick-reaction inputs, and more, all wrapped in a nostalgic CRT-TV presentation. Easy to learn but chaotic to master, SportsBlitz delivers classic WarioWare-style energy with a distinct pixel-sports aesthetic. Survive long enough, rack up the wins, and secure your place in the Hall of Fame! SportsBlitz was made by 6 students for our university project.

rows.name: ABSØLVE
rows.short_description: Welcome to ABSØLVE, a dark fantasy based hack-and-slash game, where you fight wave after wave of demons hordes using the chaotic Wheel of Judgement system to try and defeat as many monsters as possible in an attempt to gain absolution.
rows.description_html: Absølve places the player in the role of an empowered warrior who channels both strength and corruption to face endless waves of enemies. The combat combines precise melee action with dynamic movement mechanics such as dashing, jumping, and ability-based attacks. Each encounter challenges the player to maintain momentum while managing limited-use ability cards that offer powerful attacks or movement options. Monster Waves Face large waves of enemies, where every wave gets harder and harder.. how far will you get? Wheel of Judgement: The Wheel of Judgement  is a unique mechanic where the player draws random abilities from a holy arsenal to empower him during combat, this arsenal grants abilities in randomised fashion causing the player to have little-to-no influence over the abilities that will be granted. Every time an available ability gets used, it will be removed from the player and put back into the  Wheel of Judgement , then the Wheel  will randomly appoint a new ability to the player, replacing the earlier ability. Rage: In order to use these abilities you will need to build the resource called  Rage , this resource automatically builds up when using your light and heavy attacks to hit enemy monsters. Corruption: The corruption adds a risk-reward element, using the Wheel of Judgement  you will gain access to random abilities but not all abilities are created to your advantage.. these are what we call Corruptions  gain and use one these corruptions will activate a negative effect on the player.. so be wise in your decisions on when to active certain abilities. Boss Monsters: Face unique boss monsters (with unique archetypes/mechanics) that each will challenge you in a different way to test your gameplay, tactical and mastery. The player’s journey emphasizes control, spectacle, and skill expression. Every battle rewards mastery, awareness, and creative combinations of attacks and abilities. The experience aims to create a strong feeling of empowerment while still challenging the player to stay composed amid chaos.

rows.name: Cybersoul
rows.short_description: Deckbuilding Card Game meets Incremental Data Mining. Command 3+ dystopian factions & 100+ cards in this acid-soaked Cyberpunk Card Battler. Unleash glitch-fueled combos, gamble in a corrupted Arcade, and farm Souls & Star Power in idle clickers. Don't just play the game—break the code and ascend.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Cybersoul, where high-octane Deckbuilding, glitched-out card games, and a compulsive Souls & Star Power incremental idle system collide in a flash of neon. Jack into the ultimate Cyberpunk Card Battler, launching with 3+ dystopian Factions and over 100 cards. Compiled in the static of a dying world, Cybersoul takes the card battlers you know and hard-wires them into a high-tech, low-life future. Command the scrap-metal juggernauts of the Rust Legion , the chemical-fueled speedsters of the Stim Freaks , and the corporate overlords of the Credit Barons . With over 100 distinctive cards , each surging with cybernetic augmentations and system-breaking hacks, the tactical possibilities are limitless. But the Grid is unforgiving. Engage in visceral, turn-based combat against a ruthless AI that learns your exploits. And when you need to disconnect from the warfare, the Glitch Arcade awaits! Gamble your life away and earn Credits & Energy in corrupted simulations of classics like 9-Player Poker, Blackjack, Pool, Match 3, Chess, Space Invaders, Brick Break, Snooker, and more. Then, set your system to idle farm Soul Coins & Star Power. Spend your ill-gotten credits to upgrade your rig, overclock your cards, and farm resources even while you sleep. 🔋 SYSTEM FEATURES 3+ Dystopian Factions: Master the streets—from the brute force of the Rust Legion to the arcane code of the Stim Freaks and the corrupted wealth of the Credit Barons . 100+ Cybersoul Cards: Compile a deck of cybernetic horrors, viruses, traps, and glitches, each rendered in a visceral analog-horror art style. Neural-Net AI Battles: Test your build against adaptive AI opponents that exploit your weaknesses and show no mercy. Visceral Turn-Based Combat: Fast, brutal, and strategic. Execute combos that shatter the game logic and overload your opponent’s CPU. Deep Deck Optimization: Tailor your loadout with a diverse host of mechs, mutants, and programs. rows.name: KhanII M
rows.short_description: The legendary MMORPG returns. KHAN 2 M brings back the classic experience with modern systems—story content, seasonal battle pass, events, and a challenging tower climb filled with escalating rewards.
rows.description_html: KHAN 2 – The Return of a Legendary Warlord Twenty years after the original KHAN defined an era of early MMORPGs, the legendary world rises again—reborn, renewed, and more powerful than ever. KHAN 2 is the true continuation of a beloved classic, bringing the essence of the original back to life while expanding it for a new generation of adventurers. Step into a vast ancient kingdom shaped by war, faith, and heroic conquest. Become a true “Khan”—a warrior forged in battle, tested by fate, and destined to stand among legends. Experience the Heart of Classic MMORPG Gameplay A Massive World of Myth and War Begin your journey from humble lands and venture through deadly forests, forgotten ruins, sacred temples, and war-torn continents. Discover ancient races, mythical beasts, and dark forces threatening to engulf the realm. Fight, Rise, and Become a Khan Grow stronger through battles, master unique skills, and face powerful enemies in solo challenges, guild wars, and massive kingdom-wide conflicts. An Epic Storyline Continuing the First Game Set years after the original KHAN, the sequel expands the lore with new characters, factions, and sinister threats that push the world toward chaos. All-New Storyline Discover an expanded narrative that follows the events after the first KHAN, introducing new heroes, enemies, and conflicts across the land. Seasonal Battle Pass Progress through monthly seasons, unlock exclusive rewards, weapon skins, costumes, buffs, and special items designed to keep every moment meaningful. Year-Round Events Limited-time quests, special bosses, seasonal festivals, and bonus drop periods ensure the world is always alive and evolving. Tower Challenge (Tae Tower) Climb a multi-floor tower where difficulty increases with each level. Earn greater rewards the higher you ascend—perfect for solo players or group parties. Enhanced Classic MMORPG Combat Faithful to the original KHAN yet rebuilt for smoothness and modern playstyle. Master class abilities, gear upgrades, and fast-paced battles. Modern Gear & Rarity System Collect equipment of various rarities, build your character’s stats, and customize your power progression to suit your playstyle. Strong Community & Guild System Join guilds, participate in massive battles, defeat world bosses, and compete for ranking dominance across the kingdom. Privacy Policy This game requires acceptance of a third-party EULA

rows.name: SlimyLeap
rows.short_description: SlimyLeap is a fast-paced pixel-art infinite runner where you play as a brave little slime trying to go as far as possible without dying.
rows.description_html: SlimyLeap is a fast-paced pixel-art infinite runner where you play as a brave little slime trying to go as far as possible without dying. Cute, colorful, and just a little chaotic – how far can your slime go? As you go farther, new environments appear: from grassy fields to deep jungle and tall mountains. Each run feels slightly different, with handcrafted level designs and new challenges waiting ahead. But beware – a creeping red fog is always behind you! The farther you go, the faster it moves, leaving no room to stop. Keep jumping, dashing, and moving forward – or be consumed by the mist! Jump, dodge, survive… and collect gems to unlock new skins that let you show off your style!​ Features: • Control your slime with simple swipe gestures: drag your finger/mouse to aim and release to launch • Master the unique dash mechanic: dash mid-air, bounce off enemies, and stay airborne longer • Retro pixel-art style and smooth animations • Fun sound effects and colorful visuals • Unlock new slime skins to customize your look​ • Local best-score system – beat your own record • No ads, no internet required Can you keep the slime alive long enough to become a legend? Challenge yourself and see how far you can leap! This game includes both original assets created by the developer and third-party assets, which were used under their respective free asset licenses.​ Asset Credits: Tilemaps, backgrounds, and some spritesheets by Ansimuz Chest spritesheet by Admurin

rows.name: A Father's Growth Spurt
rows.short_description: Juggle the tasks of taking care of a bonsai by monitoring the water, fertilizer, and weeds in the same pot, all while witnessing the short linear narrative between the 3 generations of the same family.
rows.description_html: Enjoy this short 15-minute first chapter of A Father's Growth Spurt. Which includes:  Resource Management:  Choose each day between maintaining the water and fertilizer levels, or weeding out the bonsai pot. If you don't keep the water and fertilizer levels at each weeks random level for three days, the bonsai will die from malnutrition.  Ensure that weeds never encroach on the bonsai's stem; otherwise, no matter how well you've been mai ntain ing the bonsai, the weeds will ultimately kill it.  Purposeful Limited UI:  Just like in real life, there is no UI to help keep track of the water and fertilizer levels. This is an intentional design; you need to be aware of the bonsai yourself. You can keep track of any way you seem fit and use in-game clues to help you along the way.  Storytelling:  Enjoy a story based on reality between a grandfather, father, and grandchild as they work through the intricacies of life together. Over the span of four weeks, you will talk with both your father and son as the first chapter of A Father's Growth Spurt unravels.

rows.name: Escape Games World vs Escapers
rows.short_description: Unlock the world! Solve 95 thrilling escape room levels & hidden object puzzle
rows.description_html: Welcome to 'Escape Games World vs Escapers' by HFG ENTERTAINMENTS! Immerse yourself in an intricate puzzle adventure, where you'll unlock secrets, solve mysteries, and crack codes. Explore hidden chambers and navigate through cryptic corridors in this thrilling escape game. Can you unravel the enigma and escape in time? Game Story 1: A climber’s peaceful mountain ascent turns into a deadly fight for survival. As darkness closes in, hidden clues and mysterious room objects reveal betrayal, a corrupt climbing agency, and a shocking conspiracy buried deep in the mountains. Game Story 2: During a Christmas vacation, a disabled boy discovers a magical world with his talking penguin and snow fox friends. When they vanish the next year, he returns alone to uncover a chilling truth—a devil queen has captured them. Solve snowy puzzles, unlock hidden doors, and rescue the magical kingdom. Game Story 3: A boy from a Himalayan village sets out to conquer Mount Everest at Christmas, only to be pulled into a frozen mystery world. Battling blizzards, ice creatures, and ancient riddles, he must uncover hidden clues and stop the Winter’s Wreath before it destroys the mountain—and Christmas itself. Game Story 4: After receiving a mysterious book, a young boy is transported into a magical Christmas world as an elf. With Santa’s help, he must explore dangerous escape rooms, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden clues to defeat a monster threatening the Reindeer World. ESCAPE GAME MODULE: Embark on exhilarating escapades delving into unsolved mysteries awaiting your keen detective skills. Each meticulously crafted room invites thorough investigation, promising a unique puzzle-solving challenge. With every clue deciphered, inch closer to unraveling the overarching truth behind each thrilling case. LOGIC PUZZLES & MINI-GAMES: If you thrive on the thrill of cracking codes and unraveling mysteries, our escape room adventures are tailor-made for you. Dive into our immersive games where each puzzle serves as a mental workout, promising both challenge and gratification. Engage in a quest where deciphering cryptic clues and uncovering hidden secrets propel you towards the ultimate truth. rows.name: Cube Dodger 3D
rows.short_description: Cube Dodger 3D is a fast, neon arcade runner. Slide along a glowing highway, dodge smarter and faster cubes, charge your shield, unlock ships, roads and enemy skins, and chase brutal score-based Steam achievements
rows.description_html: Cube Dodger 3D is a high-speed, neon-soaked arcade runner about pure survival. You pilot a glowing cube ship down an endless highway while waves of enemy cubes get faster, larger, and smarter the longer you stay alive. Simple controls, brutal difficulty, and a ridiculous rank ladder make every run a tight, score-chasing challenge. Features Fast, responsive left/right movement and a one-button shield Dynamic difficulty: cubes speed up, grow, and gain moving / homing behavior as you progress Ship Garage with score-unlock ships, premium cosmetics, and a legendary shield-heavy ship Road Garage and Enemy Garage to customize the look of the highway and cubes Local saves only: high scores, unlocks, and equipped cosmetics live on your machine Steam achievements for ship-specific score milestones and an extreme 1000-point goal There are no ads, no online accounts, and no grind passes—just you, your reflexes, and an endless wall of cubes trying to end the run.

rows.name: Untold Story
rows.short_description: A modernized turn-based RPG. Go on an adventure with your party, battle tough monsters and fierce foes, and save the world! A large cast with unique skills creates strategic turn based combat, with plenty of challenges to face.
rows.description_html: Synopsis Rover Wilson had a pretty simple life; he went to school, learned about using the Elements, did his homework, and spent time with friends. Then one day a strange group of people appear near a mysterious monument. After the encounter, Rover's entire world as he knew it is about to get flipped upside down. After being teleported away from his home, Rover finds himself in unfamiliar lands, stranded and alone. What begins as a simple search to find his friends and his way back home will become a quest to save the world. His life will be anything but simple from then on.  About Untold Story is a turn-based, party-based RPG with an emphasis on characters and story. Players will follow Rover Wilson on his journey, gaining new allies, completing quests, and learning the history of the world in the process. Manage your actions in battle well, and strategize the best approach to take down the fiercest of foes!  Explore the world, meet the characters, complete their quests, earn rewards, and hear their stories! Every single NPC is unique, with their own design, behavior, personality, and story!  Almost 200 Quests to complete! From mandatory story quests, to a plethora of side stories that explore the characters and unravel the history of the world of Atomous.  Friend Conversations explore inter party relationships and boost stats. Hidden Items are found throughout, and always present a visual cue to their location. Observe your surroundings, and be rewarded for it! Hundreds of collectibles! From Friend Conversations, to Hidden Items, to books about the world itself. Find them all and get to 100%! Nothing is missable! Every single quest and every single collectible can be obtained from the first opportunity all the way until the no going back point. Doing quests at different points in the story may even offer different dialogue as well!  Many Monsters and fierce foes are abound as well. Master the combat and take down even the hardest of enemies! Each character gets a single action per turn--the order they take those actions, and what they do, is up for you to decide! Strategize the best plan, and win! Every action requires Energy, with more powerful skills requiring more Energy to preform. Characters naturally gain Energy each turn. Equipment can alter this gain, or change the Energy cost of skills. Find the perfect balance! Every character has their own unique skill set. To exploiting weaknesses, inflicting statuses, and even changing the battle field, everyone has a use. Synergize with other party members and efficiently win each battle. Unleash Decisive Skills at pivotal moments to change the tide of battle. Every character gets a unique skill, while several others can be taught to anyone at your choosing.  Swap party members mid battle! Every turn you are free to switch the party however you like. Think carefully, once an action is taken, the party is locked for that turn! There are three additional difficulty modes for players to enjoy: Beginner Mode reduces damage taken & increases EXP earned. Hard Mode  limits the party max to 3 members [Opposed to 5], requiring more precise action management in battle. Story Mode  boosts the stats of all characters, reduces damage taken, grants regen, and doubles EXP earned, so players can focus more on the story, and less on the battles and combat.

rows.name: Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant
rows.short_description: A story-driven psychological horror game where you must balance cooking authentic Vietnamese Pho with surviving chilling, unexpected events in a quiet, mysterious village.
rows.description_html: A TASTE OF VIETNAM, A SLICE OF HORROR. Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant is a story-driven psychological horror game, deeply inspired by Vietnamese culture, real-life events, and the unique atmosphere of Hanoi's suburban villages. Made with the Godot Engine, the game offers a glimpse into the everyday life of Vietnam that often goes unseen in media—mixed with a chilling, unfolding mystery. If you enjoy narrative-rich games, unique cultural settings, and a blend of cooking simulation with true psychological dread, step into Anh Hai's kitchen. 📜 STORY: THE DARK SIDE OF DAN PHUONG Step into the shoes of Anh Hai , the new owner of a small pho restaurant in a seemingly peaceful village in Dan Phuong District, Hanoi. Your day starts simple: run a thriving business, serve steaming bowls of pho, and socialize with the local townsfolk. But the serene facade quickly cracks. As you settle in, Anh Hai gradually uncovers a dark and unsettling mystery shrouding the village. To keep his restaurant running, protect what he holds dear, and survive the strange occurrences, Anh Hai must confront unexpected, harrowing events and the haunting secrets of his own past. Every interaction, every decision, and every bowl of pho served holds a clue to the truth. ✨ KEY FEATURES 🍲 Unique Pho Restaurant Simulation: Experience the authentic process of making and serving traditional Vietnamese Pho. Handle customer orders precisely, from the cut of meat (tái/chín) to the garnishes (quẩy, bò viên, cơm nguội). 🔪 Gripping Psychological Horror: A rich and thrilling storyline filled with plot twists, building genuine suspense and atmospheric dread, culminating in intense final moments. 🇻🇳 Immersive Vietnamese Setting: Explore a rural Vietnamese village with highly detailed retro graphics, bringing to life local culture and relatable, real-world inspirations. 🐾 Protect Mr. Gold: Interact with and protect your loyal canine companion, a surprisingly emotional and pivotal part of the storyline. Don't forget to pet the dog! 🎬 Cinematic Presentation: Features cinematic cutscenes and a compelling narrative to draw you deeper into Anh Hai's disturbing reality. 💀 Multiple Endings: The choices you make determine Anh Hai's fate, leading to one of 4 distinct endings. ⏱️ Compact & Intense Experience: A focused playtime of approximately 30 minutes to 1 hour allows for high replayability across different ending paths.

rows.name: Potion Knight
rows.short_description: Potion Knight is an intense and up-tempo first-person shooter that combines the need for speed with tactical potion throwing. Set in the harsh snow ridden village of Cronenberg where an unorthodox alchemist has been fusing animals with weapons to fight under his command.
rows.description_html: Potion Knight is a first person 'shooter' with intense and up-tempo elements. This game combines the need for speed with tactical potion throwing in this endless satisfying yet chaotic fast runner and faster slider experience. Set in the coldest days of medieval times in a harsh snow ridden village of Cronenberg. A place where every creature is out to steal that last bit of warmth out of your body. Your goal is to defeat all enemies and kill the corrupt alchemist to free Cronenberg from its grasp.  Step into the cold, wintery world of PSX inspired graphics filled with strange and unsettling enemies straight from the ‘illuminated manuscripts of old’ and try your hand at conquering this strange menagerie. Luckily you can kill these gut-wrenching creatures with your trusty weapon, the ancient art of alchemy! Throw potions at the right enemy or get faced with the consequences if you throw the wrong elixir.  Made for everyone who wants to play challenging levels that are procedurally generated to make every run different from the last.

rows.name: Running Beehind
rows.short_description: Run fast, take risky shortcuts, and deliver food across Waspington or choose to rebel against your Hive; after all, nothing says job security like a perfectly timed landing.
rows.description_html: Running Beehind is a speed-based third-person platformer set in the buzzing city of Waspington , where fast deliveries and fluid movement keep the Hive alive. As a delivery worker at Co. Hive, you can sprint, swing, and bounce through an insect metropolis, master expressive traversal, and plan the most efficient delivery routes before the clock runs out! The city is built like a living playground, offering shortcuts and hidden routes in every zone. Using grapples, sticky honeycomb walls, and trampolines, players are encouraged to explore and refine their movement, turning each delivery into a fast-paced puzzle of speed and flow! Along your delivery route, you’ll meet all sorts of diverse characters, each with their own fears and stories. But one pattern quickly becomes clear: the further you stray from the Hive, the more you see the sticky, not-so-sweet impact that Co. Hive has on Waspington. Its citizens are cornered into two choices: work with the corporation… or push against it. But you , the player, don’t have to pick just one. Using your company-issued gear, you can access hidden nooks and crannies, using them to send a very pointed message back to the big bees upstairs. Players can secretly disrupt production lines or leave messages across The Hive . Vandalism slows down corporate operations and reveals hidden paths the company tries to keep buried. Through exploration, dialogue, and choice-driven gameplay, Running Beehind allows players to decide whether to serve the Hive or sting it from within. FEATURES Speed-based third-person platforming focused on expressive movement; Fluid traversal using grapples, sticky walls, and trampolines; Multiple delivery routes that reward exploration and mastery; Distinct zones to explore, including the Hive, the Butterfly Farm, and the Roachlands; A choice-driven narrative with dialogue and multiple endings; Vandalism mechanics that tie player action directly into story outcomes; A colorful insect city filled with memorable characters and environmental storytelling.

rows.name: Uninvited: Security Service
rows.short_description: Uninvited: Security Service is a really simple stealth/exploration game where you sneak around a mansion while avoiding the butler that lives in there. Learn about the foolhardy protagonist and the stupid chain of events that led to the situation that’s happening there.
rows.description_html: A butler, a mansion and missing people , you don’t need to be Sherlock Holmes to guess what’s happening, but someone has to look into it, and its going to be you! In this simple stealth/exploration game with graphics inspired by ASCII games, you’ll have to search around the mansion for keys and notes while you hide and, overall, just try to not be broken in half by the butler. Play as Ricardo , a foolhardy teenager that after an incident in his summer job, involving him being dragged around a forest, finds himself in front of a mansion that has a murderous butler inside, he sure has a great 'luck' , but don’t worry about him! He's used to this stuff. Go for a stroll around the mansion, search for notes that tell you some employees gossip, or maybe find a key to open a closed door. You can also go greet the butler if you want, but I wont take responsibility for what happens. If you decided to go greet the butler, then I can introduce you to the main game’s mechanic, evading the butler is your main focus, since, to your misfortune, if he grabs you he’s not going to comfortably let you outside the mansion, this guy is not that nice to intruders. Run. Hide. And move silently. Because even if he’s not the most brilliant, he’s still the one who knows how to move around the mansion. Some employees unhappy about their bosses not listening about their concerns with the new butler and a Ricardo that is trying to find out what happened to the aforementioned employees, it’s not a story worth of a Noble Prize in Literature, but my boy Ricardo and the events that happens to him in the mansion will try to make you laugh so at least you’ll have a good time. And who knows! Maybe you’ll get a peek to an actual story and all. Around 1 to 2 hours of content . A stealth/exploration gameplay inspired by horror games (this is not a horror game, don’t worry, the only scary thing here is the game’s code). Comical story and dialogues. Pixel Art inspired by ASCII games and their graphical editions. A Green Hat, to your misfortune.

rows.name: Everyday Devil
rows.short_description: A short, linear story game of a random demon guy's life.
rows.description_html: Ah, what's a devil to do in this day and age... Looking back at the past, I'm not sure if I learnt anything. Was there something to, in the first place? May you be my judge, jury and executioner, dear player, as you venture through my mind and life. Through my mistakes and plights. Welcome, to my everyday~ A short, linear story game revolving around fragments of a random demon guy's life. The scattered pieces of memory are short, and somewhat disjointed... it's mostly a lot of walking and talking. The style of it may be a little different between each vignette, depending on Cecil's feelings at the time. It's a strange world, full of darkness. But it's just everyday life for him. I hope you understand. FEATURES About an hour long experience Atmospheric levels of varying styles Characterization of creatures to both love and hate A feeling of despair, but also of coziness CONTENT WARNING Contains themes of abuse, alcoholism, animal harm, blood/gore, violence and has flashing/eyestrain

rows.name: Geenius : Cupid Dough
rows.short_description: A fast-paced runner game powered by GEENIUS’s new single Cupid Dough. Run, collect orbs, and switch between five characters to change vocal parts in real time. Earn gold, unlock instruments, and remix the song to create your own version.
rows.description_html: Sprint to the rhythm in this fast-paced runner game featuring GEENIUS’s new single, Cupid Dough . Freely Customize Your Vocal Parts Run to the right, collect glowing point orbs, and switch between five playable characters in real time. Each character change instantly swaps the song’s vocal part, letting you experience the track in a dynamic and interactive way as you play. A Song That’s Truly Yours—Unavailable on Streaming Platforms After each run, your score is converted into gold, which you can use to unlock instrument parts . Rearrange and combine these instruments to rebuild the song and create your own unique version of Cupid Dough . Short, fast-paced runner gameplay with simple controls Real-time character switching that changes vocal parts on the fly Score-based progression and instrument part collection Music editing system to rearrange and customize the song Based on the official music from 5-member K-pop group GEENIUS

rows.name: What the Healer Left Behind
rows.short_description: Welcome to what's left behind. Explore a silent village after a failed mission and discover, little by little, that not every cure is a miracle. What the Healer Left Behind is a short, atmospheric first-person psychological horror game where unease grows with every step.
rows.description_html: How many times have you used resurrection in an RPG? A party member falls in combat. You open the menu and use a spell, an item, or an ability. And then the character returns as if nothing had happened, and the mission continues. But… what if something had happened? In What the Healer Left Behind, you take on the role of a swordsman sent on a common guild mission. Just retrieve an item, return to the village, and maybe give a report. The mission fails. Not everyone returns. And someone is brought back. The village is still there. The houses are still standing. The streets look the same. But something doesn't fit. The silence lingers. The healer's presence becomes unsettling. Fragments of information emerge where they shouldn't. As the night progresses, the world begins to behave strangely, and little by little, it becomes clear that the resurrection was not a neutral act, it was a choice. Everything points to a single isolated place, far from the village. A place where something was left behind. And that shouldn't have been brought back. What the Healer Left Behind is a first-person psychological horror experience about faith, trust, and the unseen consequences of accepting miracles without question. A short game, focused on atmosphere, environmental narrative, and growing unease where the horror doesn't come from death, but from what insists on remaining alive. Features First-person narrative experience Psychological horror focused on atmosphere and tension Structure divided into acts, with clear narrative progression Retro visual style inspired by games from the early 2000s Short and experimental game, focused on sensation over combat

rows.name: Dunjinn
rows.short_description: Turn-based dungeon crawl, every step advances foes; stealth, noise, and light matter. Procedural rooms mix traps, mimics, locks, loot; combat is gear-driven with augments, consumables, and breakable durability. Between runs use town to shop, craft/repair, vault gear; death drops your pack.
rows.description_html: Dunjinn is a deliberate, turn-based crawl where every step advances enemies, so stealth, noise, and light control matter. Procedural floors mix rooms, winding halls, traps, mimics, locked doors, and loot that drops to the ground if your 20-slot pack is full. Combat runs off a gear-driven action bar: melee, ranged, shields, augments (teleport, cloak, barrier), accessories, and consumables add abilities with cooldowns and status effects; durability can shatter weapons or armor mid-fight. Light sources burn fuel and affect vision and detection. Between dives the Free Quarter is your safe loop: rest at the inn, shop only common gear, craft/repair/upgrade with salvaged essence, appraise unidentified finds, and stash extras in a 50-slot vault. Death wipes what you carry but not your vault or progress—push deeper for rarer drops, essence, and nemesis encounters.

rows.name: Just Kill It
rows.short_description: Just Kill It is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter.Shoot, survive, level up, and build your own playstyle as endless waves of enemies close in — then push your limits on the global leaderboards.
rows.description_html: About This Game Just Kill It is a top-down survival shooter focused on pure combat intensity and build-driven progression. Endless waves of enemies approach from all directions, growing exponentially over time. What begins as scattered foes quickly turns into dense encirclement, and eventually an overwhelming flood that nearly fills the screen. Every second tests your movement, positioning, and build decisions. Relentless Enemy Pressure Enemies attack from all sides with increasing density From small groups to full-screen swarms in the late game Multiple enemy types: Close-range swarmers High-health enemies Mixed wave compositions Terrain and paths affect kiting, positioning, and crowd control Late-game “red tide” moments deliver pure survival pressure Kill. Level Up. Become Overpowered. Defeat enemies to gain experience and level up. Each level presents a random upgrade choice , allowing you to shape your build run by run: Increase damage or attack speed Boost critical chance and critical damage Hit more targets per attack Improve movement speed for survival Clear, stackable stat growth ensures every upgrade has a visible impact on combat flow. Global Leaderboards Built-in online leaderboards let you compete with players worldwide: Player name and country tracking Total kills ranking Survival time ranking You are not just challenging the game — you are competing against other players’ best runs.

rows.name: Green Tea Field Mayhem
rows.short_description: Set against the beautiful Boseong Green Tea Fields of South Korea, this is a thrilling multiplayer psychological hide-and-seek game. Choose your role: become an adorable Tea Fairy protecting the tea leaves from mischievous Dokkaebi, or be a Dokkaebi tasked with stealing them.
rows.description_html: Teatime Tussle: Defend the Leaf! (Game Description) Set against the beautiful Boseong Green Tea Fields of South Korea, this is a thrilling multiplayer psychological hide-and-seek game. Choose your role: become an adorable Tea Fairy protecting the tea leaves from mischievous Dokkaebi, or be a Dokkaebi tasked with stealing them. Gameplay This game reinterprets the Boseong Green Tea Fields into a sprawling, intricate multiplayer maze focused on strategic hide-and-seek, psychological warfare, stealth, and collection. The Tea Fairy Vulnerability & Stealth: The Fairy's figure is easily exposed over the maze walls, making their position quickly visible. They can crouch to conceal their appearance, but this significantly reduces their movement speed. Mission: Chase and catch all the Dokkaebies, before they manage to steal the required tea leaves. The Dokkaebi Concealment & Risk: Dokkaebies are completely hidden by the maze walls. They can Jump to secure vision beyond the maze, but this action risks being instantly spotted by the Fairy. Mission: Collect all the mission tea leaves without being caught. Core Feature The key enjoyment lies in the strategic choice and execution of actions by all players, utilizing the constant risk-reward structure between concealment and exposure. Despite the cute graphics, experience the thrilling psychological battle that feels like a combination of hide-and-seek and Whack-A-Mole through momentary exposure.

The Dokkaebi Concealment & Risk: Dokkaebies are completely hidden by the maze walls. They can Jump to secure vision beyond the maze, but this action risks being instantly spotted by the Fairy. Mission: Collect all the mission tea leaves without being caught. Core Feature The key enjoyment lies in the strategic choice and execution of actions by all players, utilizing the constant risk-reward structure between concealment and exposure. Despite the cute graphics, experience the thrilling psychological battle that feels like a combination of hide-and-seek and Whack-A-Mole through momentary exposure.

rows.name: EmuDevz
rows.short_description: A game about building emulators! Implement your own NEEES core in JavaScript, get instant feedback with unit/video tests, build the graphics unit in real time, learn 6502 assembly, debug test ROMs, and have fun with the included homebrew games!
rows.description_html: A game about building emulators! In the year 32767, the world suffered a massive cyber attack which destroyed the entire Internet. Since then, you and an online friend are trying to understand the sparse pieces of documentation about the NEEES , an ancient game console released in 1983. With your programming skills, you'll have to build an emulator that runs those old games, helping preserve video game history. Key features Full 🕹️ NEEES emulation guide from scratch, in JavaScript Interactive 🔨 6502 Assembly tutorial Implement 🧠 CPU, 🖥️ PPU, and 🔊 APU in any order Play 👾 homebrew games to unlock ROMs 🧪 Unit tests, video tests, and audio tests are provided 💻 Unix-style shell and code editor 🎶 Original retro-synthwave soundtrack 📃 Included documentation and in-game dictionary 🗣️ Fully localized into English and Spanish 🐞 Powerful debugger with Memory Viewer , Disassembly ,  Name tables , CHR , Sprites , Palettes , APU Channels ,  Controllers , and Emulator Logging 🔭 Free mode to use the IDE to develop emulators for other systems! This game requires programming knowledge. If you can't write code yet, turn back while you still can 😅

rows.name: The Physical
rows.short_description: Enter the white void. Compete against thousands of clones for the title of 'No.1 Physical.' This is a ruthless examination of your reflexes, precision, and endurance. Master punishing trials—from split-brain multitasking to button-mashing agony. Customize, survive, and dominate the leaderboard.
rows.description_html: **ARE YOU THE PERFECT PHYSICAL? ** The massive doors open to a blinding white stadium. Inside, thousands of identical low-poly clones are stretching, running, and preparing. You are one of them. **The Physical** is not just a game; it is a clinical examination of your gaming capabilities. Your goal is simple yet brutal: Outperform every other clone and prove you possess the **No.1 Physical** . * THE TRIALS * Prepare to test every limit of your hands and brain across a variety of punishing game modes: * SPLIT-BRAIN COORDINATION * Hand Eye:  Sync left (ZASX) and right (Arrows) inputs to the beat without error. Lateral Drill:  Independent agility test—control two agents via Keyboard & Mouse. Box Jump:  Control 4 characters simultaneously across varying speeds. * REFLEXES & TIMING * Ghost Step:  Switch Black & White stances instantly to phase through attacks. Wall Ball:  Account for gravity to hit the teleporting target. One miss fails. Cadence:  Run to the beat, then mash keys frantically for the final sprint. * ENDURANCE & WILLPOWER * Sisyphus:  Fight gravity to push the boulder using raw button-mashing speed. Dead Hang * Hold complex key combinations for 60 seconds without letting go. * KEY FEATURES  * Scientific Ranking System: Every run is recorded. Compare your 'Physical Score' globally. Escaping Conformity: Earn currency to unlock skins and stand out from the white clones. No RNG, Just Skill: No luck involved. If you fail, your physical wasn't good enough. **Welcome to the exam. rows.name: RK Override
rows.short_description: RK Override is an hour-long fully voiced interactive narrative following Chimera, a Mecha Captain fighting in an endless war for their country’s future. Fight for control against your Mecha’s AI copilot (RK System) as you attempt to end the conflict - no matter the cost.
rows.description_html: **INCOMING BROADCAST** For 50 years, Synergy Corporation has secured our prosperous nation and saved us from tyranny. Today, under the landmark Preservation Statute, the art of modern warfare has changed for the better. Our compliant mechanical mission systems contain our threats at no risk to human life. Our 4th generation Mecha systems have now been accepted into service by your government. 10,000 new units will be delivered over 5 years under a 50 billion dollar contract, creating thousands of jobs at the newly expanded Synergy Central Plant. We have sworn to defend our way of life, and will do everything in our technological power to defeat anyone standing in the way of progress and peace. Reverence to Synergy Corp and glory to our pilots. **END BROADCAST** The only hope against the Scrapper’s endless onslaught has always been Synergy Corp. They have defended the country for years, and managed to convince the Scrappers to agree to the Preservation Statute, ensuring that neither side kills the other. Conflicts are carried out using Mecha, with each Synergy Mecha Captain being assigned an RK System, an Automated Replicant Knowledge System that helps copilot their Mecha and ensure the statute is maintained. Assume the role of Chimera, a Mecha Captain of Synergy Corp, as they fight in this endless war. They have never truly believed in the statute, trusting neither the Scrappers nor Synergy Corp. They believe the only way to end the war is to break the statute and wipe out the Scrappers once and for all. Chimera’s RK System “Ki”, who is optimistic and hopeful about the world, disagrees with their outlook, and tries to convince them to see value in the statute. When Chimera's Mecha Squadron is deployed on a mission to defend the Synergy Central Plant from an invading Scrapper force, the status quo unexpectedly changes, and the fate of the conflict is put in Chimera’s hands. KEY FEATURES Immerse yourself in an hour-long fully voiced narrative Assume the role of Chimera as they fight in the ruthless conflict between Synergy Corp and the Scrappers Experience 2D animated cutscenes and 3D in-engine cinematics as Chimera attempts to alter the course of the war When in breach of the Statute, your RK System will interfere with your Mecha’s controls - fight back to ensure you achieve your goals

rows.name: PlaneShift
rows.short_description: PlaneShift is a Role Playing Game immersed into a 3D virtual fantasy world! A medieval world, with many cities to explore, monsters to fight, weapons and equipment to find and craft. A skill based progression system, magic and many quests.
rows.description_html: PlaneShift is a Role Playing Game immersed into a 3D virtual fantasy world! A medieval world, with many cities to explore, monsters to fight, weapons and equipment to find and craft. Old school as we are one of the first free MMOs! Made and maintained by volunteers (as a hobby!) Original setting and lore 9 playable races with unique traits Professions and crafting through a skill system Original magic system with six Ways of magic Hundreds of quests Many cities and outdoors to explore Open development approach, anyone can contribute Available for Windows, Linux and Mac

rows.name: Cubicle Cats
rows.short_description: Survive the 9-to-5 as a corporate cat! Sort emails, master rhythm-based meetings, fix printer jams, and make strategic decisions in this humorous 8-bit office simulator. Complete mini-games to earn promotions!
rows.description_html: Welcome to WhiskerWorks LLC, where cats manage emails, attend meetings, and navigate corporate drama in this hilarious 8-bit office life simulator! WHAT YOU'LL DO Sort emails, master rhythm-based meetings, fix printer jams, ace compliance quizzes, make strategic decisions, and climb the corporate ladder through a series of engaging mini-games. Each day brings new challenges as you balance productivity, reputation, and burnout. INBOX SORTING - Sort emails into folders before time runs out MEETING SIMULATOR - Hit buzzwords in this rhythm-based challenge PRINTER JAM - Fix the office printer through multiple repair games COMPLIANCE TRAINING - Pass corporate quizzes to advance PROMOTION REVIEW - Navigate dialogue choices to earn promotions CEO DASHBOARD - Make strategic decisions managing company KPIs FEATURES • Multiple engaging mini-games with unique mechanics • Career progression system with promotions and stat management • Office humor and satire throughout • Charming 8-bit pixel art aesthetic • Strategic decision-making that affects outcomes • Random events and AI coworker interactions • Replayable gameplay with varied challenges Whether you're sorting emails at breakneck speed, surviving endless meetings, or managing company crises, Cubicle Cats captures the absurdity of office life with humor and style. 🐱 CONTROLS: Currently supports mouse and keyboard. Controller support coming soon!

rows.name: A Seagull Game
rows.short_description: This is a short casual 2.5D platform puzzle game with a unique hand-drawn art style. A wee seagull who wants to get some chips at the pier, but accidentally falls into a vent system of an office building…
rows.description_html: A seagull with existential wisdom, is heading toward the pier to get some fries. Unfortunately, amid the forest of high-rise buildings, it accidentally crashes into a glass window and falls into the ventilation system of an office building. In this overlooked world, a diverse array of creatures live, each with its own unique perspective on life... A self-developed 2.5D puzzle game that delights the senses with its hand-drawn visuals, cute animation and vibrant sounds. Proceed at your own pace in figuring out the routes to carefully designed levels, explore the vent world and meet new creatures. Trying to confront the meaninglessness or nihilism of life through an existentialist approach. Playtime: 15-30 mins. Features: Black & White, Hand-Drawn Art Style. Sudoku-Inspired Puzzle Mechanics. Meet new Friends! Each of them has a witty quote. Casual philosophy ideas.

rows.name: How Smart Are You? IQ Test
rows.short_description: How smart are you? Take this IQ test and find out!
rows.description_html: How smart are you? Take this IQ test and find out! Features include a detailed IQ breakdown, question generation that allows for retesting, and a full length 50 question test. FEATURES - Detailed IQ report, with a breakdown of 5 intelligence categories . - Full length 50 question test gives greater IQ accuracy. - Question generator makes every test unique , making it possible to retake the test multiple times and diminishing gaming of the test. NOTE This IQ test is for entertainment purposes, but has been normalized in an attempt to give more accurate results. Therefore, the most important part of the test is the IQ category breakdown, which can highlight your areas of strength and weakness. The 5 categories are Mathematics, Spatial Reasoning, Short Term Memory, Logic, and Mental Efficiency. This test is especially good when you compare against someone else who was also took the test, as it works well as a comparison tool. Challenge a friend and see how you compare! ADDITIONAL INFO This game is part of the GZ Storm legacy series and was originally released on the Xbox 360 on July 22nd 2010. This version runs on PC and has some improvements.

rows.name: Woodswalker
rows.short_description: Woodswalker is a strategy-based survival horror game in which quick thinking is key. Listen closely to your surroundings, defend yourself with your searchlight, budget your limited power, and solve environmental puzzles to discover the truth of the forest.
rows.description_html: Woodswalker is an entirely solo-developed first-person survival horror game in which you've just been hired as a night ranger in the Cook County forest preserves. You must frantically balance your own survival with saving the lives of the innocent campers under your domain. Features Frantic Gameplay - Throughout the night, the monster will become increasingly aggressive. You will have less and less time to read your messages, decide its importance, and make it to the light before your fate is sealed. Many Secrets  - Explore a detailed story through puzzle-solving. Use environmental clues and good thinking to unlock boxes, find new cassette tapes, enter hidden areas, and locate secrets. A Dark, Wintry Atmosphere  - Immerse yourself into the surroundings with attention to detail on sound and lighting. Replayability - With 18 hidden achievements, a rich, secret-filled storyline, and maybe even a hidden difficulty, there is plenty to keep yourself busy with.

rows.name: SIM Election
rows.short_description: Take control of a political party and compete for power in this turn-based simulation. Manage strategy, face media pressure, debates and critical decisions, negotiate alliances, and lead your party to electoral victory.
rows.description_html: About This Game SimElection is a turn-based political simulation where you take control of a political party and face the entire road to election day. Manage your strategy, respond to media pressure, survive televised debates, control your finances, and decide how far you are willing to go to win. Every decision matters. Every turn can change the course of the campaign. A deep yet accessible political simulator In SimElection, players experience a full political term from the inside. Unexpected news, uncomfortable interviews, rumors, internal tensions, negotiations, and major media events will shape the pace of the game. Winning is not just about making promises. You must manage resources, protect your public image, control your party, and read the social climate to avoid losing support. Dynamic campaigns and realistic elections Take part in different types of elections: General Elections Regional Elections Municipal Elections Each election type has its own rules, rhythm, and consequences. Vote counting unfolds progressively, territory by territory, recreating the tension of a real election night. Decisions, consequences, and strategy The game is played in turns, where you will: Respond to political and media events Manage your party headquarters Deal with lobbies and pressure groups Make key economic decisions Face televised debates and interviews Organize campaign events and final rallies Nothing is ever completely safe — even good decisions can have unintended consequences. Total political freedom You can play with existing parties or create your own party from scratch, defining: Ideology Political positioning Territorial strategy Communication profile The system adapts to major parties, small movements, regionalist groups, and emerging political forces alike. Key Features Turn-based political simulation Full political party management Dynamic events and campaign news Interactive electoral debates Interviews and media pressure Economic and reputation systems Territorial strategy with interactive maps Progressive and realistic vote counting Multiple election types High replayability — every campaign is different Recommended for players who enjoy Management and strategy games Political and social simulators Decision-making with real consequences Emergent narrative experiences

rows.name: Glyph Chess
rows.short_description: Glyph Chess is a strategic board game infused with magical fantasy elements, derived from the Tales of Tarsylia. You will command mages with distinct abilities to escort your Scepter to the central 'Source of Magic', or to destroy the enemy's Scepter.
rows.description_html: Glyph Chess is a strategic board game infused with magical fantasy elements, derived from the Tales of Tarsylia . On a board where the four elements of wind, fire, water, and earth intertwine, you will command mages with distinct abilities. Your goal is to escort your Scepter to the central 'Source of Magic' or to destroy the enemy's Scepter. Core Features Seven Unique Pieces: Summoner : Summon an army to overwhelm your opponent. Illusionist : Stealth and invisibility, shifting positions at will. Abjurer : Project a Force Field to protect allies or crush enemies. Necromancer : Manipulate life and death, reviving any corpse to serve you. Diviner : Project a Divine Ward to suppress magic, the bane of all mages. Evoker : Pierce through the battlefield, incinerating everything. Scepter : The core and soul, the key to victory. Contest the Center, Unleash Metamagic The 'Source of Magic' at the center of the board is a strategic focal point. When your piece occupies the center, it gains powerful Metamagic  abilities. Controlling the center often tips the scales of victory in your favor. 2v2 Alliance Battles In four-player matches, players sitting opposite each other form an alliance. Tacit cooperation is the key to victory.

rows.name: Geobeast
rows.short_description: Test your geography skills with Geobeast! Find as many countries as you can in 12 minutes, master two unique game modes, and climb the global Steam leaderboard.
rows.description_html: Do you think you’re good at geography? Put your knowledge to the test with Geobeast . The concept is simple: find as many countries on the world map as possible before time runs out. At the end of each game, your score is recorded, allowing you to compete with players worldwide through the global Steam leaderboard . Normal Mode The default competitive mode in Geobeast. Each country found earns 1 point 12 minutes to find as many as possible Accuracy, memory, and speed make the difference Jumbo Mode The fun and strategic mode. A score multiplier system is introduced Find a country, then a neighboring country to double your points A third neighboring country triples the score, and so on 12 minutes to score as many points as possible Here, the goal isn’t just to find a lot of countries, but to make smart choices . Strategy is the key.

rows.name: Take Care Of It.
rows.short_description: Horror/thriller visual novel with RPG elements about two friends that explores guilt, co-dependency, and personal limits being pushed.
rows.description_html: Austin and Riley are childhood friends. Despite their tumultuous friendship in high school, things are going pretty good now in college. But that stability does not last. Something happens. Old habits resurface. Riley can fall back into old patterns, or he can draw a line. Both choices leave marks. Play as Riley as he grapples with guilt, responsibility, and personal limits.

rows.name: Five Nights At Monkeys: Flat Mode
rows.short_description: Five Nights At Monkeys: Flat Mode is a flat screen horror experience where every night is different. Survive roaming monsters, manage tricky power systems, and face sudden jumpscares across forests, canyons, cities, and dark mines.
rows.description_html: Five Nights At Monkeys: Flat Mode brings the chaos and unpredictability of the original VR experience to flatscreen play. Every night is different, with changing mechanics, systems, and threats that keep you on edge. Monsters roam freely, power systems can fail at the worst times, and things rarely go as planned. Learning how to react quickly is just as important as planning ahead. Throughout the nights, you’ll find yourself moving between a range of new locations, including forest treehouses, canyon huts, city streets, and dark underground mines. Each area introduces its own mechanics, dangers, and surprises, forcing you to adapt your strategy as you go. Some nights are quiet and tense, while others spiral into chaos without warning.

rows.name: Double Cross Dungeon
rows.short_description: The couch co-op roguelike dungeon crawler with a twist! Compete to perform the best in each room to see who gets first pick on the Ancient cards to prepare for the final fight. Will you escape with your friends, or die trying?
rows.description_html: Watch out, your friend may become your foe! Lost in the Temple of Nimh, your party trying to fight their way to freedom. Level up using the Ancient Cards and clearing each room of enemies as a team. All is fine until one of you is corrupted by the  Traitor Card...  Now it is not only a battle to escape but a battle to stay alive against your once friend! -=== Set Up ===- Connect 2 - 4 controllers to your laptop/PC via either Bluetooth or cable. Stand on the pressure plates to start, select your cards and fight your way through the dungeon! -=== How To Play ===- In Game (General): Movement: Left Joystick In Game Menu (Toggle): + Stats Peeks: Left Bumper Switch: Primary - Y Secondary - B Xbox: Primary - X Secondary - A Card Selection: Select Card - Left Joystick Confirm - A Deny - B -=== ===- Please note that if you wish to connect a Nintendo Switch Pro Controller as a wired controller, or experience controller vibration on a Nintendo Switch Pro Controller, you must enable Steam Input for Nintendo Switch Pro Controllers (from your Steam client controller settings) before launching the game, as Unity does not support either of these features natively. Please also make sure the 'Use Nintendo Button Layout' toggle is OFF, otherwise in-game button indicators will not be accurate.

rows.name: Sorrow's Serenade
rows.short_description: A brief emotional experience lasting a few minutes, centered on the quiet weight of a kept promise. A narrative-driven tale with minimal mechanics.
rows.description_html: Visit the final resting place of your beloved, fulfill the promise. Sorrow's Serenade is a micro-game delivering a concentrated 5-minute gameplay experience. This brief, emotional journey utilizes simple mechanics to tell a haunting tale of love that transcends the grave and the enduring power of a promise kept. Key Features: First-Person Perspective: Deep immersion in a hauntingly atmospheric world. Emotional Narrative: A story-driven experience focused on mood and meaning. Bite-sized Gameplay: A concise experience designed to be completed in a single 5-minute sitting. Gothic Horror: A thick, melancholic atmosphere blending dread with beauty. Simple Action Mechanics: Clear and intuitive gameplay that keeps the focus on the story. Written Dialogue: Text-based storytelling that enhances the intimate and poetic tone.

rows.name: BYE BYE! POLICE!
rows.short_description: Steal, Escape, and Power Up! 'BYE BYE! POLICE!' is a high-octane, first-person heist action game set in a stylized world. Evade the police blockade, cash in your loot, and upgrade your abilities. Master various skills to pull off the ultimate, 'smooth' robbery!
rows.description_html: Want to enjoy stealing more casually than a thief simulator? 'BYE BYE! POLICE!' is for you! This is a high-tempo, first-person thief action game where you use 11 different upgrades to break through police blockades. Enjoy a 'smooth' stealing experience across 7 stages, including tutorials and bonus levels! [11 Strategic Upgrades to Expand Your Tactics] Vacuum Van: Allows you to toss loot into the van from a distance! Rabbit Run: Increases movement speed. Outrun the cops with pure speed! Muscle Toss: Enhances throwing power. Throw heavy loot from afar for maximum efficiency! Extra Life: Increases remaining lives. You have more than one chance to succeed! Police Scanner: Highlights police positions. Know exactly where they are at all times! Scanner Burst: Increases the number of times you can use the scanner. Burst Shoot: Throw all your held loot at once in a single burst! Police Knockout: Allows you to take down police. But beware—are you ready for the 'Felony' (more reinforcements)? Bullet Time: Slows down time. Use slow-motion to assess the situation and escape! Summon Portal: Set up a portal that teleports loot directly to your van! Portal Plus: Increases the number of portals you can place. Build the perfect escape route. [7 Challenging Stages] Tutorial Trailer House The Bar Mansion The City Bonus Stages (Past game locations turned into heist scenes!?) Apartment Ruins - Streaming Guidelines - We welcome video posts and live streams of this game! Monetization is also permitted. The creator would be very happy if you could do the following: Link back to the store: Include the Steam store URL in your video description (Optional). Include the title: Please put 'BYE BYE! POLICE!' in your video title (The creator would love to find and watch your gameplay!).

rows.name: Downfall MMORPG
rows.short_description: Downfall MMORPG is an open-world sci-fi & fantasy MMORPG where magic and technology collide. Choose a faction, forge your own playstyle, and fight for control of a living world in massive PvP battles and endless PvE adventures.
rows.description_html: Sci-Fi and Fantasy Collide in a Living Open World Downfall MMORPG is a cross-genre open-world MMORPG where advanced technology clashes with ancient magic in a persistent, player-driven war. Choose your allegiance. Shape your playstyle. Decide the fate of an entire planet. Two Factions. One World. Endless Conflict. Kaelthera is home to the Lumen, a nature-bound civilization capable of wielding powerful magic drawn from the planet itself. Their world is under siege by the Coalition, a technologically superior spacefaring force stranded after a catastrophic crash and now determined to claim Kaelthera’s resources at any cost. Your choice of faction defines your journey: Embrace fantasy combat, ancient powers, and primal weapons Or step into a sci-fi RPG experience with firearms, mechs, and advanced armor Play Your Way Downfall is designed to adapt to your preferred MMORPG playstyle: Engage in large-scale PvP battles where entire servers fight for faction dominance Focus on PvE progression, hunting wildlife, elite enemies, and world bosses Explore a fully open world solo, with friends, or as part of a guild Mix and match gear, skills, and classes to create your own unique build Every choice matters. Every battle leaves a mark. Deep Customization & Progression 18 playable classes, each with unique abilities All classes can equip all weapons and armor Skillsets dynamically change based on equipped items Hundreds of items ranging from medieval weapons to futuristic firearms Upgrade and enhance your gear to push your power to its limits A True Open World MMORPG Fully open world with 7 distinct regions Seamless exploration without artificial barriers Dynamic environments and procedurally generated instances for infinite PvE replayability Dedicated PvP zone featuring massive faction-wide conflicts and rewards Cooperative & Social Gameplay Form parties, alliances, and guilds Take on epic bosses and high-risk content together Own pets that assist you in combat Collect mounts to traverse Kaelthera faster Key Features Open-world Sci-Fi & Fantasy MMORPG PvP and PvE gameplay at massive scale Two factions with distinct themes and playstyles Procedurally generated content for endless replayability Legendary loot, heroic quests, and world-changing battles The war for Kaelthera has begun. Choose your side. Forge your build. Welcome to Downfall MMORPG.
