rows.name: A Date With Chester 2
rows.short_description: It's been three years since your first date with Chester the Otter. It's your anniversary today, and you've both got surprises in store. Are you ready for a date that's truly out of this world?
rows.description_html: Has it been three years already? A Date With Chester 2 is a short, standalone story about remembering the good times. You've been with Chester for a while now. Have things gotten a little too comfortable? It's your anniversary today, and you've got something really special planned. You wonder what he's got in store for you... Hey, snap out of it - you've been planning this for a long time! Features: A short but thrilling experience - 30 minute to 1 hour expected playtime.  A nostalgic aesthetic that blends 3D with hand-drawn 2D art. ONE OR MORE otters! (There's one.) MORE THAN ONE ending! (....... There's two.) Twists and turns shake up the gameplay, guaranteed to keep your heart racing! A fresh, unexpected blend of genres, including point-and-click elements and tense first-person sections. Loads of collectible items scattered throughout - seek them out to unlock Chester's deepest hopes and fears. Note: Love can be a bit scary sometimes. That's okay, right?

rows.short_description: Agent C is the ultimate stealth survivor designed for tactical operations. This innovative character excels in infiltrating military bases, utilizing advanced stealth techniques to navigate through enemy lines undetected with the added capability of piloting a powerful helicopter.
rows.description_html: Experience the thrill of aerial combat with Agent C, an action-packed shooting game that puts you in control of a powerful helicopter. Engage in intense battles as you take aim at enemy tanks and strategize your way to victory. With dynamic gameplay and immersive graphics, Agent C offers an exhilarating challenge for gamers seeking adrenaline-fueled excitement. Dominate the skies and prove your skills in this ultimate test of precision and reflexes. Get ready to soar and conquer!

rows.name: Touhou Mistystory
rows.short_description: A free-to-play, single-player Touhou Project fan-made bullet hell shooter that blends light roguelike elements with modified gameplay mechanics. Defeat your enemies and collect dropped spell cards to enhance your abilities!
rows.description_html: A free-to-play, single-player, fan-made bullet hell shooter based on the Touhou Project, incorporating light roguelike elements and modifying the original game rules. Defeat your enemies and collect dropped spell cards to enhance your abilities (or sell them). In addition, the game's framework has been significantly modified, with substantial changes to resource collection and usage logic. You can use dodge actions or hide off-screen to avoid enemy attacks. Furthermore, this game is built on the Godot engine, demonstrating Godot's potential to create visually appealing 3D games. The game was originally intended for a university game development competition; now that the competition is over, it's being released for free play.

rows.name: Paperback
rows.short_description: Paperback is a short horror game that takes place in a public library at night with an aggressive thunderstorm raging in the vicinity where you take on the role of the newly hired novice librarian, Max.
rows.description_html: Dawn Of The Millenium  - the year is 2001 . You're a novice librarian tasked with keeping things running smoothly and closing up shop for the night. Sort out the shelves, maintain the utilities of the library and take calls as they come in - but keep your ears to the ground; there's something sinister unfurling in Maple Falls County Logic-oriented puzzles and mechanics make up most of this game with a fully integrated physics and object-grabbing system, drawing inspiration from horror games of the past and present. The game takes roughly 30-60 minutes to finish depending on your own individual pace. It features multiple paths the player can take, and even has a secret easter egg. Think you can find it?  Highly recommended for playing in the dark - the muted orange hue of the library coupled with the dark atmosphere should be very easy on the eyes. An ideal game for those seeking a cozy indie horror experience. Also, headphones are a big must if you enjoy immersive 3D sound design. Disclaimer Regarding AI Usage This game does not feature any AI content. All voice lines, assets, texts and sound effects have been produced naturally by verified users and commissioned artists. If you think a particular asset featured in the game was generated by AI, please reach out to me at morningraininteractive@gmail.com

rows.name: Robo Dolphin Escape
rows.short_description: Break out of a top-secret military operation! To enter the portal that leads to your escape, you must thwart an army of fish-like machines and collect their power-ups.
rows.description_html: You emerge in an underwater military testing site, next to a mysterious portal. If you can move fast enough, you might just be able to enter the portal, and make your escape. The site is littered with mechanical foes, which are best slain through the clever coordination of their own attacks. Full features list: Enemies  - Fight against 4 types of aquatic machines, each with their own attack patterns. As you explore the facility, enemies become stronger and more frequent! Devices  - Start each game with one of 6 special abilities, which can protect you from harm, distract enemies, or just straight-up kill them. Game Modifiers  - Make the game easier or harder with the choice of 10 different gamemodes, which can all be enabled in parallel with each other. There's also 2 super-challenge modes for pros. Highscores  - Earn score by defeating enemies. Your best scores are saved locally, so you can cherish them forever. Original Soundtrack  - Listen to the 5 songs (honestly not that many) I made for this game. Each song is inspired by one of the game's characters! Pixel Graphics  -   Enjoy a nostalgic pixel-art aesthetic.

rows.name: Channel 4 Midnight
rows.short_description: A bite-sized psychological horror game about a wayward soul who seeks transformation through a sinister ritual.
rows.description_html: You are far away from home. Winter chills you to the bone. Staying at a dingy inn, you perform an old ritual that who-knows-whom on the internet taught you. This is a story-driven, first person horror game of 15-20 minutes of gameplay. Guidelines to the ritual are hinted at in a blog called The Channels, which can only be accessed through the inn's private network. You read the page carefully and follow the guidelines. Then you will be fine. At the end of a successful ritual, you will be rewarded by being transformed into someone completely different from who you are. Well, how does that sound? Tempting? Then give it a try.

rows.name: Game Saloon Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Step into the world of fun and become the boss of your own game saloon! In this free version of the game, you’ll serve customers, enjoy interactive games, and get a taste of the relaxing and enjoyable experience that awaits you.
rows.description_html: [ Game Saloon Simulator: Prologue is a free version prepared for you to experience the  Game Saloon Simulator in advance. By purchasing and placing classic arcade machines, you can increase your saloon’s appeal and expand your venue by unlocking new areas. But that’s not all — just like your customers, you can also enjoy the games! Grow your business while having fun in your own game saloon. Key Features: Expandable saloon system Interactive entertainment equipment Service mechanics that increase customer satisfaction Freedom to design your own play area Relaxing, humorous, and enjoyable simulation experience Build the 'Game Saloon' you’ve always dreamed of — manage it and have fun!

rows.name: 天使戦争 Angels' War
rows.short_description: Our angel Amane Kanata soars the sky in this short 'souls-like' action game.
rows.description_html: Is there salvation in this 'world'? 天使戦争 Angels' War is a free fan-made 'souls-like' action game, featuring Amane Kanata from Hololive 4th Gen as the main character. In this game, our angel Amane Kanata soars the sky to reach the end of this imaginary world. This is a short game featuring only a few boss fights. Note from the Author Inspired by Amane Kanata's 3D Live, I started developing this game as a passion side project mid-2025. As a Heimin (Kanata‘s fan), I wanted to create an experience where Kanata is flying in the sky, overcoming any obstacles she faces, just like the legendary idol and VTuber herself. The original scope was bigger, and the project was initially planned to be finished in 2027. After Kanata’s graduation announcement on December 2nd, 2025, I almost gave up on this game for... a day. But in the end, I decided that I had something I needed to express, and that I still had an experience I wanted to share in this game. I decided to take a break from work until Christmas 2025, holing myself up in my apartment to finish the game with reduced scope, 'if this game would at least function as a game by then, I would release it as a free and non-commercial game available to the world'. I managed to finish it 2 hours before Kanata's farewell live concert on December 27, 2025. Note that the narrative is strongly fan-oriented. In certain situations in the game, messages collected from fellow Heimins will appear at random. Through this, we hope to let at least one player know that 'you are not alone.'   These messages are presented in their original languages, mostly Japanese. The game may be short and feel unpolished, and it is a very different game from the original vision, but still, I tried my best in this short period to convey the experience I want to share. If you find enjoyment, I would be very happy. -Windy Darian Controls Controls manual is also available at in-game pause menu. Controller recommended. Controller: L2/LT: Fly Square/X: Dodge R1/RB: Punch R2/RT: Shuriken Left Thumbstick: Move Right Thumbstick: Camera R3/RS: Lock on Mouse/Keyboard: Space: Fly Left Shift: Dodge LMB: Punch RMB: Shuriken WASD: Move Mouse: Camera Q/MMB: Lock on Disclaimer This game is a personal, free and non-commercial derivative work featuring character Amane Kanata © COVER Corp. / Hololive Production. This game was made following the official Derivative Works Guidelines from COVER Corp. . This game is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with COVER Corp. or Hololive Production. For third-party assets used, please refer to third_party.txt in the game folder.
rows.about_html: Is there salvation in this 'world'? 天使戦争 Angels' War is a free fan-made 'souls-like' action game, featuring Amane Kanata from Hololive 4th Gen as the main character. In this game, our angel Amane Kanata soars the sky to reach the end of this imaginary world. This is a short game featuring only a few boss fights. Note from the Author Inspired by Amane Kanata's 3D Live, I started developing this game as a passion side project mid-2025. As a Heimin (Kanata‘s fan), I wanted to create an experience where Kanata is flying in the sky, overcoming any obstacles she faces, just like the legendary idol and VTuber herself. The original scope was bigger, and the project was initially planned to be finished in 2027. After Kanata’s graduation announcement on December 2nd, 2025, I almost gave up on this game for... a day. But in the end, I decided that I had something I needed to express, and that I still had an experience I wanted to share in this game. I decided to take a break from work until Christmas 2025, holing myself up in my apartment to finish the game with reduced scope, 'if this game would at least function as a game by then, I would release it as a free and non-commercial game available to the world'. I managed to finish it 2 hours before Kanata's farewell live concert on December 27, 2025. Note that the narrative is strongly fan-oriented. In certain situations in the game, messages collected from fellow Heimins will appear at random. Through this, we hope to let at least one player know that 'you are not alone.'   These messages are presented in their original languages, mostly Japanese. The game may be short and feel unpolished, and it is a very different game from the original vision, but still, I tried my best in this short period to convey the experience I want to share. If you find enjoyment, I would be very happy. -Windy Darian Controls Controls manual is also available at in-game pause menu. Controller recommended. Controller: L2/LT: Fly Square/X: Dodge R1/RB: Punch R2/RT: Shuriken Left Thumbstick: Move Right Thumbstick: Camera R3/RS: Lock on Mouse/Keyboard: Space: Fly Left Shift: Dodge LMB: Punch RMB: Shuriken WASD: Move Mouse: Camera Q/MMB: Lock on Disclaimer This game is a personal, free and non-commercial derivative work featuring character Amane Kanata © COVER Corp. / Hololive Production. This game was made following the official Derivative Works Guidelines from COVER Corp. . This game is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with COVER Corp. or Hololive Production. For third-party assets used, please refer to third_party.txt in the game folder.

rows.name: Hopping Ninja-san
rows.short_description: Hop your way to the goal as Hopping Ninja-san! A high-difficulty game with simple controls — just be careful not to hit your head.
rows.description_html: Control Hopping Ninja-san and bounce your way to the goal. Hopping Ninja-san automatically jumps off the ground and walls. You only need two buttons: rotate left or right to adjust your angle and jump over obstacles. It’s a high-difficulty, skill-based platformer, but frequent checkpoints make it approachable even for beginners. Hitting your head sends you back to the last checkpoint. The game can be completed in about 1–2 hours.

rows.name: Down With Hell: Crystal
rows.short_description: Play as M in this retro styled platform-shooter and blast your way up to heaven!
rows.description_html: In this adventure you'll find yourself journeying through ruins to find an oasis said to grant a short burst of unlimited power, you are headed there to open a portal to the heavens to retrieve 'God's Crystal'. Play as M in this retro styled 2D shooter and blast your way up to the heavens! Scale walls with your versatile wall jump & blast enemies with your GUN! Defeat enemies to collect encyclopedia pages to learn more about each enemy! Features a difficult New Game +
